games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Vienna
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Vienna in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

games.name: Acting Out
games.summary:
Don't be shy. Act with everything you've got!
The online co-op game where you are actors in a movie, but filming is one-take, do-or-die! Your bloopers won't get cut, so don't screw it up.
Whether you follow the script or ruin it with improv, you'll watch your masterpiece right away. Will be it great or will it be cringe? That's up to you!

games.name: Alien Bloom
games.summary: Alien Bloom is a three-player turn-based strategy card game in which rival factions compete for control of Earth. Players expand across a world map, attack territories, resolve battles using card-game mechanics, deploy spaceships, and pursue multiple victory conditions.

games.name: Aniquiz
games.summary: Aniquiz is a quiz game about anime music! Inspired by the popular “guess the opening/ending song” quizzes that are all about matching a set of anime songs to their anime, Anime Music Quiz takes these quizzes one step further! Thanks to the ever-expanding community-driven song database, an unlimited amount of unique quizzes can be generated. Furthermore you can add your MyAnimeList account to have your quizzes personalized by the anime you’ve watched, while still throwing in new and fresh anime for you to discover!

games.name: Antichrist
games.summary: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

games.name: Antivirus Girl
games.summary: Antivirus Girl is a defense shooter game where you become an inspector for the anti-malware Sentinel to protect computers from malware. Inspect files coming in from the network, let safe files pass through, and immediately eliminate malware.

games.name: Backrooms Protocol
games.summary: Backrooms Protocol is a 1–4 player co-op horror game focused on exploration, research, and survival across the levels of the Backrooms.

games.name: Backrooms: Collision Not Found
games.summary: A 1-4 player co-op horror experience. Navigate hyper-realistic Backrooms levels and liminal spaces, survive unique entities, and uncover the dark mystery behind those levels. Extreme visual fidelity meets psychological dread.

games.name: Block Sprawl
games.summary: A spatial puzzle strategy game where cards create building shapes. Fit them into tight, constrained grids, expand your city, and use cards to bend rules and unlock actions. Min-max adjacency, terrain, and line bonuses to meet ever-increasing city council demands and engineer massive combo turns.

games.name: Burnout
games.summary: Burnout is the perfect game for anyone who has run out of patience. Click, snap, let it out: here stress isn’t cured, it’s recycled. The more unhinged you get, the more the game rewards you.

games.name: Caravan SandWitch
games.summary: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure game.

games.name: Carpet Cleaning Master
games.summary: Clean filthy carpets until they look new again. Mind each one's rules, watch your water and power bills, and try not to think too hard about the company you work for. A cozy cleaning sim with something underneath.

games.name: Cat Squeeze
games.summary: Cat Squeeze is a cozy, brain-teasing cat puzzle game. Playing as an explosive kitten, use the extrusion of the pipeline, and navigate a maze to collect fish treats! Solve puzzles with precise blasts to escape, or get trapped by the soft maze.

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

games.name: Chant Wizard
games.summary: Scream to win! Shout over-the-top spells in this hilarious voice-controlled battler. Assemble your magical deck from the five elements for 1v1 duels testing your wits and shame. Warning: Play safely—don't let your roaring summon the neighbors before you beat your rival!

games.name: Chasm Shift
games.summary: A 2D pixelated platformer journey through a mysterious and vast maze of puzzle box dungeons. Solve puzzle-infused platforming challenges and uncover new abilities as you plunge into an atmospheric adventure.

games.name: Clairval
games.summary: Join the pack, enter the pact and impose your law in a game of cunning and suspicion. Here, words are your sharpest weapon or your deadliest weakness. Manipulate, accuse, survive. The truth has never been so elusive.

games.name: Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia
games.summary: Clarity is a 2D side scrolling platforming adventure. Choose to face seven demons and acquire their demon sword and demon magic. Each sword and spell, has an elemental strength against a corresponding demon.

games.name: Cozy Cleanup
games.summary: Clean up after a big party, collect trash, and earn money for better tools and new areas. Play at your own pace, customize your equipment, and find hidden rubber ducks. No violence, no stress, just relaxing cleanup.

games.name: CryptoGrid
games.summary: CryptoGrid is an addictive clicker simulator where you build your digital empire from scratch. Click to earn coins, upgrade your performance, unlock unique music tracks, and collect rare items. Start your journey, manage your resources, and reach the top in this relaxing and engaging experience!

games.name: Defense of Wancotte
games.summary: Build-a-Tower Defense. Combine modular units to forge custom towers, experiment with thousands of synergies, and save Wancotte from the encroaching shadow!

games.name: Doctor Pigeon Simulator
games.summary: This isn't a normal ER. What's going on here, why are you pooping in the hallway?! I'll attend to the patient having a heart attack. Oh no, the exploding uncle! Stay away from my bed. I don't think I can manage this ER...

games.name: Double Knight
games.summary: Fight through a dangerous dungeon with an ever-growing army of synchronized doubles in this chaotic roguelike.

games.name: Empire in Decay
games.summary:
Empire in Decay is a roguelike deckbuilding turn-based tactical game, loosely based on chess. Its gameplay has been broadened with the use of cards and the progression of units. In the game, you'll proceed through procedurally generated routes across the districts of Daandria, the capital of the Empire.
In your journey to the Throne Hall to face the King, you will have to fight turn-based combats through different locations, collect cards and upgrade them, recruit units to support your cause and enhance them, find relics and forge artifacts to boost your powers, and use all your cunning and skill to make your way through waves of enemies.

games.name: Empyrean Defense
games.summary: Empyrean Defense is a modern military tower defense game where players build, upgrade, and customize defensive sites to repel waves of invading forces. The game features player abilities, skill progression, and resource management systems, including crafting ammunition and gathering resources directly on the battlefield to adapt to evolving threats.

games.name: Engine of Chaos
games.summary: Bolt guns and upgrades to a runaway train and blast through endless hordes of zombies, monsters, and abominations across six brutal environments. Build your loadout, unlock new carriages, and see how far you can survive.

games.name: Escape: Immersion
games.summary: Escape: Immersion is a horror adventure inspired by Inside and Little Nightmares. An atmospheric survival adventure with puzzles, platforming, and unpredictable challenges inside a collapsing underwater lab.

games.name: Evolution Survival
games.summary: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Who knows when Natural Selection is at the wheel!

games.name: Exaverse
games.summary: Extinction of the Exaverse is a mobile roguelike where evolved dinosaurs fight back against invading AI machines. Players progress through biome-based runs, choosing powerful upgrades and building unique combat styles each attempt.

games.name: FirstPlate
games.summary: FirstPlate is a first-person multiplayer cooking game about preparing orders, managing kitchen chaos, and working together under pressure.

games.name: Flawed Tactics
games.summary: Build an unstoppable team of adorable characters ready to destroy all enemies!

games.name: Forever RPG
games.summary: Embark on a new adventure on every playthrough. Find equipment, meet all sorts of NPCs and battle your way through a short 10 chapter randomised story. A casual retro roguelite RPG you can play forever!

games.name: Founding Paws: How America Began
games.summary: Relive the American Revolution through the paws of two historical heroes!

games.name: Fractured Library
games.summary: A cozy 2D pixel art adventure where you explore magical worlds, solve whimsical puzzles, and collect crystal fragments to restore a misbehaving library: no combat, just curious discoveries and a dash of chaos.

games.name: Frocat Puzzles
games.summary: For Frocat Puzzles, Ukrainian artists and writers have collaborated to create a relaxing experience. Piece together uniquely divided images in order to discover new stories.

games.name: Garden of Being
games.summary: Garden of Being is a handmade oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

games.name: Graveyard Orbit
games.summary: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

games.name: GravityBall
games.summary:
GravityBall is an action-arcade game where players take control of an ancient, magical artifact attempting to escape from deep within a high-tech alien stronghold. Stripped from Earth and locked away for its immense power, the spherical artifact awakens with a single purpose: navigate the alien base's complex defense systems and break free.

Featuring 20 meticulously handcrafted levels rather than procedural generation, the game offers a structured journey with a rising mechanical challenge. Players must roll, dodge, and weave through specialized obstacle courses by mastering and upgrading six unique magical abilities, including Lightning Discharge, Levitation, Time Distortion, Shockwave, and a specialized Wrecking Ball mechanic. Alongside its progression system, GravityBall features distinct unlockable skins to customize the artifact, an original atmospheric soundtrack, and entirely human-made, stylized 3D visuals.

games.name: Guild Soup
games.summary: Created for SOUPJAM2026, Guild Soup is the joined effort of several Moth Guild members. Deeply inspired by the original SOUP as well as SOUP ROOMS and many other SOUP-likes, we got together to have fun and create some cool spaces in the process.

games.name: Headache: Altered States
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a psychedelic adventure created with RPG Maker. The main character uses a substance “Nix” to draw inspiration for her book from surreal worlds. The line between hallucination and reality blurs, and the search for creativity turns into a struggle with addiction and inner demons.

games.name: Increbouncer
games.summary: Increbouncer is a short incremental ball game where you launch balls, earn two different currencies from wall bounces and ball collisions, unlock new balls, and level up a skill tree to maximize your income.

games.name: Just Futanari 3
games.summary: Online adult game exclusively for VR Let's play H with everyone as a futanari!

games.name: Limekaruza STG
games.summary: Slack artstyle indie Bullet Hell Shooter

games.name: Lost Ages Hunting
games.summary: Hunt across time itself. Track dinosaurs, Ice Age beasts, modern wildlife, and creatures from future eras in a unique hunting simulation spanning multiple worlds.

games.name: Love in Space
games.summary: It is the year 2009. A short time after "the incident". Mankind has fled the scorched crusts of planet earth for a better life in space. Those unlucky few who still reside on earth are forced to live beneath the sea in leaky metal domes. This includes you... 50% Visual Novel - 50% Karaoke-Musical.

games.name: Lullabies Made of Static
games.summary: The world is gone. In the silent aftermath of humanity’s fall, you explore the ruins of a post-apocalyptic megalopolis surrounded by industrial brutalist factories, collecting forgotten cassettes that will reveal what human emotions once felt like long ago.

games.name: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
games.summary: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon is a survivor-style roguelite action RPG for Nintendo Switch. Play as Luna, a curious black cat adventurer, and harness the power of the legendary dragon Selva. Use Scale Change magic to grow giant or shrink tiny while battling legendary monsters in fast-paced 10-minute adventures. Build powerful combinations using weapon, support, and beast cards, and team up with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

games.name: Mind Vessel
games.summary: An autobattler roguelite in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

games.name: Miracle Brave
games.summary: Endless tides of beasts crash against your fortress, yet never breach your line. Fight alongside your brave companions, reap the invaders, and grow stronger with every battle. Rise to meet the next wave with greater might—reap, strengthen, reap again. The cycle never ends.

games.name: Mosaic Garden: The Flower Game
games.summary: A relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where flowers spread and mutate in real time. Shape their growth, clear space, and transform one pattern into the next on a colorful 10×9 grid.

games.name: Murder Castle
games.summary: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

games.name: Nano Reef
games.summary: Turn every keystroke into a thriving ocean! Nano Reef is a cozy companion game where typing or clicking earns gold—without interrupting your work. Spend gold to buy marine fish, vibrant corals, and decorations, or feed your fish to interact. Build your unique, relaxing desktop aquarium!

games.name: Navy Mission
games.summary:
A 3D naval shooter in which the player commands a single warship through 30+ missions against waves of enemy vessels and aircraft. Three weapons — main gun, Phalanx, and missiles — must be switched quickly to handle different threats.
Enemy types include battleships, carriers, fighters, torpedo bombers, and more, each with distinct behavior. Multiple difficulty levels available.

games.name: Overdrive Reloaded
games.summary: Overdrive Reloaded is a single player first-person shooter created by Dynamite Games. Drop into a stunning reimagining of the series, built from the ground up with relentless PvE combat, action-packed Arena modes, open world Battle Royale, and an all-new progression system known as Evolution.

games.name: PNR: Point of No return
games.summary: You don't dodge. You push through. PNR: Point of No Return is a space opera roguelite where you blast through enemy fleets head-on, forging a new loadout every sortie. Build your arsenal mid-battle, come back alive, hit the jackpot on the Slingshot, and do it all again.

games.name: Parralysis
games.summary: You open your eyes in a surreal space, paralysed. The only thing you can do is to scarcely move your right arm, and scribble. Scribble in a notepad before you to move forward. Towards a goal you must reach, despite something horrific trying to reach you. Create the cure. You don't have much time.

games.name: Pointo's Big Adventure
games.summary: Pointo's Big Adventure is a hand drawn, single-screen platformer about spinning and climbing. Play as Pointo the gray star in his grand journey to find and collect the Shiny Things! Why? Because shiny things are awesome!

games.name: Pokéfeet
games.summary:
web-based trivia game where you'll have to guess a Pokémon by its feet (and some advices revealed in case you're needing a hint).
Challenges – Daily or Weekly: Put yourself to the test using our selection of 5 to 10 Pokémon per game. Emoji Share System to compare your results with your friends, Marathon Mode, Feet-dex

games.name: Poor Bird
games.summary: Poor Bird is a 2D side-scrolling arcade survival game inspired by Flappy Bird. Across 10 themed levels, players navigate obstacles and dynamic hazards before facing a boss encounter at the end of each stage. The game features a two-phase level structure alternating between low-hazard "leisure" zones and high-hazard "danger" zones, a monster wave system introduced in the later levels, and a set of general and level-specific cheat codes. The game supports offline play and includes optional in-app purchases to remove ads.

games.name: Problematic
games.summary:
Problematic is a gothic party game where someone always goes too far.
Judge cursed answers, betray your friends, and battle in Problematic Chess, where strategy meets chaos.
Use power-ups, survive secret rules, and do whatever it takes to win. You will need every advantage you can get.

games.name: Procelio
games.summary: Procelio is a multiplayer voxel-based vehicle builder and shooter. Create your chassis and combine movement parts, guns, and other functional utilities to create a remote-controlled war machine, then duke it out with others in the war tearing its way across the Martian frontier.

games.name: Project Solaris
games.summary: A rogue-lite RPG about the 100-day challenge of Solaris, a Less magic power witch, and her sidekick Homu, with beautifully animated combat, quick-time events, and charming characters to interact with!

games.name: Quadra
games.summary: Put your logic to the test with this sleek, minimalist puzzle experience. Your goal is simple: use the tiles to hide every dot on the grid

games.name: Reclaim
games.summary: Reclaim is a fantasy visual novel following a peculiar elf and a dying god trying to free the world and themselves. Choose wisely and help them study, create, and escape.

games.name: Room.txt
games.summary: You find yourself in a room with no doors. This is an unconventional soup-like made for SOUPJAMP2026.

games.name: Sepapu
games.summary: Playing with a field of bits on the magical sandlight. A puzzle, it solved neatly.

games.name: Shards of the Heart
games.summary: Shards of the Heart is a story-driven RPG with strong visual novel and dating sim elements. Dive deep into a branching narrative with rich character interactions and emotional storytelling.

games.name: Shmandala
games.summary: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

games.name: Signal Zero
games.summary: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

games.name: SpaceCiv
games.summary:
SpaceCiv is a persistent, browser-based multiplayer 4X strategy game about colonizing space — one that you can play at your own pace, even while you're away. You start small: a lone colony on a single world, an economy to balance, a first ship to build. From there you explore your home system, reach for other stars, and grow an empire that expands until it collides with the domains of real players around you.
Six playable races each bring a distinct identity — from the balanced, diplomatic Terrans to the swift raiding Felari, the hive-like Brood, and the exotic Voidborn — with fleets you design and fit to your strategy. The galaxy itself is shared and ever-growing, expanding as new players arrive, with an endless frontier to explore and a contested heartland worth holding.
Play it calm or play it cutthroat. Build a beautiful, humming empire, cooperate in alliances, or fight for dominance across seasonal ages that each end in a galaxy-shaping reckoning — and whose greatest deeds are recorded in a chronicle that outlasts them. However you play, your empire keeps living while you're offline, and the story you leave behind endures.

games.name: Speed Rivals: Model Trains
games.summary: Build your dream railway. Lay tracks, design stations, decorate every detail - then put your network to the test delivering cargo and passengers across maps you created yourself.

games.name: Star Witch
games.summary: Sandbox sci-fi fantasy survival RPG. Play as a scientist working on teleportation, who gets sent to another world that has been taken over by a witch, and your only way home is to join the resistance.

games.name: Still in the Fog
games.summary: A first-person horror adventure that combines environmental exploration, combat, strategic puzzles, and intense encounters in a fog-covered town that refuses to let you escape. Can you find a way out? Estimated playtime: 4–7 hours

games.name: Strafest
games.summary: Strafest is a third-person co-op platformer full of physics-based minigames! Join friends in dodge boulders in volcanic pits or outrun bridge-blasting cannons. Unlock colorful Skins, Trails, and Titles to customize your character. It’s all about teamwork, goofy moments, and having a blast together!

games.name: The Abyss Below
games.summary: The year is 1997. Pilot a small submersible into the depths of the Pacific to investigate a massive sonar anomaly. Navigate by instruments, scan targets, and uncover something far older than it should be.

games.name: The Dark Curiosity
games.summary: First-person sci-fi psychological horror set on a secret corporate station. Left alone to secure it, you navigate oppressive corridors where every sound, shadow and choice punishes. "Curiosity always leads you further than fear ever could."

games.name: The Drawn Hour
games.summary: The Drawn Hour is a haunted-terminal card roguelike. Dial into a cursed dial-up BBS as one of three operators, build a deck, and claw through three corrupted sectors. Manage your rising Corruption, hunt relics, and face what waits at the drawn hour — alone, or in 2–4 player online co-op.

games.name: The Gardener
games.summary: Solve tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

games.name: The Old Man and His Cat
games.summary: Play as Domino, a stray cat in love with food, in this heartwarming adventure where you help an old man overcome his grief after his wife passed away. Use your feline skills to explore and solve puzzles as you strive to bring joy into the old man's life and build an unbreakable bond with him.

games.name: The Punchbag Machine
games.summary: A fast-paced pixel-neon rhythm roguelite where every missed punch can end your run. Hit falling notes, chain combos, upgrade your boxer, defeat 9 bosses, and climb the leaderboard.

games.name: The Sound of Piano
games.summary: A keyboard rhythm game featuring pure piano tracks, where every note hit generates a real key sound for an authentic piano response. Designed for intermediate to advanced players, the game includes a unique skill test algorithm to determine player ratings. All tracks are human-crafted without the use of AI-generated music. The game also features an automatic MIDI converter, allowing players to import and play their own MIDI files.

games.name: Thirsty Princess
games.summary: Thirsty Princess is a fast-paced, top-down party game for 2–4 local players where you and your friends compete to drink beer with an impatient and unreasonable princess. Get drunk and slowly lose control while you brawl, steal from and sabotage your friends to win the favour of your princess.

games.name: Tomboy Adventure 2
games.summary: Start a relaxing adventure together with your (girl) friend!

games.name: Top Drifters
games.summary: A frantic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, vibrant low-poly graphics, high-speed chaotic races and physics-based, drifting-focused driving. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats, tear through unconventional. semi destructible tracks and become the "Top Drifter".

games.name: Total Chaos Against Apathy
games.summary: A high-intensity action game, inspired by the feeling of emulating arcade-only action games. Learn a simple-yet-nuanced two button control scheme. Use hitstun, attack chains, grabbing and throwing to crush and control hordes of enemies! Tank controls are awesome!

games.name: Tumbles
games.summary:
Tumbles (Previously Silk Soar) is a Physics Flinging, Rage-Bringing Narrative 2D Platformer (Foddian), where you take on life as a newborn caterpillar attempting to meet the challenges of flinging yourself from the rainforest floor to the top of the canopy.

Launch your caterpillar around using a catapult-like motion to bounce off walls and flowers, be pushed by the wind, slide across wet leaves and avoid obstacles.

As you reach higher into the canopy, you will face more difficult jumps and a variety of obstacles to go further through the layers of the rainforest in search of the top of the canopy.

Explore the poetic narrative of the struggles of reaching from the depths of darkness in search of freedom and light.

Each time you choose to build your cocoon there is an increasing chance of evolutions affecting your next caterpillar. Will you be a different colour, have a more bouncy body, or have tunnel vision? What combinations will you have and will they help or hinder your next climb?

In Tumbles, every climb can bring you further through the climb you have faced before or challenge you with a combination of evolutions. Will you make it out from the forest floor and into the light or will this climb be cut short as another cocoon in the darkness?

Can you make it to freedom?

games.name: Turnip Rush
games.summary: In our new Party Game Turnip Rush, face your friends up to 4 players ! Forget the static board game for a dynamic and exciting gameplay ! Grow as much turnips as you can and prevent your friends of doing so by any means ( yes, this include exploding them)

games.name: Valkyrie Tune: Synthesis of Souls
games.summary:
A visual novel that brings the "Valkyrie Tune" plastic model series by Good Smile Company to life.
Experience the resonant story of an amnesiac protagonist and six stunning heroines, whose intertwining serenade of love, sorrow, and fateful encounters calls forth a reboot for the future.

games.name: Verticopolis
games.summary: Verticopolis is a free, browser-native homage to the 1994 classic SimTower. Build a high-rise from the ground up: place offices, condos, shops, restaurants, and hotels, then wire them together with elevators, escalators, and stairs as your population grows. Keep tenants happy by managing congestion, cleanliness, noise, and rent, respond to fires and other events, and climb the star ratings all the way to a 5-star TOWER. Two rule-sets are included: a pixel-faithful Classic mode that mirrors the original, and a Modern mode that adds continuous pricing, variable households, and a deeper economy. No download or account — it plays instantly in any modern browser and installs as a PWA.

games.name: Vexle
games.summary: Vexle is a free daily flag game. Build the day's flag from coloured parts in six tries, or draw any of the world's flags from memory. A new flag every day.

games.name: Void Captains
games.summary:
Void Captains is a roguelike collectible-card territory-control game set in the void between dying stars. Players command a starship for one of four alien factions, forge a deck from 129 cards across five rarities, and fight card-driven ship combat across procedurally generated star sectors where fleets move one planet per turn and enemy attacks are defended in real battles.

Roguelike pirate-hideout runs chain encounters against five enemy ship classes, while a deck builder, forge, and progression system carry a collection between campaigns played across four difficulty tiers.

games.name: What the Dog Doing?
games.summary: What the dog doing? is an abstract action game with the core theme of "meme melee". Its gameplay is to defeat bosses to pass levels. In battles, you need to flexibly dodge attacks, create counterattack opportunities to clear levels, and all intense battles take place in a duel arena.​

games.name: Wheelchair for Two
games.summary: Start a chaotic co-op adventure in one wheelchair. Two players control different sides of the chair and must work together to survive brutal obstacles, dangerous jumps, and physics-based challenges. Play solo, local co-op, or online with a friend — one small mistake can send you both falling down.

games.name: Wild West Nightmare
games.summary: Enter the cursed mine of the wild west, a spooky western adventure where danger lurks in every shadow.

games.name: Wizard Soup
games.summary: The first collaborative project from Machine Wizards Interactive, explore our soup, explore your feelings, and vibe to your hearts content.

games.name: Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?
games.summary: A puzzle game where you play as a snake. Push objects, block lasers, teleport, and bite your tail off to escape dreamy puzzle rooms.

games.name: Write Night
games.summary: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

games.name: Wuthering Waves
games.summary:
Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and surmount the Lament.

The game features fast-paced combat with a variety of mechanics such as Extreme Evasion and Dodge Counter. You can also absorb the remaining of the monsters you've defeated and use their power in battles.

games.name: Aether Keepers
games.summary: Tower Defense meets Casual Incremental! Be the ultimate caretaker and fiercely guard the core; Watch the stats skyrocket and enjoy pure mowing bliss!

games.name: Aphelion
games.summary:
Aphelion is a text-forward space-horror adventure in which Vale, a rescue medic, boards the survey ship Aphelion-7 ten weeks after it went dark past the heliopause. Told in first-person present tense with painterly scene art and visual-novel dialogue, the game moves compartment by compartment through a dying ship, gathering evidence and reading survivors who may no longer be entirely themselves.

Around 21 pen-and-paper puzzles with provable solutions gate progress, spanning logic-gate circuits, ciphers, and constraint locks, and hints cost sanity, a resource that makes the game itself start lying as it drops. Choices persist across the story, two of them irrevocably, leading to six tonally distinct endings tracked across playthroughs.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Lady Bug
games.summary: Strategic play is the key to victory!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Lady Bug
games.summary: Strategic play is the key to victory!

games.name: Archmage Idle
games.summary: An idle/incremental RPG where you're an Archmage of a wizard guild. Your skills bolster the frontlines and the supply lines. Every skill multiplies the others, and it all keeps running while you're away.

games.name: BDSM Sex: Futanari 2
games.summary: An adult visual novel about a young woman who returns to her Mistress’s dungeon seeking more pleasure and pain, only to realize her craving for submission is far deeper and more dangerous than she expected.

games.name: Backrooms: Multiverse
games.summary: Backrooms Multiverse is a cooperative survival horror exploration game where you play as a team of researchers venturing deep into the endless Backrooms multiverse. Explore rare and mysterious environments, and encounter unique entities that few explorers have ever lived to see.

games.name: Bacterium
games.summary: Design organisms. Evolve brains. Survive the dish.

games.name: Car Simulator: Driving School
games.summary: Feel the engine. Hear the world. Every road becomes a story — and you’re the one behind the wheel.

games.name: Chunithm Mate
games.summary: Chunithm Mate is a rhythm arcade game focused on hitting notes in time with the music. Players interact through fast, continuous note patterns that test timing, accuracy, and reaction as songs increase in complexity.

games.name: Common Sense National Championship
games.summary:
8 categories. 50 questions. Where does your common sense end?
Animals, space, history, sports, food — can you name them all?

games.name: Console Archives: T.R.A.G. - Tactical Rescue Assault Group: Mission of Mercy
games.summary:
T.R.A.G.: Tactical Rescue Assault Group - Mission of Mercy" was released by SUNSOFT in 1998 for a 32-bit home console.
This action game puts you in the role of a special commando unit member, tasked with rescuing scientists held captive in the Togusa Building, which has been occupied by an armed group.
Your only resources are your own physical strength and honed skills.

games.name: Crayon Jungle
games.summary: Color adorable animal friends in a lush jungle with your own colors!

games.name: Curious Paws: Hidden Objects
games.summary: Curious Paws: Hidden Objects is a short, cozy hidden object game where you explore vibrant, hand-drawn locations through the eyes of a curious cat. Search for objects that could catch his attention, and enjoy a lively environment, relaxing music, and an atmosphere of slow-paced exploration.

games.name: Darkstone Bay
games.summary: A first-person escape room puzzle adventure. Explore a mysterious island and search for a legendary shipwreck hidden for over 300 years.

games.name: Dispatch
games.summary: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

games.name: Dress the Part! Outfit Puzzle
games.summary: Slide the panels and complete the outfit! A cute fashion puzzle that tests your eye Easy to play in short sessions!

games.name: EA Sports College Football 27
games.summary: In EA SPORTS College Football 27, step into the modern era of college football, where personal ambition meets program pride. Balance expectations, identity, and everything Saturday demands while immersed in the iconic traditions and pageantry of game day.

games.name: Everglen
games.summary: Build your dream farm in a cozy pixel RPG. Grow crops, fish, mine, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Meet quirky NPCs, craft and trade items, and uncover magical surprises at your own pace. Relax, explore, and create your story in this farming adventure.

games.name: Fearbound
games.summary: Enter a nightmarish world where fear is always watching. Explore dark environments, solve disturbing mysteries, and survive terrifying encounters.

games.name: Full Colour Tiles
games.summary: Fiendishly simple puzzle game

games.name: Fuu
games.summary: A reflex-testing 2D Platformer Runner set in a dark, gothic universe. Utilize core mechanics like double jump, wall jump, and precise dash/slide to overcome deadly obstacles and logic-based trigger puzzles. A demanding challenge awaits players who crave speed and adventure.

games.name: Gauge Guessr
games.summary: A guessing game where you need to guess which is the thicker string size.

games.name: Hauntmates
games.summary: Co-op horror investigation game across multiple maps. Enter procedurally generated environments, use your equipment to gather clues, and identify the entity. Watch your back, because monsters are hunting you down.

games.name: Heavy Machinery vs. Shumai
games.summary: Please use the heavy machinery to remove the green peas from the top of the shumai.

games.name: Hollow Ground
games.summary: Play as four mercenaries as they descend into the Epsilon9 bunker. Navigate 60+ handcrafted labyrinthine levels, purchase upgrades, and destroy chaos manifest: The Machine. The blend of old-school arcade action and true focus on tactics sets this game apart from an ordinary shooter.

games.name: Home Designer: Home Sweet Home
games.summary: Help Hazel redesign client homes in this fun Hidden Objects game, "Home Designer: Home Sweet Home".

games.name: Home Designer: Living Room
games.summary: In this classic hidden object game, Hazel wants to help her aunt with home refurbishment. Sell off the old stuff and renovate the empty living room with real world furniture and design the room of your dreams!

games.name: Hyperwired
games.summary: Pilot a ship with a charger hanging. Explore an ever-changing space an plug to recharge your energy while surviving the enemy breach in this cable-like space shooter with roguelike elements and plugged resource management.

games.name: Independence Day: Festive Finds
games.summary: Independence Day Festive Finds is a patriotic spot the difference game that transforms lively 4th of July celebrations into a fun and satisfying test of observation.

games.name: Kitty Witchy
games.summary: A little lost witch, a magical cat, and a world full of secrets. Kitty Witchy is a 3D narrative puzzle adventure game. Join the witch and solve puzzles with the help of her cat, uncover the secrets of this universe, and find the way back home.

games.name: Kuroba: Oghuz
games.summary: Kuroba is a historical RTS set in the brutal frontier of 13th-century Anatolia. Build settlements, manage logistics, and command armies in grounded, realistic combat. No magic, no heroes—only economy, strategy, and leadership determine who endures.

games.name: Little Immortal Cultivator
games.summary: This is a roguelike deck-building game set in a world of cultivation. Choose core paths like Sword, Spell, or Demon, and mix in support styles like Alchemy, Blacksmith, or Merchant to create unique decks.There is also a built-in editor to facilitate you to develop or share your own games!

games.name: Little Number Daycare: Learn, Count, Say, Play for Toddlers
games.summary: A cheerful learning game for preschoolers with numbers 1 to 10. Count, pop balloons, play memory, solve farm puzzles and hear spoken numbers in 14 languages.

games.name: Lofi Witch Hatch
games.summary: A relaxing idle collection game with beautiful girls (supports offline). You are an egg keeper helping the girls hatch monster eggs. 200 monster eggs + soothing lo-fi music♪

games.name: Lunyatic Invaders
games.summary: What is that... a cat!? A mysterious enemy has invaded from outer space. Break through a storm of bullets in your super fighter in this unique full-scale shooting game.

games.name: Mermaid Catch: Transform Sirens into Anime Boys
games.summary:
Catch sirens. Transform them. Date them.
The ocean has no rules anymore.

games.name: Mermaid Catch: Transform Sirens into Anime Girls
Mihashira
games.summary: A 2D top-down arena shooter. A freely scrolling shooter. Pixel graphics reminiscent of the SNES. Easy to control with the directional pad, two shot buttons, and a bomb button. Make full use of your two shots to smash through enemies.

games.name: Money Factory Tycoon
games.summary: Build, upgrade, and expand your own money-making factory.

games.name: Monster Ops 20
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: Noodlebound
games.summary: Slice, Dash, and Recover the Lost Flavour

games.name: Once You Understand the Meaning These Comics Become Scary
games.summary: Read the comic carefully. Find the hidden clue. Then the fear begins.

games.name: Padel Pro World Tour
games.summary: Feel the true padel fever in your hands with Padel Pro World Tour! Step onto the court, master the walls, and compete on the world tour.

games.name: Punk Racer
games.summary: Boost, drift, and slipstream through six neon-soaked tracks in this free low-poly anti-grav pod racer. Race a full pack of 8 — solo against AI drones, or online with cross-platform multiplayer between Steam, web, and iOS. Kit out your pod, chase fastest laps, earn GCRED.

games.name: Relapse
games.summary: A beginner friendly sheet music rhythm game, with cute characters and a shady organization!

games.name: Relax & Learn World Heritage
games.summary:
Learn World Heritage Through Fun Quizzes!
Discover fascinating facts you’ll want to share tomorrow

games.name: Reposition Defense
games.summary: A tactical Tower Defense with the ability to reposition your troops! Deploy your available warriors to hold back the forces of darkness engulfing the kingdom.

games.name: Rhythm Heaven Groove
games.summary: The rhythm is starting up again! Rhythm Heaven Groove comes to Nintendo Switch!

games.name: Slot & Learn Hangul
games.summary:
Master Tricky Batchim with Ease!
Learn Hangul Through Fun Puzzle Games

games.name: Sorcerer's Refuge
games.summary: Uncover forbidden secrets and escape the Sorcerer's realm.

games.name: Souvenirs
games.summary: Explore a house in search of Leonardo's memories. Souvenirs is a merge like strategy game, created by a tiny independent French studio.

games.name: Stardust Rain
games.summary: Enter the world of the year 2431!

games.name: Tanky Tanks: Reloaded
games.summary: Tanky Tanks - Reloaded is an intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

games.name: The Boys Escape
games.summary: Gather and lead your army to the finish line! Face your enemies and win the battle!

games.name: The Dreamers Foresight
games.summary: Embark on a dreamlike journey as a ninja in this roguelite adventure, shaping your world with randomized biome tiles, align similar Tiles for better loot. Build a powerful deck from a variety set of cards while balancing your energy to battle relentless nightmare creatures.

games.name: The One Who Runs Away Is Chased
games.summary:
The One Who Runs Away Is Chased

Simple. Cute. Addictively fun!

Take control of your adorable little yellow hero as you run and jump through endless procedurally generated levels. Time your jumps perfectly, avoid falling, and aim for the highest score possible!

Easy to learn but challenging to master, Kaçan Kovalanır is a fast-paced 2D platformer that's perfect for quick play sessions or chasing your personal best.

games.name: The Trials: Chapter Two
games.summary: A classic 90s choose your own adventure style horror visual novel. Escape the horrors hunting you, make decisions, forge your own path. An original complete story with multiple endings. Choose your own play style with a Text Adventure Mode, sound effects, and an ambient soundtrack.

games.name: There Is No Lore
games.summary: Collect Cards, build Decks, alter with Trinkets, discover Synergies, win Locations, beat Bosses. All this and more await you in this roguelite deckbuilding auto-battler, but please remember - There Is No Lore, stop looking.

games.name: Thunder Trucks: Heavy Racers
games.summary: Race powerful semi trucks in high-speed competitions. Upgrade performance, master control, and dominate intense tracks to become the ultimate heavy racer.

games.name: Timber!
games.summary: Dementia, tragedy and fun - all in the same taste of a potato! Timber! is a 2D point-and-click storydriven game that takes you on an emotional journey. Explore a mix of feelings, from the heart-wrenching struggles of dementia to the unraveling of a tragic story.

games.name: Today, I'll Be The Hero
games.summary:
You're the hero, and you're going to save the princess with your merry little crew.

This is what you wanted.

What else is there to say?

games.name: Turscar Isle
games.summary: Infiltrate the base of a cult of spammers in this Thief-style stealth extraction game! Exact poetic justice on them by stealing everything they haven't nailed down, then go back and steal the nails.

games.name: Undergrounded
games.summary: “Undergrounded” is a puzzle adventure where you explore a dungeon formed by the accumulation of American history. Become Scott, who wandered underground in search of his lost engagement ring after failing to propose to his girlfriend, and plumb the depths of the past itself with your buddy Canary!

games.name: When Will I Get Home?
games.summary: Indie anomaly-detection game set in a bleak Eastern-European stairwell. 11 floors, 40+ anomalies, minimal horror, maximal tension.

games.name: Yuru-Eto Card Battle
games.summary: A roguelike card game themed around the world of the Chinese zodiac Simple rules and controls make it enjoyable for everyone

games.name: 100 Summer Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all? ️

games.name: Aooni
games.summary: Challenge yourself while being chased by fear! A horror puzzle action adventure! The legendary horror game "Ao Oni" has evolved and come back to life!

games.name: Battle For Embolia
games.summary: Battle For Embolia is a fast-paced indie MMORPG with responsive combat, meaningful progression, and constant updates. Explore a growing world, face challenging bosses, and help shape the game’s development through community feedback. Free to play with no pay-to-win.

games.name: Brazzante
games.summary: Featuring a unique doodle aesthetic, this world is entirely hand-drawn. Your goal? Use classic 'Rock, Paper, Scissors' mechanics to survive never-ending rounds.

games.name: Cicadia
games.summary: A indie first person shooter roguelike featuring class based items, stats, and resource management mechanics around Bile.

games.name: Damn Zombies
games.summary: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus

games.name: Draw of Destiny
games.summary: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where cards evolve as you play. Build lethal synergies, adapt your deck before every battle, and fight through a demon-ravaged world of brutal tactical choices.

games.name: Fascist
games.summary: As National Guard, stand defiant against relentless hordes. Unleash righteous fury. Old Glory waves eternal and America endures because YOU fight!

games.name: Fleck & Grus
games.summary: Help Grus escort his friend Fleck safely back to his hometown in this fast-paced precision platformer. Navigate tight levels packed with tricky jumps, bouncing mechanics, and deadly hazards. Stay sharp, react quickly, and master each challenge to survive the journey.

games.name: Frick It
games.summary: Chill looking, co-op horror game about the world is ending, a giant magnetic storm is after us. As conscious robots, collect fuel with our scrap vehicle, dig crytals, fight monsters and try to survive on the endless road and learn the story from other failed robots.

games.name: Funny Folks Cafe
games.summary: Serve Up Smiles

games.name: Grid Realm
games.summary: A lightweight city-building game with LowPoly style. No complex management or resource systems here—just pure and simple building. Choose your favorite buildings and create your ideal city according to your preferences.

games.name: Hold My Hand (Or Let Go)
games.summary: A free Visual Novel about unrequited love, envy, friendship and forgiveness. Experience the story of Charlie, a completely normal Swedish college student that’s graduating next week. But before he does that, he has to say goodbye to all the friends that he made during his three years in town.

games.name: Hyakka Ryoran Master Samurai Chronicles
games.summary: Turn-based idle role-playing browser game adaptation of the Hyakka Ryoran Samurai Girls light novel series by Akira Suzuki. Players take the role of Yagyu Muneakira, a Buou Gakuen Juku student who possesses the ability to awaken Master Samurai powers in others, and lead a party of Master Samurai based on historical figures such as Yagyu Jubei, Sanada Yukimura, Tokugawa Sen, and Date Masamune. The game features a five-member auto-battle party with tap-based Spirit intervention from Muneakira. Materials collected in idle combat feed into a Katana equipment system and cosmetic Skin loadouts. Operated by CTW, Inc. on the G123 platform since July 3, 2026.

games.name: IDLE: Intergalactic Defense League Exterminators
games.summary: An incremental game about blasting bugs, collecting guts, upgrading a base, and blasting more bugs!

games.name: Ian's Rocket
games.summary: A history-based, strategy, open-world game in which a nation's economy is built from scratch by utilizing all available resources. Create cities and wonders, hire labor, sell crafted products, and build armies. Meet historical figures who will either fight to stop your efforts or trade with you.

games.name: Ice Cream Man
games.summary: ICE CREAM MAN is a first person PSX-style horror game. After a late-night gaming session, your walk home turns into a nightmare. Navigate unfamiliar backyards, jump fences and hide in the shadows to escape a murderous Ice Cream Man. Can you make it home alive? Or do you have a rocky road ahead?

games.name: Idle Regenerator
games.summary: Idle RPG with 99+ powers, deep equipment forging, sidekick roster, dungeons, constellations, prestige resets, and offline progress. No energy timers. No pay-to-win. Just depth.

games.name: Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington
games.summary:
Learn all about George Washington in this visual novel biography containing rare photos from inside the Washington Monument, Washington's home at Mount Vernon, Yorktown where he achieved final victory in the Revolutionary War, and much more. Soldier, General, Spymaster, and President - this is George Washington!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in Washington’s home state of Virginia

games.name: Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson
games.summary:
Learn all about Thomas Jefferson in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of the room where the Declaration of Independence was signed, Jefferson’s Monticello home, the National Archives where the Declaration is kept, and much more. Writer, Diplomat, President - this is Thomas Jefferson!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in Jefferson’s home state of Virginia

games.name: In Fair Spirits
games.summary: A sweet slice of life boys love / yaoi visual novel set in the English countryside about a couple of young men who bond over mutual bereavement. Also, one of the main characters is over 1000 years old.

games.name: Journey To Paradise
games.summary:
Samson Breez signs up for the journey to transport souls to Paradise for the benefits gained upon completion. This game follows his adventure to fulfilling his contract for Grando-Corp.
Gameplay best described as: "First person mini golf".

games.name: Keepy Up
games.summary: Push yourself ever higher in this challenging reimagining of a classic childhood game. Guide your balloon through a vertical gauntlet of seagulls, ghosts, UFOs and more! Your balloon is your only friend, and gravity is your greatest foe. Are you skilful enough to Keepy UP?

games.name: Laballatory
games.summary: A casual, incremental physics sandbox game where you operate a Newton's Cradle to earn high (possibly game breaking) scores to fund your escape from an experimental lab. Hit balls, earn money, upgrade your strategy, and unlock machines to help you escape.

games.name: Livora
games.summary: Livora is a browser-based life simulation strategy game about trying to build a stable life under modern pressure. Players choose a starting life and manage money, rent, bills, work, health, energy, relationships, family obligations, and long-term consequences. Every choice has a cost, and not every cost is money.

games.name: Master Healer Kale With Useless Party
games.summary: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

games.name: Merlin Survivors
games.summary: Camelot is under threat! Merlin Survivors is a game where rogue-like action meets fast-paced survival challenges. Take control of legendary characters like Merlin, Arthur, Lancelot, and Morgana, and fight against relentless waves of enemies. Master each character.

games.name: Ninety Nine Dungeons
games.summary: Japanese-style action RPG dungeon crawler adventure. Explore a top-down map enhanced with full verticality and multi-level dimensions. Discover rare equipment, customize your own unique build and playstyle, and conquer the ever-changing depths!

games.name: Parking Simulator: Retro Car Driving
games.summary: Tight spaces. Sharp skills!

games.name: Re:Metamorphosis Candina
games.summary: All girls can transform with candy. A short branching visual novel about a mysterious candy shop and the girls who go there. What candy will you choose?

games.name: Sakura Succubus 9
games.summary: In the ninth part of the Sakura Succubus series, Hiroki returns to Astoria with Ayu as she prepares for the concert of a lifetime: a joint show with her fellow idol Mihama Shizuru. Will this concert end in success, and will Hiroki's harem get even bigger?

games.name: Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
games.summary: Mystery of Silence is a point-and-click adventure where William, a young writer in search of inspiration, enters an abbey shrouded in silence. What William finds within those walls is not just a story to tell, but a secret that should never be discovered.

games.name: Seishin
games.summary: The Deadly Ritual

games.name: Sending my Pet Rock To Heaven!
games.summary:
Sending my Pet Rock to Heaven is a high skill ceiling platformer that is purposely meant to frustrate you. Your goal is to bounce your way all the way up to find out if Heaven is real or not.

Along the way, you must skip over puddles to refresh your bounces or else your pet rock will not make it to heaven.

games.name: The Cinder War
games.summary:
The Cinder War is a space dice RPG about one salvaged corvette caught between three powers: the lawful Meridian Concord, the raiding Ash Corsairs, and the smugglers of the Free Drift. Combat is turn-based d6 rolling where every action shows its live success chance before committing, and six ship systems shape what the dice can do between upgrades.

Four classes, the Ash Corsair, Pirate Hunter, Free Trader, and Political Envoy, each carry their own storyline through a branching campaign with four endings, followed by an endless mode that asks how far one ship can get.

games.name: The Hollow Road: Prologue
games.summary: A psychological horror prologue where a strange house, a silent church, and something lurking in the dark pull you into a waking nightmare. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive what waits beyond the last door.

games.name: The Laws of Probability
games.summary: You have exactly 5. Bread is 4, the bus fare to school is 3. What do you give up? In this short narrative experience, you play as 13-year-old Adam. Confront an interface that reacts to a painful reality, and discover that freedom of choice is sometimes nothing but a privilege.

games.name: The Legend of Fireball
games.summary: Unleash your fireball power and destroy your way to legendary mastery!

games.name: The Mine Room
games.summary: A first person twist on the classic game of Minesweeper. It's dark, all you have is a torch and a burning desire to flag all those pesky mines without falling in the goo or getting blown up.

games.name: Under Tower Idle
games.summary: Build, expand, and automate your island empire in this 3D idle clicker adventure. Gather resources, train units, and conquer dangerous dungeons.

games.name: Virballs
games.summary: Six outlandish planets are overrun with Virballs - viral elemental creatures that consume each other to create exotic hybrids. Clean up this ecological disaster using Virball hybrids as devastating weapons!

games.name: A Good Place To Die
games.summary: Kill as many zombies as possible, collect points by hitting them, upgrade your weapons and reach the final boss!

games.name: Choose Your Paul!
games.summary: Build bizarre Pauls. Break the run. Choose Your Paul is a strategic roguelite auto battler where you choose a unique Trainer, capture strange creatures called Pauls, craft powerful synergies through positioning and upgrades, and push through branching routes filled with battles, elites, shops, events, and bosses.

games.name: Corrupt.exe
games.summary: Corrupt.exe is a neon roguelite where you play the malware. Swarm-survival action with evolving weapons, a 225-combo fusion system, and an adaptive antivirus that profiles your movement, learns your habits, and hunts you smarter every run. Infect. Evolve. Extract — or go endless.

games.name: Drump Simulator
games.summary: A satirical game where you make choices as the American President Tonald Drump.

games.name: Fantasy World Simulator
games.summary: Open a Pixie shop and dive into an adventure with whimsical creatures. Tame, train, and evolve Pixie characters, then explore the vibrant city with them. Manage your shop, serve customers, and grow your business. Join now and create your own Pixie legend!

games.name: Focus
games.summary: Surveillance footage is slowly being rewritten. A point-and-click observation horror game where you find what changed and report it.

games.name: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades
games.summary: Do you like hot dogs? How about horseshoes? Hand grenades? (everyone likes hand grenades) Anyway, we got all that, and guns. So if you like cooking, lawn games, and ordnance, this is the VR sandbox game for you.

games.name: Idle Offworld Foundry
games.summary:
Idle Offworld Foundry is an idle factory game welded to a puzzle collection, set on a Moon being turned into a colony by lowest-bid machines that break constantly, and fixing them is the game. When a machine faults, a bite-sized puzzle opens: circuits, ciphers, match-3, pipe-routing, logic grids, or nonograms, plus a late-game mode where faults gang up and the player must deduce which machine is responsible.

The supply chain spans seven stages from launch pad to a self-sustaining colony, ending when the colony builds and launches its own rocket from ground the player dug, refined, and fabricated.

games.name: Rhythm Heaven Groove: Memory Match-Up
games.summary: A promotional memory match webgame for Rhythm Heaven Groove, available on the Play Nintendo website. You have to match up cards that feature characters from the titular game to form pairs. You can choose to either match 4 pairs, 6 pairs, or 12 pairs.

games.name: Rooster: Princess Rescue
games.summary: The rooster wants to rescue Princess Hen... but countless challenges stand in his way.

games.name: Tabletop Foosball
games.summary: Kick. Score. Win.

games.name: The Incident
games.summary: The Incident is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a closed circus, destroy evidence before investigators arrive, and avoid someone still inside watching your every move.

games.name: The Tolerance Group
games.summary: You are an operator of The Tolerance Group, monitoring surveillance cameras in various locations, where reality has begun to break its tolerance. Identify these continuity failures and promptly report them before the world is overwhelmed by horror.

games.name: Voidrel
games.summary: Voidrel is a free real-time strategy game that runs entirely in the web browser, with no download or installation. Players choose one of six distinct species — each with its own units and playstyle — then gather resources, build a base, research technology, and command armies to defeat their opponents. It features casual matches, a ranked ladder across 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 modes, Classic RTS mechanics — base-building, fog of war, a minimap, and unit control — in an instantly accessible browser package.

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in New York
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in New York in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

games.name: FishPond
games.summary:
FishPond is a pond-building sim where biology actually compounds.

Stock species into a living food web. Manage oxygen, predation, and diversity to keep things alive—then start pushing the system. Breed lineages across 12 inheritable traits. Unlock genetic tools. Automate harvesting. Expand your world.

Every fish has AI-driven behavior, a real genome, and a place in the food chain. Every population shift changes the music in real time. Every upgrade makes the whole thing run a little more like a machine—until you realize the machine is alive.

games.name: Pictures at an Exhibition
games.summary: Aozora Haru, a troubled, recently orphaned art student, finds it hard to attach much meaning to many of the things in his life. Through the meaningful bonds he has created with the people close to him, however, he begins to understand that life is much more important than it initially seems.

games.name: Schizophrenia: The Last Shift
games.summary: Remembering the past while corruption occurs, you are set out to finish the remainder of your shift until you cannot anymore. Stock the shelves using your forklift and be a productive member of society while evading the inner demons within you in this horror survival to meet quota.

games.name: The Pawn Broker
games.summary: The Pawn Broker is an atmospheric horror economic survival game. Run a cursed pawnshop, analyze every item that comes through for signs of theft or dark curses, and make high-stakes decisions to stay profitable before your five days are up.

games.name: Where Is Mommy
games.summary: A retro horror game about spotting anomalies in looping environments and surviving the cycle.

games.name: Winds of Arcana: Ruination
games.summary: Winds of Arcana: Ruination is a 2.5D Metroidvania featuring a customizable combat system set in the treacherous and magical world of Lirna. Experience a powerful, lore-rich story as you discover ancient magic, upgrade your abilities, and battle dangerous foes that stand in your way.

games.name: Bibao
games.summary: Bibao (逼寶) is a browser-based, real-time multiplayer pixel-art ARPG. Dive into endless dungeon rifts, reforge and enhance god-tier gear across eight equipment slots, and customize your build with a deep engraving system. Team up to take down server-wide World Bosses, battle rival guilds in Guild PvP, and climb the ranked arena ladder. Log in with Twitch and play instantly in your browser or on mobile with touch controls.

games.name: Bitvoxel
games.summary: BitVoxel is a 3D voxel sandbox and logic simulation game focused on building digital circuits. Players can create systems using switches, wires, logic gates, LEDs, memory blocks, and programmable components. Construction tools such as copy, paste, rotate, move, and reusable saved components supports large projects, ranging from simple circuits to custom processors.

games.name: By My Side
games.summary: Survive the wild with a loyal dog at your side. Wash up with nothing, tame a stray and raise it as your companion — build and power a home, outlast brutal winters, and face a world that fights back.

games.name: Cosmodrill
games.summary: Explore the vastness of space, dig deep into planets to find resources, upgrade your ship and survive against alien life in this 2D open-universe space mining adventure! How far are you willing to travel into the dark unknown?

games.name: Desolation Seed
games.summary: Society is a decay system you are imprisoned as the reveled flesh that feeds the cybernetic wire, through a cryptic email chain Oceancide Systematics a mysterious corporation pays you to perform seemingly random acts of debasement against society on their behalf. they seethe within the darkened vomitoriums of computational networks. do these debased acts of destruction hold any meaning? can you break from out the hollow shell of pleasure systems? how far will they push you? how far will you go? Nothing can prepare you for the apex of human understanding.

games.name: Esports Manager 2026
games.summary: Build and lead your own professional esports organization. Scout players, manage contracts, develop talent, hire staff, grow your brand, and compete for championship titles in a deep and realistic management simulation.

games.name: Herb's Homegrown Havoc
games.summary: Herb's Homegrown Havoc is a simple but chaotic arcade roguelike. Pluck plants out of the ground before they rot and summon hostile creatures! Upgrade after each round to increase Herb's strength and skills in various ways.

games.name: I'm Making a Monster
games.summary: Piece by piece, you pour your soul into the monster. This is your burden and you bear it willingly. Your friends think that this is unhealthy.

games.name: Idle Aqua Driller
games.summary: Dive into the depths of the ocean in this incremental game about underwater mining! Control drilling rigs, hire divers and submarines, and unlock new layers and resources. Upgrade your decks, speed up mining, and develop your skill tree to turn your station into a powerful underwater complex.

games.name: Landlord Simulator
games.summary:
Inheriting a single property and a harsh reality check, you must build a real estate empire from the ground up. Before acquiring your next building, survive the relentless early game by taking on side gigs, completing local quests, and trading stocks, crypto, or metals to accumulate capital. Once you establish a stable financial foundation, expand into a dynamic market where every property presents unique risks, maintenance challenges, and tenant dynamics.

Manage complex tenant relationships through background checks, navigate severe emergencies like drug labs or legal battles, and adapt to shifting market crises and global events. Balance passive income with active management, upgrade your properties to attract high-tier renters, and maintain a solid reputation. From fixing clogged pipes to mastering cashflow management, your decisions determine whether you become a renowned property tycoon or lose everything to bankruptcy.

games.name: Liftoff Inc.
games.summary:
Liftoff Inc. is a comedic idle tycoon about a backyard rocket startup with one folding chair and a five-year plan that just says Mars, written in crayon. Rockets are built piece by piece and physically grow on the pad; payload capacity follows simplified real rocketry, from engine thrust and specific impulse to tank mass, fairing size, and delta-v margin, and failed launches cost nothing but produce fireworks.

The launch complex grows to three simultaneous pads and a factory row, missions climb a destination ladder from sounding flights to an exo frontier, and a spin-off prestige system converts each company into permanent legacy shares, mission patches, and research certifications.

games.name: Misty Forest: The Parkour Game
games.summary: Step into a breathtaking forest where every jump brings you closer to the summit. Climb through a massive parkour course suspended above rivers, ancient cabins, towering pine trees, and mysterious wilderness. Precision, timing, and determination are the only things standing between you and the top.

games.name: Monster Smoosh
games.summary: Drop monsters into a jar and smoosh the matching ones together to climb an 11-creature ladder — from humble fuzzball to derpy elder god. A physics-chaos merge game where combos run big, cows are currency, and death is a feature, not a fail-state. Easy to start. Gloriously hard to put down.

games.name: New York Mysteries: Secrets of the Mafia
games.summary: A captivating detective adventure with elements of mysticism, telling a story of kidnapped children and mafia bosses.

games.name: Pogo Panic
games.summary: Pogo Panic is a difficult, Parkour Adventure. Bounce on a pogo stick, ignite a fleeting jetpack, and vault through space. One slip-jump takes you back to the start—no checkpoints. Fail, rebound, and master the sky one desperate hop at a time.

games.name: Runeboard
games.summary: RuneBoard is a browser-based adventure inspired by the exploration, progression, skills, combat, and community spirit of classic MMORPGs.

games.name: SCP: Short Story
games.summary: SCP: Short Story is a first-person shooter set in a world where the K-class scenario destroyed almost every living form. You’ll have to get through this dead world, retrieve essential documents from Site-17, and most importantly - do not get killed by what survived.

games.name: Simulation 9
games.summary:
Simulation 9 is a psychological anomaly game with unexpected twists.
The rules are simple: if you find an anomaly, turn back. If you don't, keep moving forward.
Or is it?
Uncover the truth behind the simulation, descend into its depths, find a way out, and survive.

games.name: SlideGrid
games.summary: SlideGrid is a modern sliding puzzle game that blends classic gameplay with rewarding progression and customization. Solve beautifully crafted image puzzles across 4×4, 6×6, and 8×8 difficulty modes, earn coins for every completed puzzle, and spend them strategically to lock correctly placed pieces for extra assistance. Browse a gallery of built-in images, upload your own photos to create custom puzzles, unlock completion badges, and enjoy a clean interface with light, dark, and ambient color themes. Whether you're looking for a relaxing brain teaser or a more challenging puzzle experience, SlideGrid offers smooth gameplay, persistent progress, and endless replayability.

games.name: Sor.Op: Dark Shades
games.summary: SOR.OP: Dark Shades is a realistic first-person shooter from SNRC Studios with beautiful graphics, precise controls, and over 40 maps. Play in 7 modes, including Team Deathmatch, Free For All, Domination, and Zombie Mode. Tactics, skill, and teamwork are the key to victory.

games.name: Sunken Dragon
games.summary: This is a retro 8-bit pixel-style RPG. The game features turn-based combat, inviting players to explore the unknown in a fantastical world.

games.name: The Last Tale Told: Spam
games.summary: You live alone. Work from home. You haven't been out for days, trapped by endless rain. Every day your phone rings, it's an unknown number. “Suspected Scam” is what you read on the screen. You think it's just spam.

games.name: Toilet: Urinal Game
games.summary:
A turn-based strategy board game set in a men's restroom.
The unwritten urinal rule — don't stand next to anyone — is now a game of pure strategy.

games.name: Touhou: Kira's Fangame Collection
games.summary: A collection of 6 in 1 free to play fangames based on the Touhou Project! Play as Reimu and other iconic characters in these couch co-op adventures that include genres such as platforming, metroidvania, tower defense and 3D stealth!

games.name: Velato
games.summary: Velato is a poker-bluff roguelike deckbuilder where players build a joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

games.name: Vultures
games.summary: Vultures is a manufacturing simulation game with a capitalist twist. Build an industrial empire, play the stock market for quick loot, and flood an ever-changing economy with cheap junk to buy, bribe, or bankrupt your way to the highest perch.

games.name: XeGrader Plus
games.summary: A fantasy shooter where exploration and puzzles are keys to victory. In a world of meticulous pixel art, uncover secrets hidden in every stage. Collect powerful upgrades, defeat fantasy monsters with precise shooting, and forge the world’s fate!

games.name: 50 Years Classic
games.summary: 50 Years Classic is a minimalist turn-based strategy game where you can choose from a variety of nations, each with its own unique feature. The game offers fast, engaging gameplay with high replayability. This is a free version of the game "50 years".

games.name: Above the Sun
games.summary: Yugemaru, a self-proclaimed gal mechanic, sets out to reach the top of the Acid Tower using the power of steam. With the eerie acid closing in, climb the randomly generated platforms — climb, climb, CLIMB! ...Wait — did I just fall? LOL.

games.name: BladeRite: Rivals
games.summary: BladeRite: Rivals is a fantasy-style melee battle royale mobile game. 20 contenders enter the arena and only one walks out alive. Choose from a diverse roster of heroes and dive into fast-paced melee combat where cold steel decides your fate. Unleash your ultimate skills, dominate the battlefield, and prove you have what it takes to be the last one standing!

games.name: Brainrot Card Market Simulator
games.summary: Can you become the king of card trading?

games.name: Cursed Cargo
games.summary: Cursed Cargo is an online co-op comedy-horror where the environment is as dangerous as the monsters. Team up with up to 4 players to transport unpredictable cargo using physics-based tools. Use proximity voice chat to coordinate, but be careful—the entities are always listening.

games.name: Demon Siege
games.summary: A retro-inspired boomer shooter where every powerup stacks infinitely. Become an unstoppable demon-slaying powerhouse with insane speed, massive jumps, multi-bullet weapons, and game-breaking builds.

games.name: Destiny of Immortal
games.summary: Fate of Creation "is a meat pigeon, cultivation of immortals, and storyline game. You accidentally obtained one of the most precious treasures of creation and embarked on the path of cultivating immortals.

games.name: Disjoined
games.summary: Disjoined is an indie RPG that takes place after every other adventure has been completed, in the Infinite Mall at the End of Time. Explore, battle, and join the hilarious cast of misfits trying to restore temporal balance to the universe.

games.name: Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations
games.summary:
HELL FREEZES OVER in DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations, an all-new campaign expansion that unleashes a brutal new chapter of the Slayer’s saga.

Wounded and betrayed, the Slayer is thrust into a merciless purgatory only escapable by confronting haunting truths and forging new strength with the help of a mysterious ally. He must ascend from the prison of his mind and fight an abomination of the gods to set his followers on the path to freedom.

games.name: Down the Stairs: The Game
games.summary: Down The Stairs: The Game is a physics-based ragdoll challenge where every clean stair run, brutal fall, shaft setup, and ghost race pushes you toward a better score. Stay in control, hit the beams, beat other players ghosts, and master the descent.

games.name: Drunk Dad Vs Family
games.summary: A chaotic 4v1 multiplayer game where a family must put their drunk father to sleep before he loses control.

games.name: EmergencyCrank
games.summary:
EmergencyCrank is the first Playdate idle game for lifesavers! Start with a tiny rescue station and crank your way up to a regional emergency campus.

Turn the Playdate crank to earn cash, hire staff, buy upgrades, and unlock ambulances, rescue drones, doctors, and helicopters. Dispatch calls bring quick minigames involving timing, memory, D-pad inputs, first-aid questions, crank control, and motion-controlled helicopter landings.

Your station keeps earning between missions, while the dispatch ticker delivers real, unusual, and funny callouts inspired by the developer's time as a volunteer paramedic in Austria. Return each day to choose a free reinforcement for your crew.

Complete the station to unlock New Game+, choose a Prestige Focus, research permanent Command Academy bonuses, collect cosmetics, and chase achievements across multiple runs.

As you can see, there's plenty to do, lifesaver.

games.name: Enigmo
games.summary: Award-winning physics puzzle game now in spatial format! Get your brain in gear!

games.name: Fugaz
games.summary: With only a flute at your disposal, play songs to solve puzzles. Explore a dark place looking for an exit before the darkness grows too dense. In this immersive psychological horror game, knowledge is the key to put the pieces together.

games.name: Gorotsuki Paradise
games.summary: Gorotsuki Paradise is an online PvP card game where you build your deck as you battle. Recruit over 150 unique "gorotsuki" (Japanese for gangsters, thugs, and outlaws) to dominate a mad city called Saitama. It’s completely free to play, with no pay-to-win mechanics!

games.name: Hearthstone: Escape from Violet Hold
games.summary: They say no one escapes the Violet Hold. A group of Azeroth’s most infamous criminals is about to put that to the test. To break out of Dalaran’s maximum-security prison, these Rulebreakers will need to Prepare for any circumstance, use clever Disguises, and, when all else fails, Bribe the guards. The alarms are blaring. Magical defenses are activating. Warden Maiev is locking down the prison. In other words, everything is going exactly to plan. It’s time to make a daring Escape from Violet Hold!

games.name: Hentai Succubus Puzzle
games.summary: A seductive adult puzzle game where each completed level reveals more of a mysterious succubus. Solve 100 image-based puzzles, unlock the gallery, and progress toward intimate rewards.

games.name: Hollow Sorrow
games.summary: Hollow Sorrow is a dark yet heartwarming 2D exploration adventure game where you confront your lost past.

games.name: Just Pool
games.summary: Just Pool is a minimalist 8-ball pool game. Score all your balls to win the match, play with friends or solo.

games.name: Last Breath
games.summary: Last Breath is a solo/cooperative terraforming survival game. Dig through terrain, build powerful machines, and restore life to a dead planet. Work together to survive, automate, and reshape the world from the ground up, literally.

games.name: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening
