games.summary: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening is a sci-fi idle progression game where you rebuild a shattered colony ship, restore lost systems, automate production, and uncover the mystery hidden within the Ark’s damaged memory.

games.name: Legends of Starkadia
games.summary: Legends of Starkadia is a quirky turn-based RPG full of action-packed adventure! The Starkadian Empire is under attack by one of their own and it’s up to a team of unlikely heroes to assist the resistance to restore peace by defeating Niko and his legion of interstellar armies.

games.name: Memo R.I.P.
games.summary: First‑person psychological horror card game with 900 dynamic scares, real‑time voice multiplayer, a final boss, and progression aboard a cursed spaceship.

games.name: Metal Slug Rush
games.summary:
Metal Slug Rush brings the legendary arcade chaos of Metal Slug into a brand-new survival experience — built for mobile, designed for relentless action.

Fight through endless waves of Rebel Army soldiers, fearsome Pirates, and alien Mars People. As the bullets fly and the explosions roar, collect experience to level up mid-run and shape your hero with powerful perks that bring a fresh experience every session.

Mix and match equipment to discover your favorite playstyle. Combine the best gear to create build synergies and survive missions beyond your imagination.

games.name: Moonlight Peaks
games.summary: Live the vampire life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks! Master the art of potions and spells, manage your supernatural farm, and leave your mark on the magical town. Make friends with the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids, and find your eternal love in the supernatural dating scene.

games.name: Naos-01: The Quiet Sector
games.summary: Trapped behind enemy lines as the Naos scientific-military base descends into chaos, Helios evades capture without reinforcements. Surrounded by hostile patrols, they must move silently through the shadows, infiltrate occupied zones, and send a distress signal before Naos falls completely.

games.name: Nerds Revenge
games.summary:
You Got A Problem?! is a chaotic multiplayer party game where players fight each other using physics-based combat and random objects.

Between rounds, players must answer quiz questions to gain advantages, creating a unique mix of skill, chaos, and knowledge.

The game also features Twitch integration, viewers can answer the same questions as the streamer in real time, allowing direct interaction and comparison of results.

Designed for both local and online multiplayer, every match delivers unpredictable, funny moments and constant competition between players and their audience.

games.name: Outworks
games.summary: Build a towering 3D fortress and hold the line. Stack floors, raise walls, and place turrets by altitude to survive escalating swarms of ground and flying machines closing on your core — then watch one collapsing tower take everything with it. A lean, neon, code-built base-defense roguelite.

games.name: Piano Trauma: Stress Deluxe
games.summary: A co-op game about driving a piano to play a concert.

games.name: Project: Ojisan
games.summary: This is a game about stacking middle-aged men. Play it when you want to clear your mind.

games.name: Puzzles: Space Cats
games.summary: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

games.name: Rage District: Humanity Armageddon
games.summary: A broken city where every decision shapes your survival

games.name: Silicon Scars
games.summary: Running. Gunning. Reading.

games.name: Sisyphus's Worst Day (Again)
games.summary: Build traps, manipulate the environment, and engineer the perfect loop to keep Sisyphus from ever reaching the summit in this comedic isometric 3D puzzle game.

games.name: Sponge Break
games.summary: Sponge Break is a physics-based co-op survival game in which one to four players control sponges attempting to escape down a treacherous river aboard a fragile raft, steering through rapids, environmental hazards, and hostile wildlife. It supports drop-in co-op and solo play, and features proximity voice chat with sponges that lip-sync to player speech. Players use a plunger that doubles as a grappling hook, throw loose objects, and store loot in a shared raft stash, while a physics system governs raft handling and damage. Progression is level-based across multiple biomes such as sewers, rivers, and abandoned facilities, with safehouses between levels for repairing, reviving, and restocking, alongside over 100 unlockable cosmetic options, emotes, controller support, and a range of side activities.

games.name: Stinky Cat
games.summary: Kidnapped in Cyber Space with a High-tech toilet plunger on his head, Stinky Cat needs your help! In this cozy puzzle game combining Sokoban with Bomberman, you must plan your moves to push crates, set off explosives to clear paths. Outsmart the evil Fox, and blast your way back to reality!

games.name: Super Toboggan 3D
games.summary: You are moving fast in a tunnel, a catchy music comes from somewhere and spiky obstacles begin to appear in front of you, what do you do? My advice: dodge them using the crank!

games.name: Swtchr
games.summary: A retro-styled 2D platformer game with speedrunning in mind.

games.name: Tiny Frontier
games.summary: Crash-land on a forgotten frontier. Build your shelter, power your machines, unlock new tiles, and ignite towering beacons as the storm closes in.

games.name: Your Price, Your Honor.
games.summary: “Your Price, Your Honor.” is a game where you control the choices of a judge who is getting close to retirement. You must manage the public’s tolerance for injustice… and your own wallet.

games.name: ZeroOut
games.summary: Complete puzzles by zeroing out the board! This is achieved by placing the pieces onto the board. Once the piece is placed, the numbers of the affiliated squares on the board will decrease based on the number of the piece. Pieces may need to be rotated or flipped.

games.name: 3DMurderMystery TheAshenYou
games.summary: "The Ashen you" is a 3D murder mystery for four players. Set in a French manor in the 18th century, a mysterious case of death by fire has occurred. Relive the suspects' memories, explore the manor to gather evidence, and work together to uncover the culprit through discussion.

games.name: Adios, Asteroids
games.summary:
Adios, Asteroids is a supercharged retro-modern homage to the classics that upends the experience with a bonus roulette system with each level.

You're a new Star Pilot recruit for the Earth Space Federation's (ESF) Adios, Asteroids Program. You have been tasked with clearing the Egam-Oter Asteroid Belt of asteroids and other anomalies by piloting a series of Class-A ESF drones supported by onboard clients of the HALICE hive computer.

The program features one or two player simultaneous expanded arcade action. With each level, the speed and your score multiplier increases, and you enter Bonus Time; a roulette system with thousands of combinations and over 50 unique gameplay perks and prizes. Over the course of a game you'll face strange enemies and bosses, save humans, blast a lot of asteroids, and hopefully score a lot of points. In additions to the core game experience you'll earn a slew of achievements, can visit "My Room" to customize your player card and view your rank and trophies, and sharpen your skills in the two player Practice Mode.

games.name: Bardo
games.summary: It's Liar's Dice, until the loser rewrites the rules. Bluff up to 6 players online or AI rogues with minds of their own, then survive chaotic Event rounds: hide your hand, reveal all, bet on one face. Cozy tavern, ruthless mind games.

games.name: Beghost
games.summary: BEGHOST is a narrative-heavy 2D action-adventure game set in the bowels of a haunted dungeon. Uncover the dungeon's darkest secrets with your ghost girl companion Bee, as you navigate your way through enemies, traps, and more, in a desperate attempt to escape!

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.summary: Buckshot Roulette is an indie tabletop horror game that reimagines Russian roulette using a pump-action shotgun instead of a revolver. The player faces off against a computer-controlled opponent called "The Dealer" across three rounds, with consumable items introduced in later rounds that add strategic depth. The game features a single-player campaign and a multiplayer mode for up to four players.

games.name: Buzzword
games.summary: BuzzWord is a live, chat-powered word game built for streamers and their communities. Each round, viewers race to guess a hidden 5-, 6-, or 7 letter word by typing answers in chat before the timer runs out. Across multiple rounds, correct guesses earn points, the leaderboard shifts in real time, and the final round raises the stakes for a fast, competitive, community-driven word challenge.

games.name: Caterpillar King
games.summary: Return the Caterpillar King's lost child for a life-changing reward! Ant pushes for change, Beetle clings to comfort, and their hungry Caterpillar keeps pulling them into trouble in this narrative-driven light tactics-puzzle game.

games.name: Centipede Swarm
games.summary: A four-player neon-drenched, bullet-hell roguelike where the swarm never stops!

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods
games.summary: Cross through a magical new gateway into the titular Honeyglow Woods, a land inspired by Winnie the Pooh, filled with puzzles, lost secrets, and a fair share of honey. Soon you'll reunite with Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, and Eeyore to return to the fun, carefree days of childhood!

games.name: Forest Lookout
games.summary: Forest Lookout is a first-person horror game where you navigate a lost person in a forest to safety. You can choose beetween options in dialogs to them. Listen to them, keep track of them, use your map and lead them out of the woods.

games.name: Magical Girl: Final Pink Star
games.summary: Jump Action Shooter. A magical girl who struggles with flying. Soar through the air while defeating enemies and avoiding their deadly tentacles. 6 Stages + Endless Mode

games.name: Make it! Shaved Ice
games.summary: Get ready for a delicious shaved ice challenge! Make lots of shaved ice and watch your food cart prosper!

games.name: Mine of My Mind
games.summary: This is a psychological horror where you play as a miner experiencing a midlife crisis. The final shift before a long-awaited promotion goes wrong: reality begins to warp, turning a workday into a nightmare. Will he be able to escape the depths of his own mind?

games.name: Sauve le Shérif
games.summary: Save the Sheriff: 4 to 10 players. Two saloons. One rule: trust no one. Proximity voice chat, face-to-face duels, and a dilemma with every shot: pacify or kill.

games.name: Sex Novel: Cheating Wife 2
games.summary: An erotic VISUAL NOVEL with stunning HD visuals and steamy ANIMATIONS. A devoted wife spirals deeper into temptation, risking her marriage for the passion she can no longer resist.

games.name: Somnus Corporation
games.summary: A psychological anomaly detection horror game set inside a collapsing dream simulation. Report inconsistencies. Question reality. Decide what consciousness is worth.

games.name: SusDoku
games.summary: A murder mystery blended with sudoku-style logic. Explore suspicious rooms, examine weapon evidence, and piece together clues through sharp deduction to reveal the killer. Play alone or work online with up to 4 detectives to solve the case together.

games.name: Tales From the Other Side: Beneath the Roots
games.summary: Psychological first-person horror. Fate brings you to your grandfathers house, left abandoned after his mysterious disappearance. Explore it and uncover the dark secret hidden within.

games.name: The Adventures of Hooman
games.summary: A sci-fi comedy graphic novel where you play Hooman, an android too conceded to be scared and too lucky to die. Your crew is going to die but they could have avoided an untimely death if they had only listened to you. You are not the problem.

games.name: The Fissure
games.summary: Investigate the mystery of an old family home in atmospheric visual novel style!

games.name: Two Kinds of People
games.summary: Two Kinds of People is a visual novel about at least two people.

games.name: Vials: ASMR Sand Sort Puzzle
games.summary: Vials is a single-player color-sorting puzzle game in which players pour layers of colored kinetic sand between hourglass-shaped vessels until each vessel contains a single color. The game features nearly 600 levels, minimalist visuals, ambient music, haptic feedback, and ASMR-inspired sand-pouring sounds.

games.name: Alek
games.summary: Post-soviet Russia, Tyumen in 1995. Alexey Smirnov, a local shot-caller, nicknamed 'Alek' found out about the death of his friends and swore to avenge. The bloody war started between the gangs of the city. However, a true enemy turned out not to be common gangsters, but men much scarier

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Hyper Crash
games.summary: A survival race where anything goes!

games.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
games.summary: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns with Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, launching on July 9, 2026. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.

games.name: Astro Arena
games.summary:
Astro Arena is a brand new casual 3vs3 PvP mobile game from PUBG Studios.
Pick your Hero. Build your skills. Battle your way through the Arena in matches that never play the same way twice.
Join a squad and battle in fast 5-min PvP matches. Multiple battle modes await. Unlock roguelike power-ups mid-match and crush your rival Heroes.
Choose from a roster of anime-style Heroes, each with unique skills, personalities, and flashy ultimates. Find your favorite and lead them to victory.

games.name: Backrooms: Fade
games.summary: Backrooms: Fade is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Alone or with friends, you will explore a nightmarish level, trying to understand where you are, what is happening, and how to survive.

games.name: Backyard Baseball
games.summary: The arcade-style classic is back - and it's leveling up. With enhanced gameplay, new game modes, and all the humor & charm of the original, this is Backyard Baseball like it was always meant to be played. Are you ready to play like a kid again?

games.name: BarbarQ 2
games.summary: Fun Competition & Clan Exploration, Dive into the Barbaric World

games.name: Bench Simulator
games.summary: You are not the hero. You are the bench. Witness lives, one moment at a time.

games.name: Bike Food Delivery Simulator
games.summary: Pick up orders, ride through the city, and become the ultimate bike courier.

games.name: Bottom Squad
games.summary: An idle defense game at the bottom of your screen. Build your squad, upgrade your base, and hold the line against relentless alien waves while you work or browse.

games.name: Brain Boost! Basic Math 4-Choice Quiz
games.summary: Train your math thinking with 4-choice quizzes! Read, observe, and solve number and shape problems Quick to play alone or together with family

games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops
games.summary:
Call of Duty: Black Ops is the seventh main Call of Duty game and the sequel to Call of Duty: World at War. The game differs from most previous installments, which would involve a usual three-country campaign, while Call of Duty: Black Ops features two playable countries (Russia and the USA) but only has an American campaign. Several new features are also introduced, such as dive-to-prone and the available use of a flashlight on certain weapons. Furthermore, the campaign's playable characters now speak while being controlled by the player.

Extra game included within:

+ Zork (Apple II)

games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II
games.summary: Pushing the boundaries of what fans have come to expect from the record-setting entertainment franchise, Call of Duty: Black Ops II propels players into a near future, 21st Century Cold War, where technology and weapons have converged to create a new generation of warfare between old and new foes. In this conflict, the mechanized creations of men reign supreme, facing off against each other as their creators stay safe and unconflicted, and in the process grow ever softer. In this scenario an important question will be asked: What happens when an enemy steals the keys to your war? To understand such a possible future, you must understand where you have been.

games.name: Card Party Showdown
games.summary: Three card games. One lively showdown for family and friends!

games.name: Carrot Catcher
games.summary: Squish, dash, jump, survive, repeat. Carrot Catcher is a fast-paced arcade game where you grab floating carrots, dodge hazards, and chase high scores. Simple to play, hard to master—how long can you keep up before it all gets out of hand?

games.name: Cat Mail Co.
games.summary: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat, organizing everything your way. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog, help locals, and unlock new abilities and destinations.

games.name: Color Snake
games.summary: A mix of Snakes and Colours for an exciting gameplay experience!

games.name: Console Archives: Rhapsody - A Musical Adventure
games.summary:
Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure was released by Nippon Ichi Software in 1998 for a 32-bit home console.

This is a musical RPG where Cornet, a girl with the magical power to befriend puppets, embarks on a journey to rescue a prince kidnapped by villains. Work together with the puppets who fight for Cornet as you progress through the journey!

games.name: Cozy Tide
games.summary: A cozy fishing and island-building game where you catch strange fish, expand your tiny island, decorate postcard islands, complete daily voyages, and collect your way through a cheerful ocean world.

games.name: Crime Scene: What’s Wrong?
games.summary: Study the scene. Spot the clue. Something doesn’t add up… Use your observation and logic to solve each case.

games.name: Cursed Companions
games.summary: Co-op horror with voice activation where the game listens to what everyone is saying. Say the right words to save friends, but the wrong words bring chaos, death and laughs. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, seek treasure, and try to survive the mayhem. Play up to 8 players in Co-op Mode and up to 16 players in Traitor Mode.

games.name: Cyber Psychosis
games.summary: Cyber Psychosis is a pseudo-3D dynamic first-person shooter in a cyberpunk setting with a lot of enemies, blood and drive

games.name: Cyber92 Datawar
games.summary: CYBER92 DATAWAR is a Surreal, Retro-Realistic Cyberpunk Shooter blending 3rd and 2nd-Person Combat. Master brutal gunplay, stealth, and time-space distortion. Shift through glitching vision modes, use destructive vehicles, and survive a fractured, twisted reality under constant time pressure.

games.name: Deadlined.
games.summary: a Psychological Horror where you lose yourself while trying to finish your paperwork before the Deadline.

games.name: Dice Rogues
games.summary: Dice Rogues is a tactical roguelite with infinite possibilities where you upgrade your dice and harness unpredictable rogue faces (X2, baguette, croissant, etc.) to bend fate, outplay the House, and survive a new roll each run.

games.name: Doors & Loot
games.summary: Make your way to the top of the tower and stop the sorcerer who controls it to free the unwary people who got there and are now cursed. Trade, craft, upgrade your skills and loot as you discover its history, as the higher you go the better the reward.

games.name: Eggconsole Hydefos MSX2
games.summary: Experience lightning-fast action and fluid scrolling. Deploy "Hyde" units to annihilate the Metal Creature and save Planet Tiar. The classic side-scrolling shmup returns!

games.name: Ego
games.summary: A Smoke based 3D Beat’em all. Fight thousands of robots at a time through open-ended levels in this Arcade style Smoking Wizard game ! Dash, Jump, Climb, ignite your smoke and obliterate every bots in your way!

games.name: Elevator: Avici
games.summary: "Elevator: Avici" is a 1st-person psychological horror with a retro, HK lo-fi aesthetic. Trapped in a decaying apartment elevator, your only link to the outside is a strange voice on the intercom claiming to be a repairman. Will you follow his commands, or find your own escape from the darkness?

games.name: Exorcist Candy
games.summary: Your daughter is possessed by an evil entity. Be a Dad and exorcise her.

games.name: Flaregate Network
games.summary: Flaregate Network is a roguelike deckbuilder with RTS-inspired spaceship combat. Build a unique deck, then pilot it—and your fleet—to victory!

games.name: Fleshbreak
games.summary: A story-driven survival visual novel inspired by SCP-610. Face a flesh-spreading outbreak, make brutal moral choices, protect the people you can’t let go of, and uncover the terrifying truth behind the disease.

games.name: Forward to the Sky
games.summary: Forward to the Sky is a third person action adventure game in the sky tower ruin. You are going to collect all the crystal pieces to connect the story and everything will be revealed once Princess reaches the top level.

games.name: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok
games.summary: Known for its dynamic combat, ensemble of versatile characters, and thrilling online cooperative play, Relink returns with expanded solo and multiplayer content, bringing endless adventure to skyfarers both new and old.

games.name: Gray Trading
games.summary: Gray Trading is an incremental game where you buy and sell stocks, trade forex, and dive into other unusual markets. Earn money, unlock upgrades, and conquer every type of trading.

games.name: Gyro
games.summary:
Abandoned deep in space, you play as Gyro—a small utility bot tasked to clean up the remainder of what once was. Along your journey, you will gain new items to add to Gyro's arsenal of tools. But don't think you're getting off easy—your tasks will also become more and more challenging as you help discover the nature of Gyro's predicament. Featuring the music of A Life Elided, Gyro offers up whimsical, mysterious, sci-fi-based puzzles that will keep you wanting more.

Gyro supports controller or keyboard & mouse that allow you to roll around and use the tools listed on the left side of your screen. Consisting of six stages, you traverse from room to room, completing numerous tasks. Once all tasks in a room are complete, you'll be able to proceed to the next one. Upon reaching the end of a stage, you will face a boss. Defeating the boss will potentially give you a new tool and allow you to continue on to the next stage (once your other tasks are complete). You can save your progress through the menu—or autosave has you covered.

games.name: Hell Clock
games.summary: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

games.name: Hell Clock: Cursed War
games.summary:
Cursed War is the expansion for Hell Clock, plunging players into a grim, dark fantasy reimagining of the Historical Paraguayan War. Serving as a prequel campaign, players will uncover the tragic and haunting origins of Pajeú, one of the game's core characters.

Set across more than 10 grueling new biomes, including blood-soaked rivers and treacherous swamps, players must fight through an onslaught of cursed forces. The expansion completely revamps the endgame with the introduction of Endless Nightmares and unleashes over 80 new Unique items and relics designed to let players break the game with devastating, chaotic new synergies.

games.name: Hidden Clues: Mystery Scene Challenge
games.summary: Read the case. Search the scene. Find the hidden clue that reveals the truth. A quick mystery challenge for sharp eyes.

games.name: HouseWarming
games.summary: Brian Lewis buys an old house, hoping for a quiet and orderly life. But on the very first night, the house begins to behave strangely... What starts as a harmless incident slowly turns into something far more terrifying... What if someone else is inside?

games.name: Kawaii Anime: Cute Girls Magic World
games.summary:
Spells, sparkles, and the cutest girls you've ever seen.
Play, score, and unlock them all.

games.name: Kitty Farm Island
games.summary: Farm, fish, explore, and build the coziest kitty island paradise!

games.name: Magical Girl Witch Trials
games.summary: Thirteen girls awaken, only to find themselves in a prison. What awaits them: a Witch Trial. Help them prepare for the trial by exploring the prison in order to find the witch hidden amongst them. Find the witch, learn what kind of magic she holds, dispel the lies, and prepare for the execution.

games.name: Memorize the Evidence: 1-Minute Memory Mystery
games.summary: 60 seconds to memorise the scene. Can you find the missing evidence in your mind?

games.name: Mesmalie
games.summary: MESMALIE is an occult visual novel/point & click adventure where you attempt to tame your Magickal ability under the guidance of a small Witches' coven in the middle of nowhere. Heed Mesmer's aloof teachings, strengthen your Magick, or just go home,,,

games.name: My Cozy Workspace
games.summary: Build the workspace you’ve always dreamed of!

games.name: Northgard Battlegrounds
games.summary: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

games.name: Numerous Ninjas
games.summary: Guide a team of ninjas through endless chambers packed with traps, power-ups, and surprises. How long can your clan survive?

games.name: Our Wonderland
games.summary: A horror-fantasy visual novel about five childhood friends returning to the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. This is the remastered version with updated art and features releasing in 2026.

games.name: Phageplay Basic
games.summary: A story about going to the theatre. And the play is kind of strange very avant-garde. So you feel badly about yourself. And then it all starts over. Phageplay Basic is a full length stageplay embedded in a not quite completely-kinetic visual-novelette. Created for toxic yuri jam 2.

games.name: Place & Learn 19×19 Mental Math
games.summary: Master 19×19 multiplication step by step! Place the numbers, spot the pattern, and train your mental math in short sessions.

games.name: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey
games.summary: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. Wield magic and might against legendary foes from Greek mythology. Recruit a synergistic army and cultivate your hero to win Immortal Glory!

games.name: Protean Fox
games.summary: "Protean Fox" is a bullet shooting game that combines elements of creature capture and light roguelike gameplay. Players will take on the role of a girl who gains the power of the Protean Fox. In her quest to reclaim the Foxfire, she wields weapons and magical artifacts from different worlds.

games.name: Red Titans
games.summary: Red Titans is a single player vertical shoot em up, use the resources available to stop the threat, you will have to be very skillful since there are no continues.

games.name: Tetrogue
games.summary: Stack pieces, clear lines, slay monsters. A falling-block roguelike where every line cleared strikes your enemies. Battle through a monster-filled dungeon, collect synergistic relics and gems, and survive escalating challenges across a procedurally generated map.

games.name: The Full Ann Petting Experience
games.summary: Give her a headpat!

games.name: Tokyo Valkyries
games.summary: Tokyo Valkyries is a roguelite deckbuilder where you build your deck, devise strategies, and progress through the map while defeating the enemies that stand in your way. One day, another world known as the “Other World” emerges in Tokyo, encroaching upon reality. Only a chosen group of girls can stand against this strange phenomenon. Will they be able to protect Tokyo from the encroachment of the Other World?

games.name: Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle
games.summary: Once you open this book, you are no longer just a reader. A "reading-style" fantasy adventure in the spirit of The NeverEnding Story — handcrafted over six years by a 30-year veteran from Vanillaware. 100% handmade, from the first page to the last.

games.name: Wahm
games.summary: A psychological Arabic horror short story. You set off toward the Empty Quarter, off-roading deep into the vast desert, a place meant for peace and clarity.

games.name: Warhead Vanguard
games.summary: Hostages. A stolen project codenamed "WARHEAD". Only you can go in. Warhead Vanguard is a hardcore tactical TPS with next-gen 3D physics and shaders!

games.name: Warheads & Overheads
games.summary:
Warheads & Overheads is a satirical idle tycoon in which a one-character typo in a Pentagon database hands a failing family staple factory a 2.3 billion dollar defense contract. A seven-dollar pot goes in one end of the line and comes out billed to the taxpayer as a 436-dollar helmet, before gold-plating, while sealed-bid auctions are won by underbidding rivals and padded afterward with requirements like parts built in all fifty states.

Every padded dollar draws heat; too much brings auditors and then a congressional hearing where composure is a resource. When the walls close in, the company rebrands under a shinier name and runs the racket again, climbing a product ladder that ends at an orbital peace umbrella.

games.name: Weird Water World
games.summary: Fish dark waters and discover procedurally generated fish that come in every color of the rainbow. Explore a weird ocean world haunted by Thalassophobic titans. Sell your catches. Try your luck sports betting at the bar. Drink delicious juices. Get eaten alive. Appease the Gods. Find your way home.

games.name: Whys & Wonders Secrets of the Universe
games.summary: What Does Space Smell Like?! Become a Space Expert Through Fun Quizzes

games.name: Your Intelligence Will Be Exposed: Mystery Observation Challenge
games.summary: In just 12 seconds, your eye for detail is exposed. Can you read the clues and find the answer?

games.name: Zombie Defense: Breach of the Undead
games.summary: A dark wave-based zombie defense game where you build your defenses, fight relentless undead hordes, and survive against the infected… and hostile raiders?
Pull the lever, stop the reels, and chase the 1 / 16384 triple 7.

games.name: 100 Pet Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 101 Cats in Brussels
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Brussels landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

games.name: 11 Trials of Raz
games.summary: A first-person observation game set in an endless loop. Spot subtle or deceptive anomalies, choose the right direction, and survive increasingly challenging and horrifying difficulty modes as you search for a way out.

games.name: 8AM: The Subway
games.summary: "8AM: The Subway" is a suspense game set in the subway after midnight. Watch the security cameras as eerie events unfold and decide if it’s fatigue, malfunction, or something far darker until 8:00 a.m.

games.name: Akayo Therapy
games.summary: Akayo Therapy is a game about a therapist who must overcome the shyness of hot girls, while avoiding his own dirty fantasies.

games.name: Anbar
games.summary: Anbar is a fast-paced multiplayer arena game where two teams clash with opposing goals. Explorers race to build an artifact while Mercenaries use a growing ball combo to disrupt them. Victory depends on speed, timing, and teamwork.

games.name: Arcane Ascent
games.summary: Build powerful decks to face the chaos unleashed by the Primeval Witch. With hundreds of combinations available, perfect your strategy in every battle, strengthen your cards and unravel the mysteries that await you - your rise to power begins now!

games.name: Ascent of Eternity
games.summary: Ascent of Eternity is an action-rpg rogue-like magical horde-slaying third person coop game. Fire, Ice, Electric, Light, Dark, Metal, and Life. The 7 elements call for mastery. Master the elements and ascend through eternity!

games.name: Battle Chef Brigade
games.summary: Battle Chef Brigade features fantasy chefs, including Orcs, Elves, and Humans, who need to hunt dangerous monsters for ingredients. With those ingredients, before the critical eye of the judges, the chefs create culinary masterpieces in an intense tournament. Battle Chef Brigade pairs one part combo-based action hunting and one part puzzle-based cooking, all as the round clock ticks down.

games.name: Be Missed and Remembered: The Letter from Mayoiga
games.summary: The setting is 50 years ago, Showa 47. The protagonist, a high school student, is heading to his grandparents’ countryside home. A short trip taken during summer vacation, a yearly tradition. Spending time with his sister, peacefully interacting with the villagers, but…

games.name: Black Spades
games.summary:
Black Spades is a culturally rooted spades game featuring Jokers, Deuces, Reneg, Blinds, and more house rules, realistic gameplay, competitive leaderboards, unlockable rewards, and cross‑platform play. Built to match the origins of spades from the African American communities, it delivers fast action, social energy, and competition.

Fast, smooth card mechanics and intuitive controls keep every hand feeling like the real thing, whether you’re learning the ropes or proving you’re the best at the table. As you play, you’ll climb competitive leaderboards, unlock new locations, earn avatar upgrades, and jump into prize‑based contests. Black Spades blends culture, competition, and community into a single experience.

games.name: Bravest Coconut
games.summary: Bravest Coconut is a silly game about solving story-driven puzzles, meeting a cast of quirky characters, and exploring a world littered with secrets... and you’re a cat.

games.name: Catjong 6: Pawztec Temple
games.summary: A cozy mahjong-3 adventure awaits! Solve 200 fun levels with your playful cat and restore a tranquil outdoor world shaped by soft greenery and ancient stones.

games.name: Chrono Spin
games.summary: Chrono Spin is a Roguelike RPG blending Fruit Machine with deep strategy. Manage your mana to place bets, unleash character skills, and challenge legendary guardians from the Misty Forest to the Seasons Temple. Every spin is a gamble between life and death!

games.name: Cool Game Pack
games.summary: Cool Game Pack is a casual collection of ten pick-up-and-play mini-games featuring logic, reflex, arcade, puzzle, and score-based gameplay. The game includes a variety of short challenges designed for quick sessions, relaxed play, and replayable high-score attempts.

games.name: Curio Shop
games.summary: Buy mysterious (possibly cursed) goods from the dark web by night, then sell them in your curio shop by day. Balance profit against consequence and assemble an artifact capable of causing the apocalypse. All in a day’s work.

games.name: Dead Estate
games.summary: Dead Estate is a gory, fast-paced top-down shooter roguelike with a heavy emphasis on Halloween and horror. Ascend four floors of a monster-filled mansion with two different playable characters, 25 different weapons to choose from, and 50 different items to aid you along the way!

games.name: Dig for TCG Cards With Your Friends
games.summary: A cozy junkyard card-collecting sim - now with online co-op. Dig through mountains of trash with friends, hunt rare collectible cards, sell your junk for profit, and upgrade your gear.

games.name: Digging Simulator
games.summary: Dig, Sell, Upgrade, Repeat!

games.name: Digimon Story: Time Stranger
games.summary: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

games.name: Do You Even Brick?!
games.summary: Do You Even Brick?! Old-school brick breaking meets virtual tennis. Our modern twist on two arcade classics. Featuring single player & couch co-op! You gotta ask yourself a question: 'Do i even brick?'... Well, do, ya, punk?!

games.name: Doomsday Draft
games.summary: Doomsday Draft is a multiplayer social deduction game for 4–8 players. Receive a random character with unique traits, reveal your cards, convince others of your value, and vote on who gets to stay in the bunker after the apocalypse.

games.name: Dream Corps
games.summary: Surreal horror game. You have been selected by a sinister group to participate in a twisted game of exploration and escape. Walk through dreamy, horrifying places that evoke unease and fear.

games.name: Dreamy Golden Snow
games.summary: Dreamy Golden Snow is a fantasy mystery-themed visual novel that tells a story among high school girls. The story appears in an ordinary high school. After the incident, the protagonist is also affected, and players will guide her through numerous choices to uncover the truth.

games.name: EULA
games.summary: An image created by AI is it yours? An AI art tool is placed before a nameless illustrator. To accept, or to refuse. A visual novel that tells the same story in different forms. Your choices shape the ending - there is no right answer.

games.name: Echoes of Aincrad
games.summary:
Step into the legendary floating castle of Aincrad, a realm of breathtaking beauty and unforgiving danger. What seemed to be a dream adventure has now become a fight for survival. Among thousands of trapped souls, your journey is yours alone; will you rise, endure, and forge bonds that define your destiny? Or will you perish while facing enemies stronger, faster, and more ruthless than you imagined?

This is not just a game. It’s a battle for survival.

Take up your weapon. Shape your legend. Conquer Aincrad. RISK YOUR REALITY!

games.name: Eclipsed Remnant
games.summary: In a world where every soul is captured, yours remain free. Take the chance and claim their souls for yourself and rise unstoppable...

games.name: Escape from Umbra
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight. Solve the enigmas and move unseen to escape Umbra’s domain.

games.name: Evergarden
games.summary: Evergarden is a relaxing idle incremental about turning a tiny barren patch into a lush, living island. Restore tiles with your shovel, let workers gather resources, meet pets, and watch the ecosystem quietly spread on its own.

games.name: Evil Spirit Hunter
games.summary: A fast-paced top-down action shooter set in dark dungeons. Fight off waves of evil spirits, gain temporary power-ups for instant advantages, and struggle to survive while under siege.

games.name: Explosive Track
games.summary: Explosive Track is an intense action racing game set within a virtual gaming world. Competitors will complete to be the first to the finish line with powerups on an island set rigged to blow with the ultimate goal of becoming the season champion. Inspired by Split/Second and Blur.

games.name: Farm Pro 26 Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready to master every step of the farming process?

games.name: Floworks
games.summary: A node-graph automation × idle factory builder. Materials flow along the wires you draw and transform at each machine — wire Mine → Smelt → Build → Ship. Spot glowing bottlenecks, balance power against wire distance, supply growing towns, and climb a deep production tree from steel to robots and drones. It keeps running even while idle and offline, with zero image or audio assets — every visual and sound is generated in code.

games.name: Forest Escape: Last Train
games.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.

games.name: Foxy the First Steps
games.summary: Foxy is a precision platformer focused on timing and control. Master the press jump, overcome 150 levels and perform crystal combos. Prove your skills, learn the story of this mysterious world, seek guardian's assistance and reach the path to the portal.

games.name: Gemaze TD
games.summary: Tower Defense influenced by the famous Gem TD, where you place 5 random towers but choose only one, slowly building a maze for the enemies and combining lots of different gems to get even stronger towers.

games.name: Geronimo
games.summary: Geronimo is an immersive, tactical CQB shooter built for Virtual Reality that depicts a modern-day world in which Special Forces operators are called to implement unconventional operations as members of elite teams. Engage in the most realistic combat experience available. "Who Dares, Wins"

games.name: Ghost Exorcist
games.summary: Purify ghosts and collect their souls. Grow stronger with every soul you gather, unlock powerful upgrades through the skill tree, and guide restless spirits to their final rest in this progression-driven action game.

games.name: Giants
games.summary: Giants is a first-person narrative game that tells the tragic story of the residents of the 8th floor. The company has sent you here to investigate certain incidents for insurance purposes. Explore the building and the residents' apartments.

games.name: Goblin Solitaire
games.summary: Relax with a cozy fantasy-themed Klondike solitaire experience. Customize card designs and backgrounds, unlock achievements, track statistics, and enjoy a charming goblin-inspired world while playing the classic card game you know and love.

games.name: Gold ’n Goal
games.summary: Gold ’n Goal is an absurd soccer incremental game about scoring ridiculous amounts of goals, earning good € and training your team to be the champions of the universe!

games.name: Harvester vs. Zombies
games.summary: Mill hordes of zombies on the roads of villages, towns, and cities, avoid obstacles, buy upgrades, unlock increasingly powerful vehicles, complete missions, collect cards, earn achievements, break records, and compete with players from around the world in leaderboards and statistics.

games.name: Hexcrawl
games.summary: Hexcrawl is a dark fantasy RPG about crossing a hostile world one hex at a time. Players explore a procedurally generated overland map, manage supplies, survive lethal encounters, hunt powerful bosses, craft gear, and delve into walkable sites. Combat is tactical and lethal. Progress comes from exploration, equipment, and mastery rather than traditional character levels.

games.name: Hollowforge
games.summary: Hollowforge is a fast-paced stealth/action FPS where you explore a decaying mining complex overrun by monstrous experiments. Sneak, shoot, and survive using an array of weapons while conserving resources. Uncover the dark secrets of a megacorporation in this atmospheric, immersive world.

games.name: Hyperfist
games.summary: A fast-paced, comic-styled, first person melee action game focused on punching, grabbing, and other hand-to-hand combat. Enjoy visuals inspired by comic books and the punk aesthetic while comboing robotic enemies in a fast and fluid combat system.

games.name: Incinera: Pandemonium
games.summary: This is a romance game that combines narrative puzzles with visual novels. Five love stories, five eras, a journey of soul. In endless reincarnation, you will witness the transformation of the world as the god of marriage, and when the story reaches its end, you will be forced to be part of it...

games.name: Insanio
games.summary: Autobattler where you send misfits into vehicular combat. Your job is to prepare them, deploy them, watch them struggle and finally watch them die or win in massive explosions.

games.name: Jigokuraku: Paradise Battle
games.summary: The first game adaptation of the TV anime Hell's Paradise, now streaming with Season 2. "Jigokuraku: BATTLE IN HELL'S PARADISE" is now available.

games.name: Jogo da Nota
games.summary: Jogo da Nota is an online social-deduction party game for 2 to 12 players. Each round, one player secretly receives a score from 1 to 10 while another invents a subjective scale question (defining what "1" and "10" mean). The scorekeeper answers with a concrete example matching their hidden number, and everyone else tries to guess the exact score. Play in your browser with friends.

games.name: Lamp Clicker
games.summary: Build your lamp empire, one click at a time!

games.name: Link Lab
games.summary: Connections are all you need to succeed. Link objects together to share and mix traits to create the tools you need to solve each level. Be careful which resource you spend where though, as each one is single use and you might need that piece later!

games.name: Machinefall
games.summary: Machinefall is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game set on a fully playable global map. Lead humanity’s last survivors as they build bases, gather resources, and wage massive battles against an overwhelming machine swarm. Progress through technological eras from Stone Age to Atomic Age.

games.name: Meowstery Wisp
games.summary: A multiplayer social deduction and investigation game where players gather clues, debate, and manipulate trust to resolve a mystery; with no elimination until the big finale.

games.name: Micronova
games.summary: In this vast universe, you are a Novi-01, a tiny explorer who jumps, climbs, and carves their way through levels filled with creatures and environments that react to your every move, waiting to be explored and solved in order to advance.

games.name: Mothkeep
games.summary: Mothkeep is a single player moth documenting game where you step into a peaceful nature sanctuary and discover its native moths, one journal entry at a time.

games.name: Mushroots
games.summary: New RTS for everyone!

games.name: My Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: From humble store to retail giant!

games.name: MyBiz: Pomodoro Desk Tycoon
games.summary: A cozy pixel-art office sim powered by your real Pomodoros. Focus sessions earn cash + XP — decorate, hire staff, level up. Music, ambience, break-time minigames. Productivity tool by day, tycoon by every minute.

games.name: No Escape
games.summary: A challenging survival horror game which puts you in a situation where you have to escape at all costs and don't get caught by HIM. There are 4 modes that have different difficulties, out run HIM and find all the tools you need to escape the house. There are two different endings get them both!

games.name: O2
games.summary: A short deep-sea horror game where you explore a dark and mysterious ocean, photograph strange discoveries, and uncover what lurks beneath the depths.

games.name: Overball
games.summary: Inspired by Pong, Overball reinvents the classic formula with explosive power-ups, destructible defenses, and a ball that grows more dangerous with every hit. Battle with up to 6 local players in fast-paced, frantic, and utterly chaotic matches.

games.name: Palworld
games.summary: Palworld is a multiplayer open-world survival game that combines creature-collecting with crafting, base-building, and combat. Set on the Palpagos Islands, players capture and tame animal-like creatures called Pals, which can be used as mounts, combat partners, or workers at player-built bases. The game incorporates firearms and darker satirical elements into the monster-taming formula.

games.name: PinRogue
games.summary: PinRogue is a pinball roguelike where physics, strategy, and chaos collide. Launch your ball, earn points and multiplier by hitting bumpers, score satisfying combos, purchase powerful upgrades in the shop, and create game-breaking builds!

games.name: Planet Flipper
games.summary: A short turn-based planet management sim about flipping a world for profit. Balance supply, unrest, famine, and conflict. Or let it collapse and cash out before it’s too late.

games.name: Pokémon Infinite Fusion
games.summary:
Pokémon Infinite Fusion is a Pokémon RPG fangame based on the Pokémon fusion generator trend, featuring sprite art from a large community of artists. In this version of Pokémon, Silph Co. has created a DNA splicer that can work on any Pokemon, allowing their stats, visual appearance, and typing to be combined alongside their available abilities and moves. The game includes both the Kanto and Johto regions, and includes over 570 Pokémon, including the first 386 Pokémon from the first three generations alongside a suite of specifically chosen Pokémon from later generations.

With hundreds of thousands of fusions available, even Professor Oak doesn't expect you to "catch 'em all"!

games.name: Quantum Void
games.summary: Lost in an unexplored star system after a dimensional anomaly dispersed your fleet, you pick up signals scattered throughout the system. Explore the wrecks of your fleet vessels, collect useful modules for your ship, discover the secrets of the anomaly, and try to escape from this star of doom!

games.name: Quarantine Market Simulator
games.summary:
Quarantine Market Simulator is a first-person market management simulation game set in a post-apocalyptic world.

Run your own market, manage stock and customers, check temperatures, and defend the walls during zombie raids.

games.name: Queen's Gamble
games.summary: A seductive cinematic experience where your choices shape passion, power, and betrayal.

games.name: Quest Arrest
games.summary:
A detective RPG released for the Game Boy in 2020.

The game follows the main protagonist, recently promoted, Detective Allison Bennett on her quest for clean up her city, Strange Meadows, after the recent crime spree that has thrown the city into chaos. Athena, and her gang, has been terrorizing the residents and has set her sights on taking over the city for herself.

games.name: Rahasya
games.summary: Enter a cursed ancestral haveli and uncover the truth behind a forgotten bloodline while surviving a reactive entity that watches, listens, learns your habits, and adapts to how you survive. Explore hidden rooms, solve ritual-based puzzles, and survive

games.name: Rat Race
games.summary: Here you come to be the toughest rat in the sewers, where every delivery can end on the correct delivery point... or you can be crushed into the pipes. Do you dare to be the fastest rat in town?

games.name: Red Rooms
games.summary: A time-sensitive strategy game where you must defend yourself from ominous entities. Defend yourself by using your camera flash, holding doors shut, and closing curtains. You must act quickly.

games.name: Ribbit Jump
games.summary: A precision platformer where every move counts. Adjust the strength of each jump to progress through an increasingly demanding level design. Conquer 50 obstacle-filled levels and master every leap across diverse environments.

games.name: Shipyard of Theseus
games.summary: A game about thinking about ships.

games.name: Shrapnel Sentinel
games.summary: Shrapnel Sentinel is an arena based FPS with an emphasis on defence. The longer you survive, the more you will encounter.

games.name: Smoke Town
games.summary: Experience the high-stakes hustle in a cutthroat multiplayer economic strategy game to clear your $1,000,000 debt. Grow your product, outbid rivals in real-time auctions, and manipulate the Syndicate to rule the district. Can you rise from Street Dealer to Kingpin, or will the heat catch up to you?

games.name: Step Lightly
games.summary: There's no place like home - and yours is no home at all. Play as Rosa, a neglected child trying to escape her abusive family. Sneak out, but be ever so quiet. Mom is listening, dad is angry, and your big sister is always watching…

games.name: Stick Scholars
games.summary: A social deduction party game where players parkour to school, answer trivia, and hunt down a hidden Class Clown who is sabotaging to try and make the entire group fail!

games.name: Stoneheart Archive
games.summary:
Stoneheart Archive is a moving-base survival roguelike about protecting the last library in a forgotten world.

The castle moves on its own, and you need to keep it alive. Build defensive towers to protect it from enemies. Venture out to find ruins, collect resources, recover lost knowledge, and race back to safety.

Use knowledge to unlock new towers, restore settlements, and shape the future of the world. Each run creates a different version of the archive, from a fortress of bells and flame to a plague-medicine sanctuary or a lightning-powered war library, so you can experiment with wildly different builds each run.

games.name: Sweet Dance
games.summary: A next-gen 3D dress-up rhythm dance game. Mix and match a vast collection of fashionable outfits, master the hottest dance moves, and unlock trending TikTok hits. Meet new friends and embark on a sweet romantic journey!

games.name: The Lost Mixtape
games.summary: Play as a raccoon with a cassette player, hunting for new tracks to dumpster dive to. Explore an abandoned mall and its surroundings to collect hidden cassettes. Dig through trash, uncover secret paths, and gather items. Experience this short adventure where someone's trash is a raccoon's treasure.

games.name: The World Below: A Call Within
games.summary: Achi ran away from the orphanage and he found himself surrounded by concrete, indifference, and violence. He was saved by a mysterious creature that came from within, and by a peculiar detective. He had no way of knowing that darker, more disturbing voices were about to reach him.

games.name: Tired
games.summary: High-speed sci-fi time trial racing. Master five tracks with tight controls, instant restarts, and no distractions—just you, the clock, and the push to go faster. Your biggest rival is your own skill.

games.name: TooneQuest
games.summary:
A 3rd person Adventure in full 3d featuring Day and Night and expansive vistas.
TooneQuest is a casual game where the player explores and captures creatures as they are discovered. Use the TooneDex to help find some of the trickier to find Toones.
Find and capture all the 50 of the unique creatures hiding on the 5 islands.
Discover Abilities such as Jump, Crawl, Glide and Double-jump to help you navigate and explore the Islands.

games.name: Towers Saga
games.summary: Guide humanity by building grand towers in this 3D Match-3 falling blocks puzzle game. Recall the greatest tale of them all and witness the wonders of the ancient world in Babylon, Egypt, Atlantis, and much more!

games.name: Ultimate Guess Game
games.summary: Ultimate Guess Game is a thrilling digital social game. Challenge a friend and race to identify the mystery image you are holding using strategic "Yes/No" questions. With diverse categories to choose from, use your deduction skills to win! Can you solve the puzzle before your opponent does?

games.name: Unreachable
games.summary: An urgent message from home, a choice with an impossible price tag. In a 20-minute high-stakes dialogue, you must dismantle a "perfect" engineer's facade. Faced with $100,000 and a family tragedy, will you help him preserve his costly "American Dream," or force him to face the half-packed suitcase?

games.name: Unusual Findings
games.summary: Unusual Findings: Three friends uncover mysteries in the 1980s. Follow their amazing adventures in a game where your decisions really matter. Be prepared to spin like a record on your incredible journey back to the era of synthesizers, VHS Rental stores, 8 bits games and evil alien conspiracies.

games.name: Unwoven
games.summary: Face off against cursed creatures and protect Laima’s legacy in Unwoven, a fast-paced twin-stick shooter. Explore a gothic mansion and vanquish the spawn of a family curse. But beware: fate will test your skills and make every path more challenging.

games.name: Waifu Discovered 3: Cyberpunk Fantasy
games.summary: An arcade anime shoot’em up with a unique strip’em up twist where the better you play, the more you reveal. Battle enemies, defeat absurd bosses, and unlock stunning waifus piece by piece.

games.name: Walrus Fly
games.summary: Walrus Fly is an endless on-rails flying game, where you fly through rings! Enjoy combat-free flying, and use resources carefully to hold onto your Ring Streak. Go for as long as you can, but lose your HP and it's game over!

games.name: Warehouse 30
games.summary: Take on your father's job as a warehouse clerk, inspect each shipment note carefully and direct them to where the corresponding warehouse. Stick to the rules, avoid making mistakes and subsequently fines to make enough money to help your family get through this rough patch.

games.name: Wartheon
games.summary: Wartheon is a fast-paced 2D roguelike adventure set in a world on the brink of elemental collapse. Take control of one of four unique champions to match your taste. Customize your build, master your skills, and adapt to ever-changing layouts and enemy patterns.

games.name: Welcome to Kowloon
games.summary: This is an indie horror from the first person, in which you find yourself in an area called Kowloon in search of cheap housing. The inhabitants of this place only at first glance seem to be ordinary people, but if we dig deeper, we will see their real faces.

games.name: Worst Shop in Town
games.summary: Run your own cozy corner store: stock shelves, set prices, serve customers, and try not to question why the building feels alive. A chaotic retail simulator with weird physics, suspicious customers, and bugs that are now officially part of the atmosphere.

Trapped in a mysterious space shrouded in an unsettling atmosphere, a unknown presence creeps up from behind— "it" doesn't move while you're watching. But the moment you look away, it closes in without a sound. Can you escape "it" and find your way out of this enigmatic space?

games.name: A Surgery Beyond The Heart
games.summary: This is a pix word puzzle adventure game based on RPGMaker.With serval different choice,you will get total different endings. You need to play the Germany returned genius doctor Shen Yi to find the dark side of the hospital.

games.name: Angels Fall First
games.summary:
Angels Fall First is a first person combined-arms sci-fi wargame.
From commanding the battle standing on the bridge of your flagship all the way down to frantic infantry firefights - AFF brings together all the combat you ever wanted.
Featuring tactical team-oriented gameplay and offering a wide selection of weapons, tools, vehicles and spacecraft, AFF focuses on objective-based scenarios with a high degree of replayability, playable both online and offline.

games.name: Ascension of the Dead
games.summary: Kick, yeet, and explode your way through undead chaos in this fast-paced zombie shooter with brutal physics and over-the-top action.

games.name: Burnable Hearts!
games.summary: This work is a horror mystery suspense game where you peek online at a lost bishoujo game from the 2000s called "Burnable Hearts!"

games.name: Color Attack!
games.summary: Rotate and React

games.name: Eckspelled
games.summary: You are a student witch on your way to witch school. Along the way, you're bombarded with tons of ingredients! Collect the proper ingredients to cast a fireball spell in order to pass, or else risk failing your witch exam!

games.name: Galaxy Defenders: Classic TD
games.summary: A classic tower defense game set in space! Build and upgrade towers, defend your portal from waves of alien invaders, and outsmart evolving threats across handcrafted and procedural maps.

games.name: Golfish
games.summary: Golfish is a cute single-player puzzle adventure where you roll, flop, and splash your way from ice hole to ice hole as a little fish on a big journey!

games.name: Health Audit Simulator
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a Health Auditor. FIND, FLAG and RATE potential Risks and Hazards across 20 playable environments, between two differing difficulty variants.

games.name: Jinglebug Journey
games.summary: Jinglebug Journey is a Visual Novel about a cursed video game, haunting a college student, "Max", who is in search for answers about his identity and happiness.

games.name: Lingix Lingo
games.summary:
Welcome to the ultimate word puzzle experience designed for brain trainers and language lovers alike! Inspired by traditional Lingo-style word games, this title challenges you to guess hidden words under time pressure using strategic color-coded clues.

Green means the letter is correct and in the perfect spot; yellow means the letter is in the word but in the wrong position. Use your logic, unlock power-ups, and climb the scoreboard!

games.name: Ouch! Cargo!
games.summary: 4-Player Online Co-op. Push Carts & Loot Cargo. Troll Crewmates. Fight Beasts. Hit the Quota to Evacuate.

games.name: Palette: Glass Shard Mosaic
games.summary: A fan remake in RPGMaker MV of Yoshitaka Nishida's Palette (2000), which also has elements from the 2001 Japan-exclusive Playstation remake Forget me not -Palette- that have been newly translated into English.

games.name: Roots
games.summary: Plant, harvest, buy animals and improve your farm islands

games.name: Sonoklo
games.summary:
Keep your board clean! Swipe to change gravity on a 6x6 board and prevent random block shapes to fill your board. Align 6 blocks on a line to clear it and increment your score. But be careful: if the next random shape can't spawn anywhere on the board, you loose the game

In this isometric puzzle game, your goal is to reach the highest score possible while using combos and powers.

games.name: Soothe
games.summary: You awaken at the bottom of a rusted pit, another forgotten machine amongst a pile of those who came before. On your right, an extendable grappling claw, and on your left, a melted screen. You are given only one goal - reach the light above.

games.name: Street Uni X
games.summary: Classic EXTREME sports at their best: on ONE WHEEL! Perform unicycle stunts and combos with style, smash goals, unlock new levels, characters, cheats, and more! REAL uni pros, REAL uni tricks, REAL underground jams, and REAL retro play that begs for one more run!

games.name: Summer Days in the Joyful Countryside
games.summary: Welcome your nieces to your rural home to help them enjoy a summer vacation of relaxation, farming, and gaming!

games.name: The Long Drift
games.summary: Build, upgrade, and watch your tiny universe evolve.

games.name: The Mutiny
games.summary: A third-person zombie survival RPG built by one solo developer. Scavenge a post-apocalyptic town, manage gear that breaks, hunger that bites, and a world that gets darker the longer you stay alive.

games.name: Tri City Monsters
games.summary: Tri City Monsters is a supernatural, monsterlovin' visual novel where you can romance and/or de-pants 3 demonic love interests. Navigate a dangerous urban jungle with their help and maybe you'll get a taste of what it means to be a monster.

In 1994, a bitter labor dispute between Major League Baseball and the Players Association destroys a season and plunges the future of the sport into uncertainty.

For two amateur scorekeepers, the end of baseball is the end of an escape. They can no longer hide their faces behind their scorecards and the troubles of their time haunt their fragile relationship. Amidst it all is a growing realization that baseball itself is subject to the same forces that cast shadows over their lives.

What are scorecards good for? Every one is a mirror of its creator. Deep inside those cryptic grids of figures and diagrams are the thoughts scorekeepers can't put into words: the desire to be made new, an opaque sense of justice. Greed, hate, retribution, death.

games.name: Baff C
games.summary: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

games.name: Booox
games.summary: "Booox" is a platform puzzle game where players control multiple characters simultaneously, coordinating their actions to solve challenges.

games.name: Cattlieb
games.summary: Pinball meets roguelike. A mysterious adventure of strategy and luck, where the path of the ball changes the battle and board events with both risks and rewards shake the player’s choices.

games.name: Echolink: Recursion
games.summary: EchoLink: Recursion is an active incremental hacking simulation spanning 1990s dial-up to 2150s megacities. Hack through time by infiltrating networks, building proxy chains, and automating routines. Every reset reboots you with exponential upgrades. Grow a skill tree and rewrite history.

games.name: El Ídolo
games.summary: From one of the 16 clubs, rise to become your club’s idol and a national team champion. If you make it big, you’ll make the leap to Europe—the Champions League, the Ballon d’Or, and a return home. All in 5 minutes.

games.name: Elysium: Blue Den Mansion
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore a mysterious mansion, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and survive a terrifying creature lurking in the shadows.

games.name: Goblin Camp
games.summary: Goblin Camp is a fantasy city-building game inspired by Finnish mythology. Deep simulation mechanics capture the unique challenges of surviving the harsh winters and carving a thriving settlement out of the northern forest. Lead your goblins to greatness!

games.name: Haggle Simulator
games.summary: A Monopoly-style board game focused on negotiation, trading, and bidding between players. Can take out loans from the bank. be careful—late payments may result in asset repossession! Trade via group chat or private messages. Cross-play with mobile players. Come and sharpen your haggling skills!

games.name: Kaschei
games.summary: An experimental visual novel made for the Toxic Yuri VN Jam of 2026.

games.name: No Flowers in Arizona: Rust Red Vivarium
games.summary:
Mirasol has been living with Dolores for as long as she remembers. Dolores has cared for Mirasol ever since a tragic accident impeded Mirasol's ability to live on her own.
Dolores is all Mirasol knows, and Mirasol is a weight that Dolores cannot shed.

games.name: Purrrfect Spa
games.summary: Welcome to Purrrfect Spa — a cozy ASMR game designed for relaxation and healing. Here, you’ll care for adorable feline clients, enjoy soothing soundscapes, and experience the gentle companionship and peaceful moments of a furry world.

games.name: Schrodinger's Catgirl
games.summary:
A catgirl awakes from her box again and into the care of the Good Doctor.

This is how it should be.

She wishes she always knew that.

games.name: SkyChart: Airline Executive
games.summary:
SkyChart: Airline Executive puts you in the CEO's chair of a fledgling airline, competing against 35+ AI rivals across four historical eras (1930–2020). Plan routes between 150 cities across 7 world regions, manage a fleet of 33 historically accurate aircraft from the DC-3 to the 787, and navigate 60+ scripted world events, including WWII, the oil crises, deregulation, 9/11, and COVID-19.

Every era presents a different strategic challenge. The 1930s demanded survival with propeller planes and limited capital. The jet age rewards aggressive hub-and-spoke expansion. The modern era is a cutthroat war of pricing, alliances, and hostile acquisitions.

The game features a fully draggable, resizable window-based UI with a Strategic Advisor that analyzes over 110,000 city pairs, full controller support for Steam Deck and consoles, a built-in music player with Spotify integration, and quarterly financial reporting with route-level analytics. SkyChart combines deep systems with intuitive design — the kind of game that makes you lean back in your chair and think, "I built this network."

games.name: Swordless
games.summary: A broken sword... The left hand controls the hilt, the right hand guides the blade. They work together to reach the end, and unite as one!

games.name: The Angel Factory
games.summary: A yuri visual novel produced by Gravity House for the second Toxic Yuri VN Jam.

games.name: True of Voice: A Duat Deckbuilder
games.summary: True of Voice is a roguelike deckbuilder set inside the Egyptian afterlife. Your deck is a scroll — utterances chosen for your funeral, words that are instructions to reality. Cross twelve hours of the Duat toward the Hall of Two Truths. Every card you play is spoken aloud. Every transgression is written in the heart. The scale does not lie.

games.name: Uncanny Cat Golf
games.summary: Take control of the Canny Cat and launch your way to the goal! Watch out for any Uncanny Doppelgangers that lurk around...

games.name: Voidbloom
games.summary:
Voidbloom is a top-down survival roguelite in which players pilot a light-ship through swarms of hostile blooms that grow increasingly intense. Weapons fire automatically while the player controls movement, positioning, and upgrade choices. During each run, experience shards provide weapons, improvements and passive systems that can be combined into different builds.

Bosses appear at timed intervals, ending with the Voidmother. Defeating it completes the standard run and opens an endless score-chasing mode. The game also includes permanent progression, unlockable vessels, competitive Void Clash matches, and cooperative Team Raid encounters.

games.name: 13 Masca
games.summary: Can you... identify the one who isn’t quite right?

games.name: Active Soccer 3
games.summary: Explosive retro arcade action is back! Active Soccer 3 is an exciting retro arcade football game providing a fast-paced arcade experience, implementing amazing playability and responsive easy-to-learn/hard-to-master controls.

games.name: Alchemickal
games.summary: A skill-based action roguelite where you imbue your weapons with chemickals to exploit enemy weaknesses. Master alchemy, customize your arsenal, and survive the depths of an arcane invasion!

games.name: Ascend to Zero
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what it's like to stop the time? Ascend to ZERO is a time-control roguelike, in which you can use your special ability to stop the time itself and efficiently fight your way through the top. Freeze the time to dodge opponents' attacks using your unique ability, and always hold a higher ground for the combat. However, don't forget that the time allowed for you is confined.

games.name: Blackwater Exchange
games.summary: Run a basement black market pawn shop in a gritty 1990s city. Inspect questionable goods, negotiate with desperate sellers, resell through shady contacts, manage heat, survive raids, and decide whether each item is a payday, a fake, a trap, or a liability.

games.name: BugFixer
games.summary: BugFixer is a 4-player co-op horror social deduction game where you must collect the bugs occurring in reality. As a specialized agent, your mission is to collect these bugs and survive until the end against both mysterious monsters and a hidden traitor among your teammates.

games.name: C-ko-fn-ta-C
games.summary:
A troubled illustrator runs away from home.

A lonely fan takes her under her wing.

From there, it’s all downhill.

A visual novel about responsibility, arrested adolescence, and the mortifying ordeal of being (un)known.

games.name: Carpet Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: Clean carpets, earn money, and grow stronger in this incremental cleaning game. Scrub, rinse, and squeegee your way to profit—before time resets and you start again.

games.name: Casenology
games.summary: A top-down tactical shooter where you'll fight enemies, rescue hostages, and complete various missions. But it's not that simple — you'll face shortages of ammo, medkits, and all kinds of resources. So, is it worth engaging in a firefight? Think before you act!

games.name: Chest Buster
games.summary: An incremental battle game where destroying treasure chests instantly brings item effects into battle to fight enemies. Break all the seals on the Abyss Chest and liberate the great being who will save the world!

games.name: ChildMare
games.summary: Dive into a secret 1980s laboratory where the "Super Kids" program turned into a nightmare. Hunted by Lou, a blind girl transformed into a terrifying monster after a failed experiment, infiltrate the facility, use the environment to your advantage, and try to survive this first chapter.

games.name: City Bus Simulator 2026
games.summary: Experience the Ultimate Bus Driving Adventure! Step into the driver's seat in City Bus Simulator 2026, the most immersive and realistic bus simulation game. Navigate a sprawling 40 square kilometer city, mastering a variety of bus models with unique features and dynamics.

games.name: Co-Drive Chaos
games.summary: Co-Drive Chaos is a chaotic CO-OP driving game where two players control a single car together. One managing the left wheel and the other the right. To move effectively, both players must synchronize their inputs and communications.

games.name: Cog Foo
games.summary: A battle-laden automation game where you have to manufacture everything from battle units down to every bullet! Engage in battles to gather survivors. Manage and feed your people. Mine, farm and Optimize production lines. Can you lead your people to victory?

games.name: Dayscream
games.summary: Dig deep down in a world of darkness. Uncover the secrets of your dreams and try to find out what is really going on. Are they just daydreams or your deepest nightmares?

games.name: Descent Down Infinity
games.summary:
Descent Down Infinity is a psychological horror game inspired by classics such as Silent Hill 2 and Dead Space

Descend down into the abandoned underground megastructure of Helix-8 and uncover what's happened to the people there.
As the newest member of the Infinity Inc. family, your goal is to retrieve important data from the very heart of the city, The Core.

games.name: Don't Starve Together
games.summary: Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve. Discover and explore a massive procedurally generated and biome-rich world with countless resources and threats. Whether you stick to the surface world, go spelunking in the caves, dive deeper into the Ancient Archive, or set sail for the Lunar islands, it will be a long time before you run out of things to do.

games.name: Dorothy's Magical Journey in Oz
games.summary: A magical journey of friendship, courage and finding your way home!

games.name: Electoral Carnage
games.summary: Electoral Carnage is an absurd 2D fighting game featuring America's most famous (and infamous) politicians. If you don't download it you hate America. Also JFK can assassinate himself. What more do you need to know?

games.name: F.E.A.S.T
games.summary: F.E.A.S.T is a farming factory automation game focusing on cooking. You are a new recruit in a secret organization tasked with a critical mission: feed the gods before they destroy the world with their hunger. Farm ingredients, run food factories, and prepare gourmet-level offerings tailored to each divine being’s impossible appetite.

games.name: Fart Fighter
games.summary: Fart Fighter is a 2D, top-down, pixel-art action game, where players travel across a world map, progressing through levels while collecting equipment, powerups and combining food to craft different farts and eliminate enemies.

games.name: Finding Cats
games.summary: In the serene world of Finding Cats, embark on a relaxing journey. With soothing music, use your mouse to explore detailed scenes and spot hidden cats. Slow down and immerse yourself in this cozy, peaceful atmosphere.

games.name: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective
games.summary: Become a forensic specialist in a realistic crime lab simulator. Investigate crime scenes, collect microscopic evidence, and identify perpetrators in the lab using DNA and digital analysis. Based on the experience and insights of experts from the State Criminal Police Office Rhineland-Palatinate.

games.name: Forest of Deceit
games.summary: Forest of Deceit is a 4-8 player social deduction game where you use your phones to play!

games.name: Fresh Food Merge
games.summary: A 3D physics puzzle game where you dodge flying toys while dropping and merging identical food items to create a variety of fruits and vegetables.

games.name: Fu-Fu-Chan: Way Up!
games.summary: Blow into the microphone and breathe life into your climb. As simple as a breath. As deep as the sky.

games.name: Game Store Chronicle
games.summary: Run your own game store! Stay ahead by following the timeline of gaming history and preparing for key events that has shaped the industry. Stock shelves, set prices, and sell consoles, games, and accessories. Strategize to grow your business and dominate the market!

games.name: GeoFlag
games.summary: A geography game for the curious. Match flags. Place countries. Race the daily challenge. Four game modes covering 154 countries, with two visual themes — vintage parchment or modern aerial — to set the mood.

games.name: Geogames
games.summary:
GeoGames is a browser-based geography game platform built around Google Street View. Players explore real-world locations, navigate streets, and compete or cooperate through several game modes.

The main mode, City Meet-up, challenges players or teams who start lost in the same city to find each other using only communication and orientation skills. Other modes include GeoBingo, where players complete a bingo card by finding real-world objects and landmarks; Hide & Seek, where one player hides and others try to discover the location; Rally, focused on reaching checkpoints; and Scotland Yard, a pursuit mode between police and thieves.

GeoGames is an multiplayer project designed for quick online sessions, geography fans, streamers, and players who enjoy exploration, deduction, and real-world navigation.

games.name: Goblin Attack
games.summary: Shoot goblins, grow your army, and maintain your speed with every tap. Play in full screen or let the game run silently at the bottom of the screen while you do other things.

games.name: GreasyMac: Void Wilds
games.summary:
This game is a collaborative effort from the GreasyMac community to celebrate Mac's birthday.

A short point and click adventure intended for GreasyMac fans, packed with in jokes and references to his streams.

games.name: Half Step Princess
games.summary: Tenth grader Gwendolyn Baker joins her schools fencing club and becomes entangled in rivalries and romance with her competitors.

games.name: Hexalith
games.summary: Hexalith is a casual sci-fi city-building game with dynamic twists. Collect resources, complete missions, discover new city blueprints, and expand your civilization in this tile-based space odyssey.

games.name: Honest War
games.summary: Honest War is a free-to-play browser real-time strategy game with fast PvP battles. Players gather resources, build a base, research technologies, and command infantry, tanks, and aircraft.
