The game includes ranked matchmaking, seasons, leagues, clans, tournaments, team battles, bot practice, replays, and a map editor. Optional cosmetic purchases provide no pay-to-win advantages.

games.name: Hover Cup
games.summary:
Slide your paddle to strike the puck into your opponent's goal.
Ranked matches, Tournaments, 'King of the Ice', and more...

games.name: Imperial Ambitions
games.summary: Discover and colonize the world, Allocate your labor force, Monopolize markets, Fight tactical battles, Survive the age of imperialism as the world turns into a war zone.

games.name: Kaz
games.summary:
KAZ, your shot of dopamine wrapped in a minimalist roguelike. Execute lightning-fast moves with frame-perfect controls : easy to learn, hard to master. Immediate, Intense, Addictive. Every run makes you better, faster, hungrier, unlocking tons of unique items, skins and challenges.
4 keys, no excuses: Prove your skill and dominate the ranks.

games.name: Kill The Nova
games.summary: Classic puzzle meets roguelike deck-building! Collect a variety of unique pieces, build powerful synergies, and unleash overwhelmingly inflated scores through explosive “multipliers.” Smash impossible numbers straight into your enemies and beat up the final boss—the developer himself!

games.name: Kisen: Seeker of Aenjan City
games.summary: Tap into the mystery as a stranger in the city — a mild mystery visual novel. Kisen runs a tracing agency in a city far from his home. There, he is asked by a local university student to look for his brother missing from twelve years ago. Investigate what happened back then to uncover the truth.

games.name: Lazy Kickers
games.summary: Lazy kickers is a tiny soccer incremental where you grow balls from plants and shoot goals for coins. Start small and climb the leaderboards, unlocking more upgrades to score millions and plunge the playing field into total chaos.

games.name: Little Incrementisle
games.summary: Little Incrementisle is an incremental colony-building game where you land on one wild island after another. On each island, you gather resources, construct buildings, recruit villagers, and develop your colony, until you’re ready to set sail for the next one.

games.name: MetalMuters
games.summary: Half puzzle, half roguelike, mini-factory game where you turn lead into gold!

games.name: Metamancer
games.summary: Metamancer is a roguelike video game that uses procedural generation for every sprite, item, map and faction making for a unique playing experience each time!

games.name: Miney Golf
games.summary: Miney Golf is a casual miniature golf strategy game where players can pick up and place land mines all over a destructible course to either help them traverse obstacles or mess with their opponents. Play through several courses with your friends online through Steam!

games.name: Mysarium
games.summary: A cozy sandbox designed to accompany you as you go about your day. Take a break: relax, breathe, and create tiny worlds in glass. Grow plants, unlock new elements, and find secret combinations to summon special guests to photograph.

games.name: Neko Station
games.summary: Sit back and relax with Neko Station, a cozy 2D Pixel Art Desktop Idle Game! Manage your very own 'cat train,' decorating it with the perfect furniture to attract a diverse cast of feline customers. Pick them up at various stations and build friendships in this heartwarming adventure.

games.name: Orpheus: To Hell and Back
games.summary: Orpheus: To Hell and Back is a adventure game for the gameboy, where the player plays as Orpheus descending into the Underworld to rescue Eurydice. You have your magical lute that allows you to play songs that pull or push enemies toward you, or put them to sleep momentarily.

games.name: Pacremental
games.summary: Pacremental is a incremental game about opening packs, unlocking weapon cards, evolve them and automating your progress. Collect rare artifacts, combine them with weapons, and push through increasingly difficult waves. Build tower your own way.

games.name: Paradise Island
games.summary: A solo-developed (by a non-technical designer using AI) fusion of merge mechanics, simulation management, and roguelike deck-building. Your goal: survive as long as possible through strategic piece placement, card synergy, and map exploration.

games.name: Penguin Lifter
games.summary: Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. You'll work outdoors, far from civilization, surrounded by cute creatures - penguins. It's just you, the snow, and the penguins...

games.name: Phantom Tower
games.summary: Hack-and-slash action RPG. Climb an ever-changing Tower, loot enemies, forge your own build, and grow stronger with every run

games.name: Pixplorer
games.summary: Pixplorer is a top-down sandbox action-RPG. Explore biomes, conquer dungeons, craft, build, fight, mine, farm, catch fish and insects! Enjoy the game's atmosphere and complete freedom to shape your own adventure.

games.name: Playing Prague
games.summary: Playing Prague is a relaxing puzzle game in which Prague comes to life at your fingertips. Discover this bohemian city with playing cards featuring the ancient symbols of Prague houses.

games.name: Ponder Thy Realm
games.summary: Observe magical environments, memorize your surroundings, detect magical aberrations, and report them before time runs out on the clock and reality unravels in this first-person observation game.

games.name: Porcelain Heart
games.summary: Porcelain Heart is an interactive visual novel with multiple endings following the story of Mary. It was made as a submission to TOXIC YURI VN JAM 2 on itch.io.

games.name: Protocol Solari: Escape Room
games.summary: Awaken alone aboard a drifting colony ship under autonomous lockdown. Restore critical systems, solve interconnected puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Solari Protocol before you and the colonists depending on you are lost to the void.

games.name: Red Flag
games.summary:
You find yourself seated at a table with other survivors (from 6 to 12 players).

Each player has hidden information about themselves – their pre-catastrophe profession, skills, phobias, and more.

Over the course of several rounds, players take turns revealing information about themselves, discussing, arguing, and trying to convince the others that they are the ones who deserve to remain in the shelter.

games.name: Road Defense Racing
games.summary: High-speed vehicular combat racing set in the world of Road Defense: Outsiders. Drive, shoot, destroy, and upgrade your car across 30 challenging tracks. Battle armed rivals and survive attacks from a hostile crowd while earning cash to upgrade your vehicle.

games.name: Room Craft
games.summary: Room Craft is a creative simulation game where you can bring your dream rooms to life. Design unique spaces with a variety of furniture, decorative objects, and interior details, and build rooms that reflect your own style.

games.name: Roulette Dungeon
games.summary: Roulette Dungeon is a turn-based rogue-like where you spin a roulette wheel to defeat your enemies. Master the balance between strategic planning and unpredictable luck by placing bets, using special abilities, and collecting items to outsmart your foes and conquer the dungeon.

games.name: Runix: Pinball Roguelike
games.summary: A roguelike 3D pinball game where you build your ball deck to hit and slay monsters with incredible combos and climb to the top of the leaderboard. Discover powerful artifacts that create incredible synergies and increase your mage powers to restore "The Pinball Order"

games.name: Save the President: Trust Issues
games.summary: A fast-paced social deduction party game for 4–10 players, grab your friends and play online together. One player is the President, but no one knows who. Protect them, complete tasks, and unmask the Killer hiding in plain sight. Accuse carefully: one wrong guess ends the game.

games.name: Shortstop by the Sea
games.summary: Baseball is about waiting for something to happen. Baseball is about being powerless. Baseball is about not getting what you want. Baseball isn't about anything.

games.name: Soulforge: Lost Path
games.summary: In Soulforge: Lost Path (Survivors-like), become a legendary hunter slaughtering endless Corrupted Souls. Scavenge Sacred Remains to forge Exorcist Artefacts, manage limited inventory strategically, and uncover the world's festering corruption truth.

games.name: Stackflow
games.summary: Stackflow is a hypnotically addictive strategic roguelike about the pure pleasure of fitting pieces perfectly. Discover unique blocks, create satisfying connections, and trigger explosive combos that release pure dopamine.

games.name: Sweet, Sweet Indigo
games.summary: Indi's older sister has been there for her since the day she was born, even moreso after she transitioned. They grew up together, suffered together, eventually ran away from home together. Now they live in a van, trying to make things work out in the small corners of their hometown. They're not kids anymore. How long can they keep this up?

games.name: Swim4Swim
games.summary: a visual novel about swimming

games.name: The Additional Dimension
games.summary: A game set in 70s Soviet Union, you need to escape an unknown liminal dimension.

games.name: The Alters: Last Variable
games.summary: Continue Jan Scientist's story as he stays behind to unlock the planet's secrets. Build an underground base, assemble a crew of specialised Scientist alters, master Terraformation, invent new technologies, and conduct research that could define a legacy.

games.name: The Death of Harsh Noise
games.summary:
As the world is falling into ruin, Harsh Noise's body is following suit. Worn out by gender dysmorphia, drug addiction, and terminal illness, it can only see one fate on the horizon: Absolute Death.

Is there any salvation possible for a dwindling pack of it/its girls as they each contend with their own kind of existential decay? And just when everything is already at rock bottom, Harsh Noise's distant past goes after a certain trailer park...

games.name: The Meat Factory
games.summary: The world has gone to ruin, communities slowly dwindle, and food is scarce. Folks have heard rumors of an operation on the rise to solve the food shortage... but at what cost?

games.name: The Sweet Spot
games.summary: The Sweet Spot is a cozy horror game where you work the last shift at an 80s ice cream shop. Make ice cream, serve customers and watch out for strange things.

games.name: Tidy Up: Spaceship
games.summary: A cozy sci-fi tidy-up game. Gather the books scattered across your ship and sort each one into its rightful place. Play in calm normal gravity or start on Zero-G mode, where the books float in mid-air. No timers, no pressure.

games.name: Ultrafeminine
games.summary: messy monster girls make each other worse

games.name: Voidrave
games.summary: A neon bullet hell where the deeper you fly, the less space behaves. Blast through 100 waves and 20 hand-crafted pixel bosses, mutate your ship with roguelite powers, and uncover the truth: you are not crossing the void. You are inside it.

games.name: War of the Austrian Succession
games.summary:
Fight across the battlefields of eighteenth-century Europe in War of the Austrian Succession, a detailed tactical wargame covering the major campaigns, battles, and theaters of the vast dynastic conflict that reshaped the balance of power in Europe.

From Mollwitz and Chotusitz to Dettingen, Fontenoy, Rocoux, Lauffeld, and Culloden, War of the Austrian Succession places you in command of the armies that fought for crowns, territory, dynastic survival, and continental dominance. What began as a succession crisis following the death of Holy Roman Emperor Karl VI quickly expanded into a sprawling European war involving Austria, Prussia, France, Britain, Bavaria, Spain, Sardinia, the Dutch Republic, Jacobite rebels, and countless allied states and auxiliary formations.

Take command in War of the Austrian Succession, where detailed tactical maps and historically grounded orders of battle place you in control of armies fighting across snow-covered plains, fortified cities, mountain passes, rivers, villages, and sprawling continental battlefields. Every battle is shaped by the realities of eighteenth-century warfare: rigid linear tactics, cavalry shock action, artillery deployment, militia reliability, command limitations, fatigue, terrain, morale, and the growing importance of light troops and maneuver warfare.

games.name: Wink Out
games.summary: Wink Out your rivals in this physics-driven 1v1 shooter! Craft clever card synergies, adapt between rounds, and outplay opponents by sending them flying out of the arena.

games.name: Worldforge: Construct & Destroy
games.summary: Build, destroy, and experiment in a physics-driven voxel sandbox featuring fully destructible environments, dynamic combat, explosive chain reactions, and creative sandbox gameplay.

games.name: A Little Horror Story
games.summary: A world frozen in fear and shadows

games.name: A Simpler World
games.summary: A small, cozy building game. Tidy up and decorate a pixel-art world. No goals, just vibes.

games.name: Am I Still Me
games.summary: Dark power makes you stronger — but each bargain erodes your mind. A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelite where your choices shape both your power and your ending.

games.name: Anomaly Department
games.summary: A multiplayer, friendslop hidden object game.

games.name: Aspectless One
games.summary: An isometric action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Collect the shattered Aspects of Omnia, master your skills, and face enemies that will test your limits. This is just the beginning.

games.name: Backgaminion
games.summary: Backgaminion is an atmospheric board game with deck building as its essential element. You experience dungeon crawling in a mystic fantasy world and turn your cards into powerful minions and magic effects on the board.

games.name: Biotone
games.summary: A pitch-controlled brick breaker where you move the paddle with your voice. Travel through 8 biomes brought to life with retro-inspired sound and visuals.

games.name: Bowling Alley Simulator
games.summary: Bowling Alley Simulator lets you build, manage, and grow your own bowling alley. Run the lanes, cook classic food, hire staff, and expand your business into a thriving entertainment destination.

games.name: Camp Wombo
games.summary: Co-op survival horror game. Four friends must gather resources and repair their vehicle while surviving deadly creatures in a constantly changing forest.

games.name: Castaway Survival In Ocean: Build Your Own Raft, Craft
Cat Chess
games.summary: Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess but with... cats! Lead your furry friends to the Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers!

games.name: Celestial Return
games.summary: Celestial Return is a story-driven RPG where dice are your bullets, your bribes, and your last breath. Loot, gamble, and survive a reality-crumbling city. Uncover cosmic horrors, outwit corrupted megacorps, and pray your next roll isn't your last.

games.name: Chasing the Dawn
games.summary: Chasing the Dawn is a joyous pixel-art strategy game, designed for families. In this vibrant, ever-shifting fantasy world, every playthrough is a unique new journey.

games.name: Chesscent
games.summary: Chesscent is a pixel art turn-based strategy roguelite that blends classic chess with rule-breaking cards. Face impossible rivals, embrace defeat, and unlock new permanent abilities to change the outcome of the match.

games.name: Commutator
games.summary: Commutator is an instrument-only horror game set in a dystopian future where human perception is replaced by sensors and code. You are an operator sitting behind a terminal, guiding a remote unit through the darkness.

games.name: Cozy Catch
games.summary: An idle fishing game with pixel art charm and a spooky-cozy twist. Cast your line, reel in strange and rare fish, upgrade your gear, and explore eerie biomes beyond the peaceful forest where you begin. Simple mechanics, relaxing vibes, and plenty of hidden treasures await.

games.name: Creepy Support
games.summary: Save people from terrible paranormal dangers as a support operator of a secret SCP-like organization! Ask questions, give advice and watch the consequences of your choices... 5+ endings in each story ;-)

games.name: D-topia
games.summary: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, its up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

games.name: Dash n Cry: Bursting
games.summary: Help Lala Sparks reignite her passion by bursting through hundreds of hand-crafted challenges! DASH n CRY: Bursting is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer. Every DASH matters, every CRY will make you stronger!

games.name: Death's Life 2
games.summary: A physics-based puzzle game where you play as Death, creating “accidental” deaths through chain reactions. Solve scenarios in multiple ways or survive and escape from deadly trap-filled environments.

games.name: Deep Space Outpost
games.summary: Deep Space Outpost is a space station building & survival game, involving resource and base management. Build your space station tile by tile, mine asteroids, refine materials and keep your station operational.

games.name: Difficult
games.summary: Step into a fully 3D medieval world of deception. diffiCULT is a multiplayer social deduction game where you must uncover hidden cultists. Use proximity voice chat, investigate houses at night, survive daily votes, and reveal who is truly on your side.

games.name: Disease
games.summary: "Disease" is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre. The Yellow Man pierces the night in search of a new victim. Can you stop him before it's too late?

games.name: Dodecium
games.summary: Solo Indie delivers a local 1-4 player split-screen physics-based create and combat sandbox with scientific tools for PvP or PvE. Replay many unique campaigns. Master your hex build strategy, microscopes, and chemistry skills. Be clever to achieve victory and learn as you go. June NEXT FEST.

games.name: Dying Light: The Beast
games.summary: Dying Light: The Beast Restored Land is a new enhanced version of the game that includes the base game, all previously released updates and the premiere Restored Land content in one package. This includes Legend Levels, New Game+, Ray Tracing, Nightmare Mode, dozens of new brutal finishers, hundreds of parkour and gameplay improvements, and numerous visual and audio enhancements - delivering new ways to experience the apocalypse.

games.name: Factory Town 2: Paradise
games.summary: A cozy city-builder where you craft and sell tropical items to keep villagers happy. Use conveyor belts, trains, zip lines, catapults, and boats to automate delivery, optimize production, and earn the favor of a giant sentient volcano.

games.name: Femme Fatality
games.summary: You are a serial killer who exclusively targets men. For a fee. To afford nice things. It's legal and you're good at it.

games.name: Flux Empyrean
games.summary: The ocean hides countless forgotten secrets. Echoes of calamity and loss scar the waves. Sail a vast planet under a blanket of stars and use your tools and wit to solve the grand puzzle of the past. Rediscover truth in this expansive open world mystery.

games.name: Garisani Detective Agency
games.summary: Garisani Detective Agency is a story-driven real-time co-op deduction game for two.In 1990s Korea, play as a brother and his ghost sister, taking cases from the living and the dead. Gather clues from two angles and solve puzzles together.An analog era of pagers and payphones.

games.name: Guardian of the Sacred Seal
games.summary: In another world, the protagonist works alongside a mysterious young man, handling requests that appear ordinary but conceal subtle changes beneath the surface. Through repeated choices, relationships between the characters gradually evolve, and the hidden truths of this world slowly come to light.

games.name: Halu: The Fish
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game about a child in a broken home. Under the watchful eyes of a strict mother, your only friend is a fish in an aquarium. Do your daily tasks and experience a heavy, emotional story where the only thing you want is to be free.

games.name: Heartstop Tour
games.summary: Heartstop Tour is a free-to-play visual novel developed by Comfort Kuma Studios, originally submitted to Otome Jam 2025 and later expanded with additional content.

games.name: Hyperscale
games.summary:
Hyperscale is a comedy idle tycoon about running an AI startup whose garage chatbot somehow acquired a board of directors. Cash from tapped server racks is poured into GPUs and coolant while a model trains toward parameter counts whose suffixes eventually give up on numbers; racks overheat, rival labs ship at the worst moment, and the benchmarks are rigged, mostly by the player.

When hype peaks, a funding round resets everything for a permanent multiplier and a proud new model name, escalating from garage chatbot toward an ambiguous ending. Everything is fictional parody, the full game is reachable without paying, and optional purchases buy speed rather than content.

games.name: I Know a Spot
games.summary:
I Know a Spot is a cozy sandbox building game about creating peaceful campsites in beautiful natural locations. Customize your car, explore forests, lakes, mountains, and seasonal landscapes, then build the perfect place to relax with your loyal dog.

There are no objectives, timers, or pressure—just creative freedom. Decorate your campsite with tents, lanterns, furniture, and cozy props, personalize your vehicle, and enjoy calm moments surrounded by nature at your own pace.

games.name: Joey's Nightmare II
games.summary: Joey’s Nightmare II is a cartoon-style roguelite deckbuilding card battler set inside a bizarre and dangerous dream. Battle monkeys, donkeys, turkeys, and undead horrors, build powerful card combos, and fight your way through a nightmare that changes every run.

games.name: Kenpin Sagyou
games.summary: You have a reason for needing a lump sum of money. You applied for a job through a mysterious job site recommended by a friend and started a part-time job inspecting products. The job is simple: pack normal products in paper bags and dispose of defective products by attaching a shipping label. If you overlook a defect or dispose of a normal product, bad things will happen. To avoid such problems, be sure to do your job carefully and accurately.

games.name: Kibble Cats
games.summary: Kibble Cats is a cozy, short incremental game with a definite ending. Rebuild an ancient cat village around a buried Pawbelisk. Hire cats, unlock buildings and reach milestones as a thread emerges connecting it all to something greater. A force stirs within this village, and it dreams a Great Dream.

games.name: Little Rock Shop
games.summary: Little Rock Shop is a casual adventure game all about rocks and exploration! Navigate hiking trails and find geological specimens. Manage your shop, hone your lapidary skills, and interact with a quirky cast of characters.

games.name: Lovely Traps Dungeon
games.summary: Your quest : Guide a golem through mad dungeons filled with platforms, traps and puzzles. Recover lost madn-- knowledge at all cost (golems are just moulded clay after all)

games.name: Maledictor
games.summary: Classic, dark ambience in a bloody and difficult retro FPS. Fight cultists and demons who are as dangerous as you in your fight against the Maledictor.

games.name: MonsterSoft
games.summary:
Manage a game-dev company where your only employees are skillful monsters in this turn-based game. Destroy humans in your free time.

Synopsis:
MonsterSoft is a game development company that hires only monsters. After personnel reduction, the new CEO appears with a goal to create the game that will knock off the competition. The problem is that he has no idea how to make it... .

No one said that game creation is an easy task, so hire new employees, kill humans that will appear on your path, and survive in the harsh world of monsters. Your final deadline is B3 Conference in the next few months, so no pressure.

Characters:
Choose your dream team from a wide variety of monsters: zombies, vampires, werewolves, ghosts, etc. Each of them has a unique skill-set to kill humans efficiently, scare them off, or follow them till they die from exhaustion.

Multiplayer:
Invade humans residences with other monsters and check who will get the title of the Employee of the month. Plan your actions carefully and kill humans faster than your coworkers in this rat race. Monster association forbids fights between monsters, but who said that you can't do it indirectly?

games.name: Murmel TCG
games.summary: A competitive online strategy card game where players battle for magical marbles that power their world's civilizations. Choose a faction, and complete missions while competing against rival regions in arena-based card battles.

games.name: Nevergrind
games.summary: NeverGrind is set in the world of Vandamor, a land inhabited by orcs, giants and dragons! Battle against the dark forces that have sewn chaos and destruction throughout the realm! Embark on your journey to unveil and crush the forces of evil, fighting battles and hunting for treasure along the way!

games.name: October: Survivor's Guilt
games.summary: October: Survivor's Guilt is an first-person psychological horror game where you explore an unsettling house, interact with objects, and try to survive a terrifying night after a simple favor goes wrong.

games.name: RSVP
games.summary: A first-person party management horror game where you scramble to set up venues, handle chaotic guest incidents, and keep the vibe from collapsing before the night spirals out of control. Will you survive?

games.name: Railway Routes
games.summary: Guide trains, build tracks, and solve relaxing grid-based railway puzzles. Plan the perfect route across 100+ handcrafted levels and watch your railway come to life.

games.name: Rock Bottom
games.summary: Mine. Smelt. Upgrade. Repeat. An incremental mining game where every swing makes you stronger. Descend through 8 unique layers, unlock devastating abilities, and discover what lies at Rock Bottom

games.name: Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids
games.summary: Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids is a medieval fantasy blend of tower defense and roguelike progression. Build defenses on a grid, manage resources, and survive ever-evolving enemies.

games.name: Scary Cave Diving
games.summary: A claustrophobic first-person underwater survival horror game where you must navigate procedurally generated cave systems on a draining oxygen tank while being hunted by a massive apex predator. Test your nerves in the main exploration mode, or fight back with a harpoon gun in the action-focused Shark Cage mode.

games.name: Seven Seas Jewels 2: Collector's Edition
games.summary: Set sail to save Rowan from the siren Narissa's curse. As Polly, journey across stormy seas, solve 250 Match-3 levels, uncover secrets, and face supernatural threats. Will love prove stronger than dark magic?

games.name: Silency: Cube 666
games.summary: Find the exit inside a giant mechanical cube of 216 rooms that rotates and rebuilds itself. Every door may lead toward survival, or send you straight into death. Read counters, deduce the rules, and decide whether the next door can still let you leave alive.

games.name: Something to Drink?
games.summary: I'm Tom and I just got a job as a bartender. Now I have to wipe down the same sticky counters where I used to leave my own marks. In this dive, even the rats look like they're hungover. Alright, the boozers won't pour their own drinks - time to get back to work.

games.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
games.summary: This was part of a McDonald's Happy Meal promotion.

games.name: Spolous II
games.summary: This is a side-scrolling 2.5D shooting game.By collecting capsules (items) that appear throughout the stages, the gauge displayed at the bottom of the screen will fill up.Once the gauge is filled, you can power up your ship by pressing the power-up button.

games.name: Stay: Ember's Desktop Adventures
games.summary: Ember is a virtual pet who feels alive - and living on your desktop. Play with her, feed her - make her feel loved. She’ll be curious and attentive, mischievous when you need a distraction, quiet when you need a little focus time. Fully 3D and animated - with a little sass.

games.name: Stay: Your Forever Pet!
games.summary: A cozy pet sim where you raise Ember, your magical fox-like companion. Bring her home, care for her, and venture into the Otherlands together -- deepening your bond one adventure at a time.

games.name: Stickplosion
games.summary: Stickplosion is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art brawler where the arena fights back. Blast, build, and bury rivals in fully destructible terrain across free-for-all and team battles. Draft a new ability every round, invite friends through Steam, and craft your own maps.

games.name: Sweet Tea Tycoon
games.summary: Run a sweet tea stand in this 2D pixel-art business simulator inspired by tycoon classics. Manage inventory, adjust your recipe, hire staff, invest in upgrades, and pick locations to maximize profits. Build a lasting business in endless Career mode, or chase high scores in a 30-day Challenge mode.

games.name: Taival
games.summary: Play together on the couch or online - or both at once. Taival is a cozy co-op adventure where you and up to 3 friends explore a handcrafted world alongside your shapeshifting companion. Discover new forms, progress through narrative quests, and make the journey your own.

games.name: The Crimson Maid
games.summary: As a secret celestial curse takes hold of his father, a young cleric finds himself enraptured by the charms of a strikingly beautiful maid. A period drama that combines romance and murder mystery, with a dash of supernatural.

games.name: The Incident at Galley House
games.summary: In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery.

games.name: The Infinite Grimoire
games.summary: Build your magical academy, produce arcane tomes, merge them into stronger forms, train students, and expand your influence across the world. An idle management game where your spellcraft grows even while you're away.

games.name: The Ouroboros King
games.summary: The Ouroboros King combines the strategic tactical depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Build a formidable army, discover powerful relics, and buy surprising gadgets to defeat the three evil witches.

games.name: Three Kingdoms: Alias
games.summary: A world where officers hide their names and abilities. Can you spot Zhuge Liang? A hardcore turn-based strategy simulation for true Three Kingdoms devotees.

games.name: Three Kingdoms: Bond
games.summary: From Legendary SEGA Japan producer Yasuhiro Nishiyama, Sangokushi Bond is a fast-paced deck-building army battler built for strategy experts, not fast fingers. Recruit from 100 legendary Three Kingdoms warlords, create devastating team synergies and watch your tactics unfold in the chaos of battle.

games.name: Uh Oh Airlines
games.summary: Uh Oh Airlines is a silly, casual, single player or couch co-op flight attendant simulator where you and a friend perform normal flight attendant duties, but must also wrangle your passengers to make it through the day.

games.name: Urban Strife
games.summary: Urban Strife is an old-school TBS, where you lead a team of makeshift, slightly deranged militia in an effort to keep the small community of Urban Shelter alive, amidst a zombie pandemic. With what’s left of human civilization divided into factions fighting over the scraps, you will need to broker alliances and fight factions wars, fortify and rebuild your community and forge a future against the ever-present threat of the zombie horde.

games.name: Valor 1944
games.summary: Turn the tides of World War II across Europe and the Pacific in this action packed third person shooter.

games.name: Vampire Hunter: Nightrise
games.summary: You came to hunt a vampire. Instead, you're trapped in his sprawling Gothic castle. You must hold on to your dwindling faith and dismantle his defenses before Nightrise — or become his prey in this single, story-driven experience.

games.name: Vellar
games.summary: Vellar is a first-person psychological horror game where a family is dead… but the recordings they left behind slowly reveal a version of events that doesn’t match reality. Explore a shifting house filled with impossible rooms, distorted corridors, and uncover a truth that refuses to stay buried.

games.name: Warena
games.summary:
WARENA is a fast-paced RTS card-battler where tactical decisiveness meet explosive arena combat.

Blend the real-time strategy with the mind games of a competitive card battler. Draft your perfect deck, manage your mana economy, and destroy the enemy base in intense 1v1 PvP duels or a challenging single-player campaign. You don't micromanage individual troops - you deploy forces, cast devastating spells, and watch the chaos unfold.

games.name: Warp to Sector One
games.summary: Trade, fight, and explore a procedurally generated galaxy in this deep space trading game inspired by 80's sci-fi computer screens and early text based space games. Command fleets, negotiate with alien factions, colonize planets, and forge your legacy across five unique career paths.

games.name: Yet Another Incremental Game (But This Time About Coding)
games.summary: Yet Another Incremental Game (But This Time About Coding) is an idle clicker about... coding (thanks, Captain Obvious). Smash your keyboard, spawn code, and discover the questionable joy of programming. No actual skills required.

games.name: [Stories to Tell]: The Stoneville Incident
games.summary: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...

games.name: 101 Cats in Budapest
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Budapest landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: 70s-style Robot Anime Geppy-X
games.summary:
Originally released exclusively in Japan in 1999, 70s-style Robot Anime Geppy-X became one of the most outrageous and ambitious anime shooters of the CD-ROM era.

Built at the height of the late-90s CD-ROM boom, the original PlayStation release spanned four discs and featured over 8,000 hand-drawn animation frames, truly an unprecedented production scale for a 2D shooter.

This wasn’t just a game inspired by anime—it was a full-blown 70s super robot TV series you could play!

games.name: A Game About Chopping Trees
games.summary: A Game About Chopping Trees is a meditative experience built for those who find peace in simple tasks — wrapped in a chill and relaxing atmosphere where there are no timers, no pressure, and no stress. At its heart, this is a game about the pure joy of chopping trees.

games.name: All But Weak
games.summary: All But Weak is a Couch Coop Roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Mix elements, stack crazy weapon modifiers, and try to survive the madness with your friends.

games.name: Am I OK?
games.summary: A horror game inspired by Exit 8

games.name: Ascension: The Infinite Descent
games.summary: Descend into the abyss, navigate the dungeon, collect cards for your custom loadout, and fight monsters in turn-based combat. Death is only the beginning—use Rebirth to gain permanent attributes that scale everything you do, and dive back in to try again.

games.name: Backpack Dungeon
games.summary: A unique pixel-art backpack management roguelike. Your backpack isn't just storage—it's your combat core. Item placement, adjacency, and trigger mechanics determine your survival in the dungeon. A mental challenge of spatial planning and strategy.

games.name: Beat Slicer
games.summary: Slice through the rhythm in Beat//Slicer, a hyper-reactive synthwave rhythm game where your music controls the action. Load any track, customize your grid, and choose from three distinct game modes. Slice with precision, build your multiplier, and master the neon horizon.

games.name: Bogatyr: Survival of the Worlds
games.summary: Bogatyr: Survival of the Worlds is a 2D action roguelite inspired by Slavic folklore. Fight endless hordes of enemies in zero gravity, develop unique heroes, collect equipment and artifacts, explore new worlds, and defeat powerful bosses. Each hero has their own abilities, playstyle, and permanent Path Tree progression.

games.name: Brainrots Evolution
games.summary: Destroy, collect pets, and evolve your creatures!

games.name: Caddywack
games.summary: In caddywack, you race against the clock to whack a ball into the goal with your car; in this physics-based car puzzle game, you play through 18 different levels, each with its unique set of challenges.

games.name: Caution Wet Paint
games.summary: A game about watching paint dry. Don't touch the paint while it's wet, or you lose!

games.name: Chronicle of Wuxia & Xianxia Survivors
games.summary: Chronicle of Wuxia & Xianxia Survivors: A roguelite pixel survivors-like integrating card combos and explosive numbers. Choose from dozens of martial & mystical techniques, place and embed your Star Atlas. Grow stronger, face greater challenges. Grow stronger, rise in the Dharma-Ending Age.

games.name: Clout Chaser
games.summary: Clout Chaser is an idler/incremental game where you chase fame.

games.name: Colorful Slots
games.summary: Colorful Slots is a short incremental game where you play slot machines to achieve increasingly higher scores.

games.name: CoreBreaker: Desktop Swarm
games.summary: A corner screen incremental brick-breaker where bouncing cores destroy endless swarms. Let it run in the corner of your screen while you work or jump into fullscreen and take control yourself. Unlock new Cores, expand your skill tree, survive endless waves.

games.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
games.summary: All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game Cozy Grove, where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

games.name: DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition)
games.summary: Experience the ultimate re-imagining of the classic DVD screensaver game. With updated next gen visuals, modernized gameplay, and a reimagined storyline. The wait is finally over. For a new generation.

games.name: Deathloop 4 You
games.summary: A college student, Hayato Ichijo, is imprisoned. This is an infinitely enduring prison of death.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: Digimon Up
games.summary: The newest Digimon raising and training simulator on mobile phones. Choose your partner Digimon, feed it, train it, and help it Digivolve into stronger forms!

games.name: Dino Quest VR
games.summary: Step into the world of Dino Quest VR, an adventure where exploration, survival, fossil hunting, and dinosaurs come to life around you.

games.name: Dropoff
games.summary: Work as a postman for a company, then build an empire ran by you, cause that is cool.

games.name: Edd Skeleton VR
games.summary: You told Edd Skeleton that his game was a lot of fun and not boring at all, and that it was really scary... that you would never want to stop playing it and that it was the best game of all time... here's another one for VR!

games.name: Farmers Market
games.summary: Grow crops, watch market prices shift, and sell at the right moment to nourish the people in your village.

games.name: Flash and Die
games.summary: You've been hired by a real estate agency to take photos of their listings at night to give them a unique look online. Grab your camera, step into dark, quiet rooms, and capture every shot before the house notices you. Finish the job or never leave.

games.name: Hamish
games.summary: Hamish is a fast-paced, momentum-driven action platformer where every step could be your last. Run, jump, and grapple your way through rising lava, snowy peaks, neon-lit cities, and more, mastering speed and precision while taking down ruthless enemies.

games.name: Hong Huang Evolution
games.summary: A top-down lightweight Rogue-like survivor game where players take on the role of a beast capable of evolving multiple times to fend off hordes of enemies. Choose from various evolution paths, talents, and skills build, survive against all odds, and ultimately evolve into the ultimate life form.

games.name: How it was to live Guadalindie 2026
games.summary: A flickgame from memories of Guadalindie 2026

games.name: Hue Factory
games.summary:
Hue Factory is a minimalist automation game about color theory. It’s just you, some conveyor belts, and a stream of colorful boxes waiting to be sorted.

Find Your Flow. Start with simple inputs and route them to their destinations. As your factory grows, new colors appear, and your factory will need to evolve.

games.name: Hypatia
games.summary: A story-driven romance visual novel about saving a café on the verge of closing, featuring heartfelt heroine routes, meaningful choices, and lively Spine-animated characters.

games.name: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard)
games.summary: Dig through junk, find rare parts and lost collectibles, rescue dogs, complete odd customer orders, hire helpers, and relax as you slowly rebuild your dad's dream car in this cozy junkyard simulator.

games.name: Incremental Epic Hero 2
games.summary: A mixture of incremental/idle and roleplaying game set in fantasy world filled with monsters and things to explore, where battling is constant, almost everything can be upgraded, and with wide array of various prestige mechanics to always keep things interesting and moving forward!

games.name: Just Dying
games.summary: A 2D action Roguelite where you play streamer parodies and die on purpose. Unlock characters, stack relics, snowball into a screen-clearing menace, then watch it all collapse in 30 seconds. Learn. Die again.

games.name: Just a Regular Night Patrol
games.summary: 'Just A Regular Night Patrol' is a first-person simulation game. Over the course of 8 days, review and execute your daily tasks based on the instructions. No jumpscares or anomalies. The goal is to simply be an ordinary night security guard and complete your shifts without making mistakes.

games.name: Kami 2
games.summary:
The calming yet addictive puzzle game is back!

With over 100 hand-crafted puzzles, Kami 2 takes you on a mind-twisting journey that combines logic and problem-solving.

games.name: Le Mystère de la fleur de verre
games.summary: Leïla Cercis, a botanist, disappears just after announcing the discovery of a flower with miraculous powers. The investigation takes you through Paris, Rio, Kyoto, Tokyo, and then Geneva, using the real tools [used by the organization C’est vrai ça?]: reverse image search, AI-generated content detection, and source analysis.

games.name: Lewd Cup
games.summary: Lewd Cup is an 18+ football-themed visual novel where you run a private recovery studio near the world’s biggest tournament, building trust and tension with international stars through quests, call-ins, and replayable adult scenes in a cozy, character-driven sandbox.

games.name: Love-Colored Memories
games.summary:
Love-Colored Memories is a Touhou Project dating sim where Marisa suddenly realizes she's completely forgotten about Valentine's Day!

With White Day fast approaching, she'll have just a few weeks to train her stats, manage her daily schedule, and win the hearts of Gensokyo's unforgettable girls before time runs out.

Every choice matters as you balance self-improvement, explore familiar locations, and go on perfect dates, leading to unique romantic routes and multiple endings.

Whether your love story blossoms or crashes and burns, one thing's for sure: White Day waits for no witch!

This game was made in three weeks for Touhou Pride Game Jam 8!

games.name: Lux Anima
games.summary: A relaxing incremental tower defense where your defenses are flowers. Defeat incoming spirits, grow your garden, collect essence, unlock upgrades, and protect the Sacred Core.

games.name: Marsmare: Alienation
games.summary: Marsmare: Alienation is a thrilling adventure of an earthling kidnapped by malevolent aliens. Improve your gear and gain new abilities as you progress through the game. Encounter numerous enemies such as Martians, robotic spiders, space slugs and flying drones.

games.name: Master of Balance
games.summary: Are sudden promotions and superpowers a blessing or a curse? After an accident, your fate has been changed. Faced with eccentric bosses, difficult colleagues and relatives, the only way to keep the balance of life is to make careful choices so as to reclaim the initiative of your destiny.

games.name: Monochrome Echoes: Black
games.summary: Monochrome Echoes White Edition has been boldly reworked into Black Edition, featuring randomized dungeons for endless replayability and Character Creation that lets you use your own favorite images.

games.name: Monster Flipper
games.summary: Monster Flipper is a short incremental game where you buy and level monsters, smash them with a giant hammer for gold, and unlock swords and artifacts to automate your progress.

games.name: Murder Is Game Over: Final Fright
games.summary: A bite-sized mini-mystery adventure in the spirit of the Murder Is Game Over series!

games.name: Ninja Teleport
games.summary: Master the art of stealth and become the ultimate ninja assassin!

games.name: Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café
games.summary: Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café is a cozy and relaxed decoration and rhythm game where you manage a cafeteria and befriend cute animals.

games.name: Ouroboros Solitaire
games.summary: Face scaling foes in this endless deck-builder! Its elegant rules let you play for free with a real deck. Steam automates shuffling and modulo 13 math. Now featuring poker-style "Hand Bonuses" for instant kills , enemy "Bribes" , and powerful "Special Cards" for deeper strategy!

games.name: Peace Under His Roof
games.summary: Peace Under His Roof is a short psychological horror focused on atmosphere, sound, and the uneasy calm of a place that was never meant to feel safe.

games.name: Pigbert
games.summary: The Supreme Overlord has granted you the Award of Excellent Labour and you are required by law to accept it. Journey across the polluted, mushroom-farming nation to reach the palace, battling fanatics, enforcers, and desperate workers in turn-based RPG combat.

games.name: Poly Kingdom: Siege
games.summary: "Poly Kingdom: Siege" is a dynamic RTS taking you from a Native tribe to Roman Empire to Medieval kingdom! Engage in intense battles with siege weapons, traverse dangerous terrains, witness your empire evolve, and enjoy thrilling building destruction in this unique strategy game!

games.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
games.summary: "Papers, Please" meets zombie apocalypse. Command the last blockade, inspect survivors, and decide their fate: trust, quarantine, or liquidate. Expand your base, upgrade defenses, and fend off hordes. Every step shapes humanity’s survival. Your choice matters and every mistake costs a life...

games.name: Roll Together
games.summary: Welcome to the ultimate friendship test! Control a massive, unpredictable Roller with a friend in this chaotic physics platformer. One moves the left wheel, the other rules the right. Trust is a lie, communication is chaos, and falling down is half the fun. Can you roll your way up to the top?

games.name: Shellshock
games.summary: You are a British WW1 soldier, trapped in an endless looping trench. Inspect your surroundings and report anything that is out of place. Will you escape? Shellshock is a short anomaly hunting experience (-30 minutes) inspired by liminal spaces and psychological horror.

games.name: Solnox: Grimoire of Seasons
games.summary: Become the master of seasons in this tactical turn-based deckbuilder. Dominate the ever-changing battlefield by unleashing the four seasons and utilizing their terrain-altering effects. Learn to create perfect synergies & guide your three sorcerers to victory against unholy creatures.

games.name: SpiritVale
games.summary: A class-based action MMO inspired by classic RPGs. Explore a fractured world of monsters and ruins, build your own playstyle, and fight alongside friends in real-time, cooperative combat.

games.name: Star Ocean: The Second Story R
games.summary:
Two worlds, one fateful encounter.

In an endless sea of stars, at the edge of the universe, two people who live in different worlds go on a journey to save planet Expel.

Choose your path and witness an awakened destiny.

games.name: Stratapath TD
games.summary: Design a tower maze, upgrade, change their targeting with layered priorities and customize their abilities with 98 different options to fight against 8 factions each with their own abilities and boss over 16 maps.

games.name: Sudoku Haven
games.summary: Daily brain & logic puzzles. Find your calm in 450,000+ Sudoku puzzles — free and offline. A fresh daily challenge, real solving trainers, and 20 quiet themes. Unwind and start solving.

games.name: Teeto
games.summary: Teeto is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a tiny blob and bunny duo on an extraordinary journey. Absorb objects from the world, harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption and help out a cast of crazy characters in an action packed adventure!

games.name: The Apprentice
games.summary: Lost in an alien world, harness the power of runes to find your way home. Craft innovative spells, tackle intricate puzzles and uncover ancient magic. An immersive puzzle-adventure experience where exploration, strategy and discovery await.

games.name: The Final Shuffle
games.summary: Unjustly imprisoned and your wife kidnapped by a shadowy gang, you must escape captivity to hunt for the truth. In The Final Shuffle, navigate a dangerous conspiracy, solve lethal puzzles, and outrun your enemies. Can you save her and uncover the dark secret before it's too late?

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.summary: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Tower Command
games.summary: Strategic tower defense where you need to maximize your bonuses. Create your build, upgrade towers, link them, equip items to create ridiculous combos. Placement is key in this game, you decide the path enemies take to their goal. Explore all maps and unlock towers, commanders, traits and items.

games.name: Track Star
games.summary:
Track Star is a text-based track and field career simulation. Set in high school, you build an athlete from scratch, choosing your event specialty and allocating stats across eight attributes. Over four seasons — Freshman through Senior — you train weekly, manage energy, compete in regular season meets, and chase qualification for Class, State, Regional, and National championships.
Outside competition, a rivalry system tracks your history against recurring NPC opponents. A world events engine generates training flavor, program news, and breaking headlines that shift week to week. Achievements and milestone unlocks mark career progress. The game ends with an epilogue that reflects the full arc of your four years.
Track Star is a single-player game built for players who want the grind of a career sim without the overhead of a management game.

games.name: Trainz Simulator World Tour
games.summary: In Trainz Simulator World Tour you drive powerful trains across the USA, UK, and Australia with 4 detailed routes, 16 gameplay sessions, and iconic locos from steam to diesel. Your adventure starts now!

games.name: United2030
games.summary: United2030 is a third-person 3D action game that takes you on a journey through the near-future world of 2030. A female character explores various maps. The game's appeal lies in being able to explore realistic forests, near-future fortresses, and futuristic cities.

games.name: Void Ignition
games.summary: Void Ignition is an atmospheric incremental game tat combines satisfying "number-goes-up" progression with an unraveling sci-fi mystery.

games.name: Wabisabi SushiDerby
games.summary: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!

games.name: What Surrounds Us
games.summary: What surrounds us? Come find out and restore balance to an abstract and colorful ecosystem where every individual maters.

games.name: eBaseball: Pro Spirit 2026
games.summary:
The latest entry in the Professional Baseball Spirits series, "eBaseball: Pro Spirit 2026" has arrived.
Experience realistic baseball powered by the eBaseball Engine.
Every movement and sound inside the stadium is brought to life with remarkable realism.
From the flight of the ball and the players’ intense actions to the eruption of the crowd, every moment is recreated with impact. Combined with smooth, live-style play-by-play and commentary, the game brings you closer than ever to “real baseball.

games.name: 7 Days To Think About It
games.summary: A short spot the difference psychological horror game. Your friends invite you to hang out tonight - you have 7 days to think about it.

games.name: 99% Can't Spot It! Common Sense Battle
games.summary:
I'm sure I know this is exactly where you slip.
Can you spot the real thing among four images?

games.name: Arcade Archives: Syvalion
games.summary: The World of Syvalion, Changing with Your Play

games.name: Are We Sinking Yet?
games.summary: Are We Sinking Yet? is a chaotic co-op rafting game for 2-4 players where teamwork is the only way to survive. Paddle together to steer your raft, dodge dangerous river obstacles, solve environmental puzzles, and try not to throw your friends overboard.

games.name: Arma: Cold War Assault Remastered
games.summary: The genre-defining military sim that began as Operation Flashpoint (2001), now a modernized, 64-bit, cross-platform build for Windows and Linux, with its engine released as open source. Over 2 million copies sold. The Cold War battlefield of Everon and Nogova, remastered for today's hardware.

games.name: Assoluto Racing
games.summary:
PRECISION COMPETITIVE RACING
Assoluto Racing is the next evolution of mobile racing simulations.

REAL CARS
Race with beautifully modeled, officially licensed cars from the top manufacturers in the world.

TRUE RACING PHYSICS
The most realistic physics engine on mobile will give you unmatched control on the road and under the hood.

MADE WITH LOVE
Our small indie team of racing enthusiasts has lovingly crafted the most realistic mobile racing game on the market for you.

games.name: Asymptote
games.summary: A 2D top-down rescue-survival game set on Mars, where you pilot an anti-gravity craft, save stranded colonists, destroy hostile machines, and face unpredictable encounters shaped by upgrades, unique tools, story choices and mysterious game mechanisms.

games.name: Basic Kanji Meaning Quiz
games.summary:
Easy kanji questions for kids!
Pick the answer from 4 choices
and enjoy learning step by step!

games.name: Beneath The Hill
games.summary: Beneath The Hill is a first-person survival horror game about entering a cave beneath a village to investigate a strange beating heard below. The game focuses on lantern-based exploration, sound-sensitive goblin encounters, simple melee combat, and multiple endings.

games.name: Biomechanical Toy
games.summary:
Classic run-and-gun action in an explosive arcade adventure!

In Biomechanical Toy, you control the action hero Inguz, diving into a surreal world where toys have come to life as dangerous biomechanical creatures. Your mission is to traverse stages teeming with enemies, collect power-ups, and defeat the infamous Scrubby to recover the artifact that sustains this world.

games.name: Bird Brigade
games.summary: Become birds together with your friends — each one has different perks and stats, and some have unique abilities. Try various game modes and have fun in Bird Brigade. The game is inspired by AI-generated TikTok videos about Bird Game 3.

games.name: Bodian's Bay Wash
games.summary: A relaxing underwater VR cleaning simulator! Use pressure washers and scrapers to clean boat hulls, smash barnacles, and expand your very own underwater wash. Buy furniture, upgrade your equipment, and get ready for clients of colossal proportions!

games.name: Brewgether
games.summary: Brewgether is a coop brewery sim. Run your own brewery, manage bars and employees, trade with townsfolk for different materials used in infusing the alcohol, build houses and furnish them in order to rent them out. Expand your business with new locations, brewery stations, vehicles and more.

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

games.name: Cheat Death
games.summary: Play dice poker with the grim reaper in a dark strategic roguelite. Build powerful poker hands from cursed dice, stack upgrades, rig the odds, sabotage Death, and survive deadly mini-games with your life on the line.

games.name: Console Archives: Hercules no Eikou II - Taitan no Metsubou
games.summary:
"Hercules no eikou II Taitan no metsubou" was released by Data East in 1989 for an 8-bit home console.

This is a RPG game where you play as a hero traveling a vast world to defeat monsters who plot to dominate it.

Join forces with companions you meet along the way and restore peace and tranquility to the world.

games.name: Culdcept Begins
games.summary:
Led by dice. Ruled by cards.

A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

games.name: Daice
games.summary: DAICE is a unique merge of turn-based dice-powered combat with inventory management, a roguelite where you control an evergrowing AI Core. Purchase and pilot unique spaceships, load your dice into weapons and systems, and unleash devastating combos and shape your own strategy-driven story.

games.name: Dead Echo
games.summary: Explore eerie, atmospheric environments, uncover hidden secrets, and survive against an unseen presence lurking in the dark.

games.name: Dead Weight
games.summary: Challenge the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on the adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search for loot. Choose a class or create your own and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

games.name: Debris Zone
games.summary:
Debris Zone is a top-down multiplayer space shooter set in a galaxy of drifting wreckage, contested territory, and trigger-happy pilots. Jump through portals into a connected world of open maps, each packed with enemies, loot, and lurking bosses, then fight in fast, skill-based dogfights where managing your shields and hull is the difference between a clean kill and a trip back to the repair station.

Customize your ship with lasers, shields, engines, amors and drones, hunt for gear to push your build further, and take on towering boss encounters with serious rewards. Earn gems, gold, and experience as you complete quests, climb the ranks, and unlock prestige titles to flaunt above your ship - all in a persistent online galaxy where every other pilot is a potential ally or you next target.

Suit up, pilot. The Debris Zone is waiting.

games.name: Decide in 5 Seconds: Who Is the Culprit?
games.summary:
Just 5 seconds. Spot the culprit.
One person in the crowd is moving wrong — catch them.

games.name: Detective Mind Training: Mystery Choices
games.summary:
Solve each case with just one choice!
Train your observation and deduction skills
Quick mystery puzzles for sharp minds

games.name: Diceaster
games.summary: You won't beat this game — A die that destroys itself to climb. Each face is a hit. Use them all and you become a ball: fast, uncontrollable, doomed. A precision platformer with no checkpoints and global leaderboards.

games.name: Diggin
games.summary: Drill into the depths of a meteor crater in this incremental adventure. Mine ores, unlock upgrades and find the cosmic treasure that lies below! Can you uncover what happened to the Moles that came before you?

games.name: Dolls: The Hunt
games.summary: A cooperative survival horror game where you and your friends must survive being hunted as prey!

games.name: Doria & the Tide Song
games.summary: Save the music of the ocean and help a brave little mermaid find her voice!

games.name: Dreamin' Her: Boku ha, Kanojo no Yume wo Miru
games.summary: From the creators of Seven Days and Lost:Smile, Life0 presents their third game: "Dreamin' Her". In his dreams, the ideal girlfriend appears taking the form of his childhood friend. Is she really just a dream, or is she something more?

games.name: Dreamscapes: The Full Journey
games.summary: Immerse yourself in two atmospheric hidden-object adventures full of puzzles, dream worlds, and dark secrets.

games.name: Dungeon Slasher
games.summary: Dungeon Slasher is a roguevania pixelated side-scrolling action game, where you battle powerful enemies and bosses in thrilling 2D combat, utilizing the weapons and skills of diverse characters.

games.name: Eggconsole Harry Fox PC-8801
games.summary: A mother fox sets out on a quest to save her ailing cub. Through encounters with many animals and riddles to solve—can she make it back in time?

games.name: Elementers
games.summary: Level-up, unlock new abilities and elements to equip and try out in Co-op Pve Missions or Pvp.

games.name: Escape Game The Locked Elevator
games.summary: An escape game set inside a trapped elevator!

games.name: Falseflash
games.summary: A fast-paced VR panic game where you must stabilize a failing planetary control grid by hitting real fault signals, ignoring false ones, and surviving ten minutes of total system overload.

games.name: Farlands
games.summary: Congratulations, you've bought your own planet! An agrarian rock in the edge of the galaxy, which, for some reason, was almost given away for free. So the time has come to leave the hectic and stressful life of the overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.

games.name: Farm Factory Simulator
games.summary: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products and create a wide range of goods. Optimize your workflow with efficient production chains and smart business decisions. Expand your facilities and build the fully automated farm-to-market business.

games.name: Feather Land
games.summary: Feather Land is an idle game that blends productivity tools with a study/work companion. Enjoy calming music, hatch eggs, collect cute birds, and watch a quiet space into a landscape full of life, bringing peace and focus to your study or work sessions.

games.name: Fire Boy
games.summary: A hero who talks to the player in a comical way about his actions in the game, adventure in classic 2D platform style, are 5 worlds with different and challenging characteristics. Join the Fire Boy and help him recover all the dinosaur eggs that were stolen by the little monsters.

games.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: A workout that works for you – now enhanced for Nintendo Switch 2!

games.name: Frostrain 2
games.summary: Become the last conductor and rule over the final train society in a frozen world. Gather, expand, and forge your train while building powerful synergies with mighty artifacts. Your position—and the safety of your passengers—now rests in your hands.

games.name: Fruitgeddon
games.summary: Blast through hordes of adorable yet deadly mutant fruits in this intense space shooter with bullet hell action. Shoot, dodge, and survive unique boss battles that push your skills to the limit. Only the strongest will uncover the truth behind the chaos. Are you ready to save the universe?

games.name: Full Stride
games.summary:
Full Stride is a jockey racing game focused on first-person riding and skill-based race control.
Players manage speed, stamina, positioning, and timing while adapting to each horse’s characteristics and the layout of 3D racecourses.

games.name: Funnel Runners
games.summary: Trapped in a doomed city, you and up to 7 friends must scavenge parts, fix your van, and escape the brutal tornado that approaches. A first-person co-op survival game with escalating disasters and total environmental destruction.

games.name: Galdromeda
games.summary: Turn-based RPG with space combat. Assemble a crew, each having their own unique abilities, level up, upgrade your ship and your crew's abilities, collect new outfits for your crew.

games.name: Garden Eternal
games.summary: The cozy garden that keeps on growing. Garden Eternal is an idle clicker where you tap a glowing Heart, raise bees & buildings, and draft cards through every season. A calm place, mostly. But the garden keeps its own hours, and not everything that blooms after dark is a flower.

games.name: Ghost Keeper
games.summary: Become a Ghost Keeper and lead your fearsome minions against the living. Use diverse scare tactics, manage demonic creatures and harness dozens of skills. Oh, and don’t let the Brotherhood catch you! The ultimate scaring experience begins…

games.name: Ghost Strike
games.summary: Redefining Modern Warfare: Breach and Conquer the Uncharted Fortress

games.name: Go-Go Town!
games.summary: Step into the role of a hands-on mayor and build your town from the ground up. Plan neighborhoods, automate logistics, and grow your community—all while juggling workers, infrastructure, and day-to-day chaos to create your dream town. Play solo for total control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

games.name: Ground Branch
games.summary: From one of the developers behind the original Rainbow Six and Ghost Recon games comes a thinking man's first-person shooter featuring in-depth character and weapon customization. Take your time. Think ahead. Get the job done.

games.name: H.O.A Simulator
games.summary: HOA Sim is a comedic suburban patrol game where you enforce neighborhood rules as an overzealous homeowners association officer. Cruise the streets, inspect properties, issue citations, and chase your daily fine quota while balancing speed, accuracy, and pure petty power.

games.name: Happy's Humble Burger Cult
games.summary: The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive and extract your hard-earned cash to survive another shift.

games.name: Heave Ho 2
games.summary: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!

games.name: Hell Maiden
games.summary: Traverse the depths of Hell and beat its toughest demons on your way to Heaven in this horde survival deck-building game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy.

games.name: Hentai Nefiris
games.summary: Enter the world of ancient Egypt with the mysterious goddess Nefiris. Complete mini-games, unlock seductive anime illustrations, and reveal increasingly daring looks of the desert queen.

games.name: Hex Judge
games.summary: Hex Judge is a medieval narrative investigation game where players take on the role of an inquisitor questioning villagers accused of witchcraft. Gather testimonies, uncover contradictions, and decide who will be judged. Every choice leads to one of multiple endings.

games.name: Hold the Core
games.summary: Hold the Core is a roguelite tower defense game about trading safety for power. Draft Risk Cards, shape enemy routes, evolve towers, and survive deadly enemies and bosses.

games.name: Holonoptic
games.summary: As the new CEO of a derelict company, you must deal (or side) with rogue corporate AIs, rebellious labor unions and globalist aristocrats. Holonoptic combines economic simulation and party-based RPG into a story-rich corporate alpine cyberpunk.

games.name: Instant Sports 2
games.summary: Instant Sports 2 delivers fast-paced, easy-to-pick-up gameplay with depth for players looking to master each discipline.

games.name: Jack In Space
games.summary: A collection of fun space mini-games for kids

games.name: Japan Stigmatized Property
games.summary: Can you endure until morning Monitor Japan's stigmatized properties and report any paranormal activity If you miss a report or make repeated mistakes

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: Karjala
games.summary: VHS bodycam horror in the atmosphere of Soviet Backrooms. Karelia is a country of rivers, forests and lakes, where the modern world comes in contact with superstitions and ancient rituals. Soldier Solnyshkov agrees to take part in a strange experiment of his command.

games.name: Kawaii Anime: Cute Boys Magic World
games.summary:
Magic, minigames, and boys cute enough to cast a spell on you.
Play more, unlock more, fall harder.

games.name: Kitty Burger
games.summary: Kitty Burger is a cozy time-management simulation game where you run a burger shop together with your adorable cat assistant! Prepare delicious burgers, serve customers on time, and keep your little restaurant running smoothly. Between busy workdays, you'll meet different characters who visit your shop, each with their own stories, moods, and quirks. How you interact with them will influence the course of the game, unlocking unique story moments and multiple endings that shape the future of your little burger shop.

games.name: Kooo to Jump!
games.summary: A hardcore, voice-controlled precision platformer where you crow to jump! Sustain a continuous 'KOOO' to scale a brutal, foddian-style map. Scale 60 camera zones, conquer a massive world, and lose your dignity in this unrelenting rage game. Includes controller support and Practice Mode.

games.name: Kyoto Xanadu: The Blooming Phantom
games.summary: Set in an alternate reality where Kyoto is the capital of Japan, Kyoto Xanadu players take on monsters and mysteries coming from the great labyrinth known as Xanadu. As a student, players will challenge the labyrinth and grow through their battles within Xanadu while also deepening bonds with various people during your daily life. Uncover the truth hidden both in the labyrinth and Kyoto itself.

games.name: Letalis
games.summary: Letalis presents an unconventional RPG adventure, paying homage to the classics of the Game Boy era while infusing inventive gameplay, souls mechanics and unexpected twists!

games.name: Letter Snap: Term Challenge
games.summary: Letter Snap: Term Challenge – A fast, vibrant word challenge to test your speed!

games.name: Looking For Fael
games.summary:
Upon receiving a cryptic voicemail from your missing roommate, the ordinary confines of your apartment transform into a surreal labyrinth. Guided by his voice and a custom retro console in hand, embark on a journey to decipher the mysteries that have twisted your home into an enigmatic maze.

But beware. The further you venture into other realities, the harder it will be to find your way back.

games.name: Lootbag Tactics
games.summary: Pack your bag, set your strategy, and dominate the arena!

games.name: MTB Mavrix
games.summary: The ultimate multiplayer open world designed by Pro riders. Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?

games.name: Mafia Life Simulator
games.summary: Build your own empire in the world of the mafia! In Mafia Life Simulator, take control of everything from marijuana farms to weapon factories, money laundering centers to drug networks. Become the undisputed leader of the region with your gang and make your name known in the world of crime.

games.name: Meow Craft
games.summary: Cursed by the Demon Dragon, you—an adventurer cat—can no longer lift a sword! In Meow Craft, flex your paws to run a blacksmith shop, recruit cute staff, and arm heroes. If you can’t fight, forge the god-tier gear needed to break the curse!

games.name: Meta-Ghost: The Breaking Show
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the reality show — "Breaking Show", where you engage in real-time battles with various intelligent machines using cybernetic enhancements and weapons. Whether for personal gain or lofty ideals. Fight! Until you reach the final victory on this Roguelike journey.

games.name: Mobu
games.summary: Play as a monk wielding superpowers in this fast-paced arena shooter with roguelite elements. Survive waves of bouncy enemies raining from the skies as the challenge escalates. Buy upgrades and special abilities to create game-breaking builds and push back the chaos.

games.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
games.summary: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an enhanced compilation of Moss and Moss: Book II that replaces the use of virtual reality in those games with a new cinematic camera system. The game is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

games.name: Mystery at Rainy Night Manor: The Missing Invitation
games.summary:
A mystery in a rainy manor
Read the clues and observe
Find the hidden truth

games.name: Neko Michi
games.summary: Build and manage a cozy Meiji-era street for cats. customize buildings, balance tradition and modernity, and create a peaceful cat community

games.name: Noise Canceler
games.summary: APods — AI-powered earbuds that read your emotions and generate music. Drawn to these songs, five ordinary people find themselves moved to action.

games.name: Ore Factory Squad
games.summary: Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

games.name: Out Here
games.summary:
You take a job on a lonely island. Watch the sea. Report anything unusual.

But something feels wrong. And it's your job to find out.

games.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster
games.summary: When outlaws murdered your wife and took your daughter, everything you had was gone. Your gut aches for blood and sweet revenge. Dyin's too good for 'em now!

games.name: Pathogenic
games.summary: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

games.name: Petunia's Purgatory
games.summary: Petunia’s Purgatory is a creepy-cute, idle-farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Plant seeds that grow into horrifying crops, sacrifice animals for blood, and summon assistants to help you run your farm. Manage your sanity while you try to appease the Elder God!

games.name: Pimbolas
games.summary: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

games.name: Project Raze: Fall of Terra
games.summary: Project RAZE is a fast-paced sci-fi FPS where you play as humanity’s greatest creation, RZ-01 (RAZE) Feel every shot and every impact as you obliterate anyone bold enough to threaten the human homeworld, Terra Supremis.

games.name: Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll
games.summary: Shape the world to your will in lush landscapes inspired by Chinese watercolors in this Zen hex-tile building game that blends puzzle and roguelite elements with beautiful Asian aesthetics. Befriend mystical creatures in your journey while you make the world come alive beneath your fingertips.

games.name: Rail Estate
games.summary: Outbid your rivals in auctions for key railway routes, then build and upgrade tracks to dominate the rail economy. Players compete to create the most profitable network, balancing speed, capacity, and maintenance in a dynamic simulation

games.name: Requiem of Reuinis
games.summary: In "Requiem of Reuinis", you'll explore lost ruins, cleverly choose equipment and skills, collect resources to enhance yourself through alchemy and research, and strategically defeat various enemies. As you get deeper, you'll gradually uncover the truth of the"Calamity".

games.name: Ring Toss Legend
games.summary: Ring Toss Legend is a casual physics game where you toss rings onto prize pegs, earn coins, upgrade your skills, and chase bigger rewards as you explore new stages.

games.name: Runic Curse
games.summary: Action RPG in metroidvania style

games.name: Samurai Conqueror
games.summary: Conquer Japanese History! A “Historical Timeline Strategy” fought on the grand timeline of Japan

games.name: Science Trivia Quiz 100 Wonders
games.summary: Discover the science hiding in everyday life! Answer quick 4-choice quiz questions 100 wonders for kids and adults

games.name: Sharks
games.summary:
Swim, bite and attack using a unique locomotion method that only needs the movement of your head and one controller: look where you want to go, pull the trigger to swim, squeeze the grip button to bite. You won't believe how fluid and dynamic the shark motion is.
Hunt with groups of up to 10 people online. Eat whatever you can to survive and avoid the zombie sharks: last player standing wins.
