games.summary: An embroidered dark medieval folk tale. While life in a seemingly ordinary village is all about simple chores and idle gossip, sinister secrets hide below.

games.name: Silver Blade of Gods' End
games.summary: A region-conquest simulation RPG where bonds with your allies shape fate. —The choices you make, and the battles you fight, will determine how the story unfolds. Fast-paced tactical battles. A strategic map mode where your decisions shift the tide of war. Preparation and growth that change destiny.

games.name: Soulbound: Online
games.summary: You wake with no memory inside a world under the influence of the Anima. In Soulbound, slay hordes of enemies in roguelite dungeon runs, craft legendary weapons and build your base. Squad up for 3-player co-op, compete in clan raids for rare loot, and survive in a massive open world MMORPG.

games.name: Stackbound
games.summary: Stack geometric blocks into towering structures using physics and strategy. Combine deckbuilding mechanics with precision placement as towers grow taller and challenges intensify across persistent rounds.

games.name: Triple Pairing
games.summary: HOOKSOFT's 27th project. The gimmick in this title is about navigating a love triangle.

games.name: Vespera
games.summary: Vespera is a dark fantasy idle RPG. Fight hundreds of enemies, craft gear, build your character with talents, gems and elements, recruit mercenaries that fight with you, and take on world bosses with other players! Full offline progression. No microtransactions, you buy the game, you own the game.

games.name: Wanderers' Outpost
games.summary: A Colony-Sim in a dungeonpunk-fantasy world where you build outpost near ancient ruins, support adventurers, and tax their loot. Expand your outpost, survive waves of dungeon-born monsters, and ultimately conquer the depths before they consume the outpost.

games.name: Watch Yo Plane
games.summary: Pilot a chaotic plane with a friend in this co-op rage adventure! Work together, survive brutal obstacles, conquer minigames, and see how far your teamwork can take you.

Your family is murdered before your own eyes leaving you in a mentally debilitated state. You must now open your mind and accept the truth of what has happened to free yourself from a spiral of emotional degradation.

games.name: Aquapark Tycoon
games.summary: Build the ultimate waterpark paradise in this cozy simulation game! Design & customize water slides, pools, and saunas to fulfill your guests' needs. Combine creativity, strategy, and management to make a splash in the world of water parks and become the ultimate Aquapark Tycoon!

games.name: Arinoa: Conquest
games.summary: Arinoa: Conquest is a real time grand strategy game with a focus on hero units, and combines elements of strategy, resource management, and light RPG mechanics. Gather resources, build your army, and conquer your enemies within the harsh world of Arinoa.

games.name: Birds of War
games.summary: Birds of War is a 3v3v3 aerial PvP combat game featuring fast-paced bird-on-bird combat, egg-stealing objectives, and proximity voice chat. Players choose from unique bird classes, each with distinct abilities, and battle across chaotic multiplayer arenas. Developed by HexNest Games.

games.name: Blast'N Bounty
games.summary: Engage in retro vertical scrolling shoot’em up mayhem as Quad the frog bounty hunter!

games.name: Blinx: The Time Sweeper
games.summary: Blinx: The Time Sweeper is a platform game developed by Artoon and published by Microsoft Game Studios. It was released for the Xbox on October 7, 2002. A sequel, Blinx 2: Masters of Time and Space, was released for the Xbox in 2004.

games.name: Conker: Live & Reloaded
games.summary:
Conker, gaming’s notoriously naughty squirrel, arrives on the Xbox with a bang in an all-new Xbox Live-enabled team-based shooter, Conker: Live and Reloaded.

The game features intense Deathmatch and Campaign story line modes via Xbox Live and System Link, and players can compete as one of six combat specialists across multi-mission campaigns covering Old War and Future War. The warfare promises to deliver the non-stop action, humor, and innuendos Conker is famous for.

Also included is the critically acclaimed single-player game, Conker’s Bad Fur Day, completely recreated for the Xbox with stunning graphics and unparalleled attitude.

games.name: Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge
games.summary: Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge combines thrilling aerial combat with the swashbuckling style of a Hollywood action-adventure movie. Set in an alternate 1930s world of gunship diplomacy and sinister intrigue, Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge lets gamers pilot powerful aircraft against nefarious air pirates and behemoth war zeppelins. As the daring air pirate Nathan Zachary, leader of the infamous Fortune Hunters, players take off on a high-flying adventure, filled with daring escapes and damsels in distress.

games.name: Dirty Business
games.summary: Build a criminal empire from a hidden underground hangar. Produce drugs, craft weapons, print fake money, and more. Hire workers, expand your gang, upgrade your base, operate cartel airstrip and take control of city distribution solo or in co-op.

games.name: Donkey Jump: In the Loop
games.summary: Jump, build, and survive! Guide a goofy donkey through endless loops with card-based paths and unpredictable challenges.

games.name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Terror of Demogorgon
Earth New Fall
games.summary: Earth New Fall is a post-nuclear apocalypse suspenseful horror game developed by ThundyVT.

games.name: Fish to Cats: Catch & Feed
games.summary: Loads of fish! Loads of cats! Sail out to sea, charm every furball on Cat Island with fresh catch. Live your cozy ocean cat life!

games.name: Futbobo
games.summary: Futbobo is a free, mobile-first football career simulator for browsers, Android and Windows. Create a player at age 12, develop through a youth academy, choose any of 12 positions and build a unique career across 637 clubs, 36 leagues and 139 national teams. Seasons combine performance simulation with choices and consequences, transfers, loans, finances, sponsors, injuries, rivalries, social life, national-team tournaments and individual awards. Decisive finals and a standalone World Cup mode can be played as a button-football game with physics, penalties and goal replays.

games.name: Fuzion Frenzy
games.summary:
Fuzion Frenzy is a launch title for the Microsoft Xbox. At its core, Fuzion Frenzy is a four-player party game featuring 45 different mini-games (not including the titular Fuzion Frenzy). A demo of the game was included with some other launch titles in the US, including Halo, Munch's Oddysee, the first Project Gotham Racing game and Amped. The title was among the first to be released as a part of the Xbox Originals program.

A sequel was later released for the Xbox 360, entitled Fuzion Frenzy 2.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Lost Chronicle
games.summary:
This is an original JRPG created exclusively for mobile devices by Bandai Namco Entertainment.

Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.

games.name: Gearplexed
games.summary: Enjoy playing with gears? Gearplexed is a constructive problem-solving game with a variety of gear-based puzzles ranging from opening gates to building factories. Build gear trains to get the right amount of speed and torque to the target gears and be careful not to lock up your gear train.

games.name: Good Night, Mare
games.summary: A bite-sized casual runner-action game. Become Mo, a fantasy creature. Dodge sweet dreams and munch only on nightmares as you run.

games.name: Hand of Fate: Hordes
games.summary: Hand of Fate: Hordes is a dark-fantasy bullet heaven auto-shooter powered by your strategic deckbuilding mastery. Survive the horde, forge your build, and unleash devastating attacks to escape a netherworld beyond the 13th Gate. Thrive in chaos!

games.name: Hex Harmony
games.summary: Restore the balance between Nature and Human using futuristic technologies. Each island is a true puzzle. Build thoughtfully, observe interactions, and shape a durable world in a calm and accessible experience.

games.name: Hopping Girl Kohane EX
games.summary:
Hopping Girl Kohane EX is an action puzzle game and players control Pogo Stick and aim for the goal in this action puzzle game.

The game is easy to operate with a single thumb, yet offers a hard-hitting, authentic action experience. The key to the game is the mysterious stamps with various effects. Step on the stamps skillfully and aim for a high score!

games.name: Jenny the Witch
games.summary: Something evil is brewing deep below New York City and Genevieve Marconi has been hired to uncover it. Shoot and slash your way through an army of robots in this standalone story set in the Steel Carnelian universe.

games.name: Kepler 186F
games.summary: In Kepler 186F, survival is just the beginning—you must investigate. Your choices shape the story, unfolding a thrilling adventure from the planet's dark side to its space station.

games.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.

games.name: Life's Too Short
games.summary:
In Life's Too Short, you take on the role of a celestial marriage councilor as you're tasked with repairing a rift between two vampires who have dramatically fallen out and confined themselves to their respective coffins...

You'll need to explore the mansion, meet various spooky characters and solve simple puzzles in order to put the mansion back together and mend the rift in the vampires' relationship!

games.name: Lifted
games.summary:
Step into the Anytime Elevator and get LIFTED — a cinematic single-player 2.5D puzzle-platform adventure from a former Disney ride designer.

Slacker Ari Buktu only pokes his head into Professor Raventhorpe’s lab for extra credit; seconds later he’s hurtling through history on a reckless mission to steal a legendary tiara and fix the professor’s love-life. Each stop opens a new era, a bigger puzzle, and the shadow of a rival tomb-raider who’s always one jump behind…

games.name: Lost in Tandem
games.summary: In a post-apocalyptic world, a young girl and a defective robot called "Mech-ute" band together in order for him to fulfill his mission. Lost in Tandem is a colorful, relaxed-paced, 2D adventure-puzzle game, which can be played by one to two players via couch co-op.

games.name: Love is a Demon
games.summary: Love is a Demon is an adventure game packed with romance, chaos, and supernatural surprises. Confess your crush, dodge demons, and embrace the mess; love has never been this complicated. Your choices shape Ash’s love life in this heartfelt, hilarious story-driven experience.

games.name: Mabinogi Mobile
games.summary: Made by Naak, "G1 to G3" producer of original PC mabinogi. Mabinogi Mobile embarks on amazing adventures, build lasting friendships or even find romance in this unique social MMORPG, where a welcoming community with thousands of devoted players await! Whoever you are, or whatever your heart’s desire, come express it in Mabinogi Mobile and start living your fantasy life!

games.name: Nightmare Frontier
games.summary: Behold the first-ever Tactical Extraction Looter where you pit your courage and leadership against fears made manifest: the Dreadweavers. Lead a band of scavenger roughnecks into a devastated boom town of the alternative 1900s. Get in, face the monsters, grab what you can carry and get out. Alive.

games.name: Offbeat
games.summary: OFFBEAT is a music-tycoon game where you build the recording studio of your dreams. Collect and upgrade increasingly strange musical objects, complete jobs for cash, and record real, actual music.

games.name: One More Spin
games.summary: An incremental slot machine clicker. Every click is a chance to win big, so don't stop! Go for one more spin.

games.name: Oryo
games.summary: A comprehensive online roleplaying sandbox game that focuses on player-driven story telling and spontaneous roleplaying experiences.

games.name: Pass the Fear
games.summary: Pass the Fear is a roguelite bullet-hell shooter. A catastrophic Witch’s Disaster strikes without warning, and chaotic magic forms the ancient Wall of Storms. Its corruption spreads relentlessly across the island. As a demon hunter trapped within, you must find a way to escape before dawn breaks.

games.name: Pickochet
games.summary: Pickochet is a short, incremental mining game where you mine ore, upgrade pickaxes, unlock abilities and discover new mining sites.

games.name: Planticulture
games.summary: Planticulture: Another Garden Game is about using companion planting to grow your garden, collect plants, unlock decorations, and fill your journal. Play idle or active, chaotic or controlled, and make the space your own.

games.name: Random Isles
games.summary: This is a world filled with a vast amount of random elements. Obtain random equipment and skills through card draws, use maps to enter random stages (you may even enter reward stages that require no combat at all). Continuously acquire stronger items to challenge tougher stages and bosses.

games.name: Reap and Rush
games.summary: Reap and Rush is an absurdly addictive action roguelike. Step into the role of an underworld envoy thrust into a chaotic underworld. Fight through hordes of Yaoguai, leveling-up skills to become a soul-harvesting reaper and unravel a shocking conspiracy across endless cycles...

games.name: Reapers Reception
games.summary: Manage a hotel for criminals, spot anomalies, and find out who killed your sister 15 years ago.

games.name: Scribble Hunt
games.summary: Paint the bunny man and blend into the scene like a chameleon! 2–10 player online hide-and-seek. Sample colors, match the lighting, tune your materials — disguise yourself to perfection and slip away right under the Hunters' gaze.

games.name: Shift at Midnight
games.summary: An online co-op horror for 1–3 players. Be wary: some of your customers are only pretending to be human. Question them. Check their paperwork. Don’t let them trick you; make one mistake, and you’d better board up, set traps, and hide.

games.name: Souls Inferno
games.summary: A minimalist soulslike with turn-based combat. Enter a cursed realm, defeat demonic knights, collect souls, and shape your build as you uncover a deeply interconnected world.

games.name: Sunward
games.summary: A deep, relaxed space-industry sim. Mine asteroids, refine raw ore into valuable goods, and trade on a living market while you build a modular station, grow a colony, and expand across the solar system and beyond into a freighter-linked empire.

games.name: Tears of Metal
games.summary: Tears of Metal is a medieval hack-and-slash co-op roguelike. Carve through hordes of enemies to reclaim your island with the help of your formidable Scottish battalion. As you advance deeper into the trenches, uncover more about the mysterious Dragon Meteor and the treacherous enemy invasion.

games.name: The Dream Of A Cockspur
games.summary: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's final researchers, you investigate a mysterious celestial body. The day before departure, the return boat is damaged, forcing an extended stay. Is someone playing tricks, or does the island want to kill all of you?

games.name: The Epic and Amazing Adventure of GleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX the Adventure Where GleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX Lives and Becomes King GleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX
games.summary: Play as gleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX and decide the best life for him to live.

games.name: The Life You Missed
games.summary: The Life You Missed — you achieved success, but lost yourself along the way. In an old house, you uncover someone else’s life — and your own. Relive memories and face choices in your dreams. Every decision shapes the ending.

games.name: Tower of Dreams
games.summary: Climb your way to the top of the tower in this vertical platforming roguelike! Bound off walls, discover fantastical items, and make use of Dream Knight's sword to bounce off of obstacles!

games.name: Wake the Beacon
games.summary: A short incremental game about firing bouncing shots, crushing geometric swarms, and upgrading your beacon to send its signal farther and farther.

games.name: Wild West Miner Simulator: First Gun
games.summary: After a savage animal attack leaves you stripped of everything, you crawl back toward a town that’s already forgotten you. Among dust, suspicion, and long shadows, you fight to reclaim a place in a world that would rather see you buried.

games.name: Your Happy Place
games.summary: You found My Happy Place. Did I find Your Happy Place?

games.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
games.summary:
Stranded after a brutal train crash, your survival begins now.

You wake amidst twisted metal and shattered carriages, trapped between steep cliffs and a vast lake. With only your wits and determination, you must explore, gather, and fight to stay alive for 28 days — until rescue arrives.

Every decision counts. Every resource matters. Will you endure?

games.name: 7 Shifts in Subway
games.summary:
Every night shift follows the same route. Every passenger follows their own rules. Break just one… and they stop being human.

Take the role of a night subway driver trapped in a nightmare where every passenger hides a deadly secret. Observe, remember, and follow an ever-growing list of mysterious rules to survive all seven shifts. Every mistake has consequences, and every new night introduces horrors you've never seen before.

games.name: A Game About Getting Bigger
games.summary: A Game About Getting Bigger is a loot-driven incremental game about feeding a growing black hole. Destroy celestial bodies to make the black hole at the center grow larger and larger.

games.name: A Love Letter in Snowfall
games.summary: A Love Letter in Snowfall is a live-action, multi-ending interactive romance movie game. As a young B&B keeper in a small southern town, you meet, and fall for a visiting actress every choice rewrites your love story. Meet someone, and fall in love that trembles in bones.

games.name: Aether Crown
games.summary: A fantasy visual novel with simulation and turn-based RPG elements. Manage Carl's schedule, complete guild requests, build relationships, develop his stats and equipment, and make choices that lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Armadillo Racing
games.summary: Never Seen Before?! An Active Racing Game!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Mouser
games.summary: Put those nasty mice to rest!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Armadillo Racing
games.summary:
"Armadillo Racing" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1997.
Control an armadillo that rolls as it picks up speed, and head for the finish line through obstacle courses filled with unique events, or sprint courses designed for pure racing enjoyment. Finish in 1st place and you can enjoy a fun bonus game, too!

games.name: Atomcraft
games.summary: Adventure in a world where every pixel is physically and chemically simulated! In this ever-evolving sandbox, creativity meets chaos, and the only limit is your imagination!

games.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
games.summary: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

games.name: Battle Echoes
games.summary: Take command of the mech and become the ultimate strategist. Construct impregnable defense facilities, handpick potent skills, lead your troops, and defy relentless enemy assaults. Will you emerge victorious in this thrilling battle for supremacy?

games.name: BloodSpire
games.summary: You are a cat surrounded by monsters inside a castle tower. A fast-paced action Cat-Roguelike with card upgrades and unique abilities.

games.name: Bobble Shop Simulator
games.summary: Take control of your very own bobble head shop. Sell, buy, trade, and repair a large variety of bobble heads and related merchandise. Stock shelves, hire employees, and grow your business. Pay attention though, as these bobble heads sometimes have a mind of their own.

games.name: Bomcat
games.summary: Throw bombs and charge ahead! In this stage-clearing action game packed with respect for 80’s arcades, rescue the lady imprisoned in the factory!

games.name: Bone Marrow 2
games.summary: Merge cards to upgrade Upgrade your character Defeat all monsters

games.name: Car Sales Simulator
games.summary: Car Sales Simulator is the ultimate dealership game where you become a true car dealer and build your own automotive empire. This is more than just a selling game - it's a full-on trade and business simulator experience!

games.name: Carnival Hunt
games.summary: Carnival Hunt is an asymmetric multiplayer horror game set inside a living, ever-shifting mechanical carnival designed by the Puppetmaster. One player becomes the Carnival Monster, while others play as puppet Bunnies struggling to survive, ascend, and escape the hunt.

games.name: Celestial Descends
games.summary: "Tianlin Hunyuan" is a Chinese-style Xianxia SRPG with chess strategy and Roguelike elements, set in an open world. Players uncover lies and pursue freedom in a complex world of deep emotions and power struggles, embarking on an epic strategic and emotional adventure.

games.name: ChatGladiators
games.summary: ChatGladiators is an interactive Twitch battle game for streamers where viewers become fighters. Streamers connect their Twitch account, start a battle, and let their community compete for victory in an arena.

games.name: Chilling Urban Legends
games.summary:
Behind every scary rumour lies a hidden "truth."
Find the chilling clue inside a single picture.

games.name: Club Soko
games.summary: Navigate your way deep into an underground nightclub and discover secrets hidden in its depths.

games.name: Coin Tavern
games.summary: Coin Tavern is not your average tavern! In this roguelike game, you’ll wield a wild array of quirky coins to build your one-of-a-kind coin deck. Hoard coins, refine strategies, streamline your deck, unlock hidden treasures, and land outrageous combos in randomized runs!

games.name: Coloring Pixels: Collection 7
games.summary: A relaxing coloring-by-numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with different themes, levels of complexity, and sizes.

games.name: Console Archives: The Conveni
games.summary: Aim to be top of The Conveni in town!!

games.name: Cubic Riders
games.summary: You can't imagine how fast Cubics can be! Try them out and test your skills.

games.name: Cultic
games.summary: You died? So what? Tuck your guts back in and gear up to fight your way through the ranks of a mysterious and twisted cult. You, your guns, and your dynamite will have to shoot, slide, blast, duck, dodge, and maybe throw a gib or two to survive in this old-school-inspired shooter.

games.name: Dancers
games.summary: Reach for the stars!

games.name: Dancers
games.summary: Twirl and weave, move in harmony

games.name: Dewdrop Dynasty
games.summary: Run, dash, and crawl your way through a fast, Metroidvania. Battle with giant bosses, find new guns and abilities, meet quirky characters, and most importantly find your way home.

games.name: Dino Jump Deluxe
games.summary: Race against time in this frantic, side-scrolling endless runner. Master simple, high-speed controls to unlock a roster of mechanically distinct dinosaurs and a variety of biome colors. In Dino Jump, every collectable counts toward your ultimate prehistoric evolution.

games.name: Dinoblade
games.summary: Dinoblade is an action RPG game that takes place right after a major event that changed what we know about Dinosaurs. You shall set out on a journey as a young Spinosaurus that can use a Great Sword fighting against other Dinosaurs that uses weapons as well to stop an extinction.

games.name: Disgaea Mayhem
games.summary:
Disgaea Mayhem is a brand-new 3D action RPG from an all-star team consisting of director Shunsuke Minowa, character designer Takehito Harada, and composer Tenpei Sato.

In this game, players will be able to experience the exhilaration of defeating enemies with overwhelming power that defies convention—unleashing flashy techniques with simple controls, completionist elements like leveling characters up to 9,999 and “reincarnating” them to grow even stronger, and developing overpowered stats that let them deal over a billion damage.

games.name: Dodo Duckie
games.summary: Aliens abducted your chicken friends! Play as Dodo, a brave but slightly clueless duck on a mission to bring them home. The twist? Swap between 2D and 3D perspectives INSTANTLY to solve platforming puzzles and explore a cozy, charming world full of surprises

games.name: Doomsday Diner
games.summary: Chaos! Cooking! Combat! In a post-apocalyptic world where hot dogs are cheap and life is cheaper, you manage the last functioning hot dog diner. Cook hot dogs, brew coffee and serve bizarre orders. Upgrade your diner and shoot down raiders who want your hard-earned cash.

games.name: DragonSword: Awakening
games.summary: Explore the anime-style open world of the Continent of Orbis, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5! Recruit unique companions, unleash spectacular Status Ailment tag-team action, and embark on an epic journey to save the world from the threat of a Dragon reawakened after 60 years.

games.name: Dryad
games.summary: Dryad is an island-building adventure where management and exploration intertwine. Grow your sanctuary. Brave the unknown. Push back the darkness.

games.name: Echoes From Ciudadela
games.summary:
Echoes from Ciudadela is a first-person adventure and puzzle-solving game focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and narrative discovery. You play as Katari, who follows the trail of his recently dead father after uncovering his journal, that leads him to a sealed mountain known as Ciudadela.

Throughout the journey, your main artifact is a Balearic sling, a tool tied to both the environment and the forgotten technologies hidden within the mountain. As you dive deeper and solve puzzles, you’ll unlock journal entries left behind by Katari’s father. Each revealing pieces of a lost civilization and their connection to time, invention, and legacy.

games.name: Eggconsole Dragon Slayer Level 2.0 PC-8801
games.summary: Nihon Falcom’s classic Action RPG returns in "2.0"! Slay the three-headed dragon to retrieve the four crowns.

games.name: Ella's Nightmare
games.summary: Linear single-player game with puzzles and alternate endings. Control Ella and explore the rooms of the house, solving puzzles to progress and escape before becoming a victim of the lurking creature.

games.name: Fading Light and Summer's Shadow
games.summary: Uncover the hidden truth behind a summer festival in this Japanese-style story adventure.

games.name: First Snow
games.summary: Having moved away from her friends and family to attend community college, Allison Merlo is a fresh student struggling with the day to day challenges of life.

games.name: Flip-Flip Jigsaw Girls
games.summary: Clear Both Sides♪ A Cute Girl Puzzle Game Featuring the Unique "Flip-Flip" Challenge!

games.name: Foretales
games.summary: Decide the fate of the world in this ingenious story-driven card game. Foretales offers a unique take on the adventure genre, with a multitude of playstyles and story paths through which you can save the world… or bring about its end.

games.name: Full Metal Nun
games.summary: Sister Hel has seven seconds before her Grace runs out. Teleport and cross through gunfire, leaving explosive Martyrs in your wake. Draw sacred borders and invoke devastating Judgement bolts to purge waves of heretic machines.

games.name: GalactiWar: Empire Simulator
games.summary: Watch empires rise and fall, or intervene with godly powers, in GalactiWar, a space empire simulation sandbox game.

games.name: Gamble: Hard Exit
games.summary: Gamble for your family. Master the slot machine, pay off your debt, and save your family.

games.name: Girls Wars 1939
games.summary: An all-new squad of beautiful girl soldiers rewrites history in this one-of-a-kind World War II universe! A brand-new engine delivers an epic evolution unlike anything you've played before!

games.name: Green Thicket
games.summary: Relaxing exploration game where you wander through a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, and interact with the world at your own pace.

games.name: Grim Dawn: Fangs of Asterkarn
games.summary: In this latest massive installment of Grim Dawn, you will journey West into the rugged wilderness of Asterkarn and contend with the mighty Kurn. Discover the dark legacy that continues to haunt these nomadic people and again drives them East, towards renewed conflict.

games.name: Gurei
games.summary: An action platformer where you face challenging enemies inspired by Japanese mythology and acquire their powers. Choose your fights in any order, knowing that each opponent gets stronger as the game progresses!

games.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
games.summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign. Experience the original story rebuilt with high-definition visuals, updated cinematics, and refined controls, plus three brand-new prequel missions featuring the Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson. A broader arsenal of weapons, vehicles, enemies, and gameplay-modifying “Skulls” – optional modifiers that change combat in fun and challenging ways – add fresh tactics and endless replayability.

games.name: Hard Edge: War Zone
games.summary: Hard Edge is back as a 4v4 real-time tactical card battler! Combine strategic deck-building with simultaneous team actions. Every turn, draw cards to shoot, throw, or defend. Sacrifice cards to move in a high-stakes tactical "WAR ZONE."

games.name: Harvest Dice Profit
games.summary: Harvest Dice Profit is an Incremental Idle Farming & Dice Game where you grow diceshrooms into dice, roll for profit, and automate your economy. Stay ahead of debt... or face the consequences.

games.name: Helix: Descent N Ascent
games.summary: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

games.name: High Times
games.summary: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

games.name: Hololive Dreams
games.summary:
The first official hololive mobile game is here, featuring a rhythm & RPG gameplay!
Centered around rhythm games, the game includes a variety of content such as theme park development and mini-games!
Over 50 hololive members make an appearance, and the initial tracklist will include 150+ songs!
A game that both hololive fans and newcomers can enjoy. The way you play is entirely up to you!

games.name: Home Makeover: Hidden Object
games.summary: Find the hidden objects, sell them, and renovate your grandparent's home in this fun and inspiring hidden object game.

games.name: Hunted
games.summary: Run. Hide. Survive. A ruthless butcher stalks your every move in this tense first-person horror experience.

games.name: Hypnospace Outlaw
games.summary: Hypnospace Outlaw is a '90s internet simulator in which players act as Enforcers, volunteer moderators who scour Hypnospace's surreal network of weird and wonderful websites to hunt down wrongdoers while also keeping an eye on their inbox, avoiding viruses and adware, and downloading a plethora of apps that may or may not be useful.

games.name: Joe Adventure
games.summary: Keep moving or explode! Control multiple Joes to solve puzzles in order to save your siblings and Joe Mama from the grasps of the food factory!

games.name: KinnikuNeko: Super Muscle Cat
games.summary: A cat with the body of a bodybuilder fights against aliens in this 2D platformer with anime aesthetics.

games.name: Koko's Cafe
games.summary: Serve coffee and befriend customers as you learn their story in this coming-of-age visual novel.

games.name: Learn Through Riddles! Masterpieces of the World
games.summary:
A masterpiece is wasted if you only glance at it.
Solve the riddles, and the world's great paintings come alive.

games.name: LinkShift
games.summary: A abstract arcade-style puzzle game with roguelite elements in which you place Nodes on a grid to try and form big connection chains. Use Upgrades and Master Nodes to change the rules or break them.

games.name: Lost in the Fogbound Deadwood
games.summary: You are already lost. Most will never escape the Deadwood. Dense fog slowly destroys your sense of direction, your confidence, and eventually your mind as you search for keys, resources, and escape routes. Escape within 60 minutes… before the Deadwood consumes you completely.

games.name: Luminas: Parasite Reign
games.summary: A single-player, party-based roguelite where you control up to 3 heroes at once. Face relentless enemies and unique bosses, unlock powerful treasures, and forge new builds through multiple skill paths. Each run offers fresh upgrades, combos, and strategic choices in your fight to survive.

games.name: Luna: Obscura
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game of hiding, solving, and surviving inside a haunted moon base

games.name: Market Empire Simulator
games.summary: Market Empire Simulator is a business management game where you build, run, and optimize your own supermarket. Manage inventory, hire employees, stock shelves, and expand your store to create the ultimate shopping experience.

games.name: Memory of Memorie: A Chill Story
games.summary:
The more you focus, the more the story unfolds.
A chill work adventure with a girl from another world.
Focus time no longer spent alone, for you.

games.name: Momoka (wo) Wasshoi
games.summary: Safely escort the intoxicated person to her couch at home. This is a 2D action game where you avoid obstacles by jumping and deliver the drunk Momoka to her sofa after arriving at her home by pressing the button at the right timing to launch Momoka!

games.name: One Rainy Night
games.summary: One Rainy Night is a puzzle platform game in which you investigate the mysterious disappearance of the inhabitants of Sleepy Falls.

games.name: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni itsu no ma ni ka Dame Ningen ni Sareteita ken: Memorial Vacation
games.summary:
Let's share a sweet and frustrating trip to Okinawa together.
The TV anime "The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten" is getting on its first console game adaptation. The bittersweet love story of the original work is fully captured in this original story.

games.name: Pet World
games.summary: Collect awesome pets, farm tons of gold, and discover Magical Kingdoms!

games.name: Pixelwave Off
games.summary: Pixelwave Off is a backrooms-mascot horror game set in the 2000s.You return to search for your friend, who disappeared a few years ago.Find him and uncover the dark secrets hidden within Pixelwave Entertainment.

games.name: Professional Chef
games.summary: Transform simple ingredients into delicious dishes in Professional Chef. Buy, cook, sell, upgrade, and unlock new recipes. Optimize your processes, master every detail, and rise to culinary excellence in this engaging idle cooking experience!

games.name: Project Corner
games.summary: Project Corner is a fast-paced, tactical multiplayer Prop Hunt game where the classic childhood hide-and-seek hits a whole new level of tension and comedy.

games.name: Queen's Blade Re:Build
games.summary: A roguelite deckbuilder featuring strong, beautiful female warriors. We fused real time card games and roguelite together to make the exciting single player deckbuilder. Discover new cards and item, Craft a strong deck. Break your rival of all their armor and defeat them with a finishing move!

games.name: Reefling
games.summary: Reefling is a calm desktop aquarium that sits in the corner of your screen. Feed your fish with a click, earn shells over time, and collect over 150 pixel-art species. Decorate the tank and watch day turn to night. Your fish never starve and you can't lose, so just relax while you work.

games.name: Rubinite
games.summary: "Rubinite" is a dark fantasy boss rush action game that utilizes the unique mechanic "Focus" to pinpoint enemies' weaknesses and execute thrust attacks. Follow Ruby, a princess who has escaped from the Scarlet Kingdom, embarking on a journey of revenge to reclaim her kingdom.

games.name: Seven Deadly Sins: Anime Boys Fantasy Love
games.summary:
Seven sins. Seven boys. None of them willing to make it easy.
Are you ready to earn their trust?

games.name: Seven Deadly Sins: Anime Girls Fantasy Love
Silent Cleaning
games.summary: Move silently. Clean thoroughly. A 3D horror action and cleaning simulation featuring Kao’s real products. Clean the villa, solve hidden puzzles, and escape while your performance affects the home’s appraisal value. A unique blend of suspense and cleaning awaits.

games.name: Sniper Game
games.summary: Sniper Game is a first-person precision shooter built on a single idea: prove you are the best shot in the world. One handcrafted battleground, relentless escalating waves, and a global leaderboard scoring every shot. Two buildings, three rankings climb the World Championship.

games.name: Splatoon Raiders
games.summary:
Splat scores of enemies and hunt for treasure in this single-player focused action shooter.

Play as a mechanic working with Deep Cut – a trio of swashbuckling musicians – and venture out into the mysterious Spirhalite Islands! Customize your character, kit yourself out with mechanical gadgets and ink-splattering weapons, and take on waves of foes called Salmonids as you raid the islands for salvage.

This is mainly a single-player adventure, but you won’t be alone: one member of Deep Cut will raid alongside you in a powerful bot. You can also join with up to three other players online or via local wireless.

games.name: Square Brain Puzzle
games.summary: The more you think, the better it feels! Easy to play, deep enough to get hooked

games.name: Staffer Retro
games.summary: Staffer Retro is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

games.name: Steam Girls
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring many Steam Girls is here!

games.name: Super Goldfish Scooping
games.summary:
It's goldfish scooping like you've never seen it before!
Scoop up crazy goldfish one after another!

games.name: Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker
games.summary: Start with a small market and build a huge supermarket empire! In Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker, fill your shelves, satisfy your customers, make upgrades, increase your income, and grow your store. Click, manage, earn, and reach the top!

games.name: Switch the Darkness
games.summary: Memorize the room. Spot the anomaly. Flip the switch. If you miss a detail, the loop resets. A psychological horror where your attention is the only weapon against a shifting reality. Can you break the cycle?

games.name: The Chilling Moment You Realize It: Creepy Meaning Psychological Test
games.summary: The answer you choose reveals a hidden truth about you. And the instant you finish reading it — a chill.

games.name: The Deepest Castle
games.summary: You are a mighty knight - how powerful your blows are! And in the very center of a vast forest lies a fortress filled with evil and black magic. There, they raise the dead and hide great artifacts. You decide to explore the fortress and see what the black magicians are hiding.

games.name: The Lonely Miner
games.summary: A 2d pixel art incremental clicker/idle Mining game. You are dropped onto an Island, with a pickaxe and a dream. Collect rocks, sell rocks, hire workers and get rich!

games.name: The Others Will Join Shortly
games.summary: A variation on classic memory game in horror setting. Cards can change, you have to stay focused, catching replaced card is a life or death situation. Play the cards. Track the changes. Survive the week. Collect your pay check.

games.name: The Seven Crystal Petals: The Blossom Realm
games.summary: Embark on a heartwarming narrative adventure with Princess Yumi and restore harmony to the Blossom Realm.

games.name: TheVillage: Possession
games.summary: A cursed village serves as the setting for this single-player psychological horror adventure. As you are drawn into a demonic scheme, solve spooky puzzles, evade deadly spirits, and discover sinister secrets. first in the series TheVillage Chronicles.

games.name: They Came for Blood
games.summary:
They Came for Blood is a desk simulation game. Your goal is to make it through the month and make enough income to afford rent in your apartment. Greet donors at the blood bank, look at their ID to determine if they're good to donate blood, and either let them inside, or reject them for not meeting the requirements. Sometimes vampires try to slip in, which can spell disaster for the hospital staff. Let in too many vampires, and the staff will be picked off one by one until you're the only one left to suck dry.

There are multiple endings, and several decisions to make while sorting donors as quickly as possible. They Came for Blood has a branching save file system, in case you've realized you've made a horrible mistake and need to turn back the clock.

games.name: Tiny Witch
games.summary: Tiny Witch, is a little game about managing a minion store, where you must mix the right resources to build the minions needed by the dungeon masters.

games.name: To the Basement: Before
games.summary: Perform precise movements Defeat the bosses Complete the levels

games.name: Tolem
games.summary: Explore. Transform. Fight. Switch between robotic forms with unique abilities. Each form changes how you play.

games.name: Torii
games.summary: Torii is an adventure/puzzle/indie game with an artistical aproach. Full of surreal landscapes, strange creatures and emotions. It's an instrospective journey about the emotions that arise when coping with the loss of a loved one.

games.name: Tormentum II
games.summary: Tormentum II is a point & click adventure game taking place in a dark, surreal world full of gloomy characters and repulsive creatures taken straight from the scariest horrors.

games.name: Twofold
games.summary: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders whose rivalry seemingly threatens to tear their friendship apart.

games.name: Under His Eyes
games.summary: Under His Eyes is a gritty, story-driven strategy game where you play a crime boss. Make game-changing decisions, manage your crew and income, send operatives on missions, seize districts, and eliminate rivals. Will you rise through subtlety, rule with fear, or fall to a small-time gang?

games.name: Viral Reload EX
games.summary: Viral Reload EX is a sci-fi shoot-em-up with a unique dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom before he destroys the moon?

games.name: Void Future: Hacking Protocol
games.summary: In Void Future: Hacking Protocol, you play as a hacker in a cyberpunk world ruled by corporations. Hack, solve puzzles, and uncover a global conspiracy. Hunted by a system that never sleeps, you’ll need to stay hidden, outsmart surveillance, and fight to survive.

games.name: Wish Upon a Cat
games.summary: Embark on a delightful little romp through the worlds of various Odencat games to track down a dimension-diving cat in this short, heartwarming adventure.

games.name: Wonderia
games.summary: Wonderia is a MANGA style open-world sandbox for 1-8 players. Unique blend of sci-fi life-sim and dungeon exploration. Transform into alien adorably quirky creatures, craft, farm, fight, recruit space travellers, and build your cosmic adventure!

games.name: Worlds Upon The Wind
games.summary: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

games.name: Yog-Sothoth's Yard
games.summary: Manage a hotel and hire employees including Death, a dragon, a Demon-Slayer, and a bioroid maid. Build your wealth through various means and refine your strategies based on the predictions of Oracles. Your choices will determine which employees become enamored with you.

games.name: Zombie War
games.summary: Zombie War plunges players into a relentless battle for survival against hordes of the undead.

games.name: Zumba: Marble Jungle Adventure
games.summary: Awaken the jungle spirits—match, blast, and conquer the marble wilds!

games.name: Zyrcon
games.summary: A mouse-only, endless sci-fi arcade shooter with dead-simple controls — just aim and auto-fire kicks in. Shatter asteroids into plasma cores, wield three upgradeable weapons, freeze time, and survive endless difficulty scaling.
Click digits to subtract them by one. Rule 1: All dots must be enclosed by walls. Rule 2: Walled-off zones cannot be empty. Rule 3: Each zone must contain an equal number of dots.

games.name: Abyss Kitchen
games.summary: Abyss Kitchen is a survival action game in which you play the role of Lop a cook who accompanies a party of adventurers, and guides them with the power of food. Feed yourself in the dungeon and eat whatever you can to keep from starving and falling down. Eat up anything that stands in your way!

games.name: An Eggstremely Hard Game
games.summary: Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos. Work together to carry it through unpredictable challenges without breaking it, every crack makes it harder, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of honking.

games.name: Arctic Shift: Fuel Station
games.summary: Operate a remote fuel station deep in the Arctic. Manage customers, supplies and vital systems while surviving brutal weather, wildlife and isolation.

games.name: Ashbound Expanse
games.summary: This is a fast-paced first-person and third-person shooter that blends roguelike elements, offering easy-to-learn mechanics, satisfying controls, and intense gunplay. Combined with highly immersive visuals, it delivers a thrilling and exhilarating shooting experience.

games.name: Aster Pebble and the Case of Bad Bureaucracy
games.summary: A short and cozy point and click time loop mystery. Join Aster Pebble as she solves mysteries and helps those in need as she takes on her first adventure in a modern fantasy world. Overcome bureaucracy via direct action in this funny little adventure filled with intriguing oddball characters.

games.name: Astray: Zero
games.summary: A 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game. You constantly defeat monsters and advance to the next level. In the hand-drawn game world, you will fight alongside a girl named Zero, uncovering the truth of this game world during a fantastical journey!

games.name: B-Prison Unchain
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG, play as Misa, the supposedly strongest soldier in the Demon Realm, as she hunts down the legendary incubus Asmodeus. Battle through the succubi prison, recruit allies, and survive nasty traps, but beware! The enemies sent after you have plenty of tricks to slow you down!

games.name: Backrooms Anomaly
games.summary: Explore a looping corridor filled with anomalies. Walk through the fluorescent-lit backrooms environment, examine your surroundings, and spot subtle changes in reality.

games.name: Black Goat
games.summary: The game is a BL Cthulhu-style narrative romance game. It tells the story of the protagonist struggling to survive on a cruise ship filled with strange events after losing their memory. The game's setting is modern with a Cthulhu-inspired narrative.

games.name: Boba Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Reborn at my venture's start. Last life, poor management got my milk tea shop crushed by rivals. At the door, sweet milk scent hit me, fired me up. Now, "Frost Citadel" aims to haunt the milk tea world. With my friend, we’ll set up to rule this street.

games.name: Bookbinding
games.summary: A quiet bookshop. A magical past. A murder and Tarot cards that can twist fate itself. Craft beautiful covers, read between the lines of your customers’ lives, and decide which secrets deserve to stay hidden… including your own.

games.name: Brave Escape
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling co-op adventure in 'Brave Escape,' a challenging platformer demanding teamwork to conquer perilous traps and treacherous terrain.

games.name: Brush Hour
games.summary: Race against the clock to copy a mini masterpiece, but you can only use primary colours; you must mix these to create any secondary colours.

games.name: Canvas of Thoughts
games.summary: Canvas of Thoughts is an cozy point-and-click puzzle adventure which invites you into Evi's vibrant but loud inner world. Experience everyday situations through shifting colours, sounds and emotions. Solve reflective puzzles and navigate the world not through words, but through feelings.

games.name: Car Parking Simulator 2026
games.summary: Challenge your parking skills.

games.name: Catio Simulator
games.summary: Catio Simulator is a casual incremental game with a satisfying gameplay loop: pet cats, adopt them out, collect adoption fees, and use the proceeds to upgrade your petting ability and fill your catio with new toys, plants, furniture, and expansions that attract even more cats.

games.name: Cave Looters
games.summary: Chill co-op cowboy adventure. Up to 2 players!

games.name: Check-In Chaos
games.summary: Run your own hotel — solo or in 1–4 player online co-op. Check guests in, cook and serve, run the spa and pool, hire staff, and upgrade your rooms from Standard to Luxury... before it all spirals into glorious chaos.

games.name: Codename Cure II
games.summary: Codename CURE II is an upcoming co-operative first person shooter set in the aftermath of a zombie apocalypse. Create an elite military squad with up to five players and fight your way through hordes of zombies in a variety of dynamic objective missions.

games.name: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms
games.summary: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms is an open-world action war game blending hero combat and troop command. Lead legendary armies alongside allies to siege cities and claim vital resources. Forge alliances, crush rival factions, and seize the realm with steel and strategy!

games.name: Cosmic Mart
games.summary: Step into Cosmic Mart, the space supermarket where the deal of the day is certain death. Wipe out the relentless alien infestation devouring the facility in this frantic action roguelike. Choose your mercenary and survive long enough to reach the sixth floor.

games.name: Dawn Car
games.summary: “Pixel art” is too soft a word! This is the story of the Pre-Pixel Age… A dazzling world built entirely from 8×8 character graphics— the vibrant construction set of a Digital Tangram World.

games.name: Dice Gun Commando
games.summary: Guns roll dice. Dice trigger mods. Mods cause MAYHEM! Destroy waves of alien horrors in this bullet heaven roguelite by building an arsenal of dice-driven, synergistic weaponry.

games.name: Dino-Might
games.summary: Dino-Might is a 2-4 player party fighting game where you control a tiny-armed t-rex in a fierce battle! Use arcade-inspired movement and power-ups to eliminate opponents, all while avoiding hazards. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, and built for all gamers. Only the best dino will survive!

games.name: Discarded
games.summary: Discarded is action rougelike, arena shooter where you face waves of relentless enemies. You’re alone and outgunned - move fast, shoot faster, dodge the bullets and upgrade on the fly. Keep up with the pressure or get shredded like the rest.

games.name: Dot Clicker
games.summary: An immersive aim training game set in a Neo-Japanese landscape. It focused on season-based addictive precision challenges with rewards but also features a narrative alongside with a leaderboard for the top aimers and aiming communities.

games.name: Dreadweave
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a horror extraction shooter where you must escape a Soviet ghost town with a monster from an upside-down world tracking your heartbeat. Arm yourself, gather resources, and fight to survive. Death is just the beginning—it's your gateway to an inside-out reality.

games.name: Dream Grove Gardens: First Shift
games.summary: A top down RPG for Gameboy about a grub's first day as an employee at the greatest theme park in the world, Dream Grove Gardens!

games.name: FableBrawl
games.summary: FableBrawl is a web-based high-fantasy auto-battler. Draft a hero, recruit characters and spells from a changing market, arrange a seven-slot warband, forge golden characters, discover powerful treasures, and outlast an eight-player realm in automatic tactical brawls. Play solo, gather friends in private rooms, or enter skill-based matchmaking.

games.name: Fate & Inflation
games.summary: Fate & Inflation is a game that combines RPG roguelite elements with card building mechanics. Embark on a mysterious and unknown journey of fate, constantly strengthening yourself, and experience the thrilling charm of exponential combat power growth!

games.name: Find Us Cats
games.summary: Find Us Cats is a new hidden object game starring our favorite feline friends! Find dozens of cats in each level and aim for a high score in the Planetarium and San Francisco. Don't forget to try out the Painting mode! ️

games.name: Football 26 League Superstar
games.summary:
Football 26 League Superstar invites you into the heart of modern football — where ambition, strategy, and skill decide who becomes a legend.
Start your journey as a hungry newcomer with a modest squad and limited resources. Every match is a step forward, every decision matters. Train harder, think smarter, and climb from local victories to the grandest stage of world football. Your ultimate dream? Lifting the World Cup and proving you belong among the elite.

games.name: Gigils
games.summary: Gigils is an action packed multiplayer game where players will take on the role of cute alien creatures that bite, evolve, and brawl to capture control points. Choose your class, devour bugs or enemies to unlock powerful abilities, and grow stronger. Alien mayhem has never been this delicious.

games.name: Gnome Glade
games.summary: Gnome Glade - a cozy city builder puzzle with deckbuilding. Help gnomes build a village in a magic forest! Grow and merge mushrooms, build your deck of cards, and raise a golden statue. Create a gnome paradise!

games.name: Gym Rat Simulator
games.summary: Build a run-down local gym into a five-star fitness hotspot. Buy and arrange equipment, sell merchandise, hire staff, run fitness classes, train your character through workout minigames, and win competitions to grow your gym’s reputation.

games.name: Homauton
games.summary:
Trapped in a cramped landing pod with only a hibernation chamber and drone control computer, investigate the abandoned surface of a dead planet and build a rocket to escape before your family back home dies of old age.

Homauton is a tiny horror automation game where you are a new employee who was shipped to a job site on a dead planet but awoke from hibernation to find it completely abandoned.

games.name: Hotel Infinity
games.summary: In Hotel Infinity, you find yourself caught in a loop. To break free, you must detect anomalies. Once you locate an anomaly, you have to decide which direction to take; making the wrong choice sends you right back to the beginning.

games.name: Huntin' Buddies
games.summary: A 4-player online co-op hunting game set in a forbidden national park. Hunt wildlife to meet dangerous quotas, drag massive carcasses with your friends and evade the creatures that begin hunting you back.

games.name: Infinitevania
games.summary: Explore different worlds, defeat enemies and challenging bosses, in search of power to destroy the core of infinitevania.

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Okgyecheon
games.summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

games.name: Kyuukyuu Enshi
games.summary: A story-driven exploration horror adventure set in a fictional modern-day Japan. Experience a quiet tale of psychological horror as two schoolgirls confront folklore, curses, and choices that lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Legacy of Shadows
games.summary: "Legacy of Shadows" is a Wuxia roguelite. From avenging your fallen sect to unraveling the "Eternal Dragon" conspiracy, master fluid builds to cut through a world of intrigue and shatter the eternal scheme.

games.name: Limitless Survivor
games.summary: Incremental roguelite with infinite progression. Collect powerful artifacts, gather crystals, and scale your stats to absurd levels. Let auto-play handle the grind anytime—even while you're away.

games.name: LouveSystems' Realms
games.summary: Realms is a strategy game where all actions are taken simultaneously then resolved all at once. With up to 8 players, there's no waiting for your turn here. Battle for land and for riches, upgrade your kingdom and follow your strategy to conquer other realms - become the one to rule them all.

games.name: Mad Taxi Simulator
games.summary: Please rate your trip!

games.name: Mall Together
games.summary: Run your mall. Open new stores, sign contracts with leading brands, hire teammates, and meet customer needs. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your mall.

games.name: Mammon’s Wager
games.summary: Mammon’s Wager is a narrative puzzle game blending psychological horror with resource management. Wager your remaining life at the demon's machine. When funds run low, choose to pawn memories, emotions, or organs. Every exchange weighs human value. For rebirth, how much of your "self" will you pay?

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
games.summary:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

games.name: Maze 95 Ultimate
games.summary: The maze that hypnotized a generation is back. It was a screensaver. But now? You can finally walk those halls yourself. Or just relax and watch, like the old times.

games.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Frost & Flora
games.summary: Join cute cats in a cozy getaway! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a snowy winter village and a peaceful Japanese cherry blossom park.

games.name: Model Kit Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.

games.name: My Tasty Husband
games.summary: Murders quietly upend May's life. A strange husband, a reckless courier, a dutiful officer—reality and hallucination blur together. In this narrative adventure of food, intimacy, and death, make choices as May and reach her ending. If she can still tell what she's eaten from what she's loved...

games.name: Nebulis Entity
games.summary: Nebulis Entity is a first person spaceship crew simulator, with support for online co-op. Maintain your vessel, track down and decode alien signals, and venture as far as you can - while doing your best to prevent your ship from falling apart around you.

games.name: No Fox Season
games.summary: One rainy day you come home from the store and find a wounded fox on the road. In spite of your strict parents who forbid you to have pets, you decide to take her in.

games.name: Oceanic Rails
games.summary: Oceanic Rails is a game about building your island and creating combinations of crops, helpers, animals, modifiers, upgrades and more to pay your rent at the end of the week. Try out challenges and overcome the tricky weather or build you island worry free and create a beautiful pixel art world.

games.name: Once Upon a Throne of Thorns
games.summary: A dark fantasy boys' love / yaoi visual novel about an assassin who falls for the runaway prince he has been entasked with killing.

games.name: One Map: Never Ending Battle Royale
games.summary: One Map is an online shooter where the entire world fights in the same never-ending battle. No lobbies, no waiting—just instant action. The dynamic map adjusts to the player count, ensuring non-stop combat. Survive, compete, and help break the world record for the most players online in a game.

games.name: Organize My Shop
games.summary: Bring flawless order to the store! Switch between shelves and find the right items in the pile on the conveyor belt. Sort cheeses, meat delicacies, aromatic pastries, and sweets strictly according to the labels. Enjoy the moment of perfect order!

games.name: Overtime
games.summary:
it's an apocalyptic future where blood-hungry monsters run rampant, and in these dire situations you have to do whatever it takes in order to survive, even if it means going down one of the most physically and emotionally taxing paths out there: the fast food industry.

in "overtime.", you're put to work as a delivery boy for a multi-million dollar fast food chain and it's your job to fend off the horde, upgrade your arsenal, and power your way through 5 levels and 30 stages to hopefully earn enough money to escape back to normal civilization, or be kicked back into the streets to rot. and you don't want that, so GET TO WORK.

games.name: Papercraft Tactics
games.summary: In Papercraft Tactics, your backpack is your lifeline. Navigate branching paths, battle fierce foes, and collect powerful items to craft the ultimate loadout. With a dark, hand-drawn style, every choice matters in this thrilling roguelite adventure. Will you survive?

games.name: Phantom Floor
games.summary: You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

games.name: Ready or Not: The Deadline is Coming!
games.summary: Join Shiiba Masashi on an unexpected journey from fan to creator when his sister's eroge company faces an "emergency"! With childhood friend Miku by his side, they dive into game development, unraveling secrets, love, and their true creative passions along the way!!

games.name: Robo Miner: Remastered
games.summary: Dig deep, collect ores, and upgrade your robot in this remastered classic mining adventure with improved graphics and smarter gameplay.

games.name: RoboDeal Simulator
games.summary: Design, craft, and trade robots on the frozen world of Xylaris-9. Serve factions, upgrade your facility, and shape your robotic legacy in Robodeal Simulator.

games.name: Royal Pit
games.summary: Spin for your life, pay with your soul.

games.name: Scrap Mechanic
games.summary: Enter the creative paradise of Scrap Mechanic! Build fantastic machines, go on adventures with your friends and defend against waves of evil Farmbots in this imaginative multiplayer survival sandbox. With Scrap Mechanic’s powerful creation tools you can engineer your own adventures!

games.name: Second Dreamer
games.summary: Rent games, pick out a movie for movie night, buy fireworks, explore the town and neighborhood, the world is yours but this particular night holds many secrets.

games.name: Shunya
games.summary:
Shunya is a survival horror game where you must escape a secret medical facility while uncovering the horrifying truth behind its human experiments. Trapped as Patient #17, you awaken with fragmented memories, pursued by the mysterious Janitor whose sole purpose is to erase every failed subject before they escape.

Search abandoned wards, laboratories, and restricted treatment rooms for key items needed to unlock your path forward while avoiding the Janitor's relentless patrols. Stay out of sight, listen carefully, and use the environment to survive as every patient file and hidden note reveals another piece of the facility's disturbing history.

Explore a claustrophobic research facility inspired by secret medical experiments, filled with abandoned equipment, unsettling patient records, and atmospheric environments designed to keep you constantly on edge. Every corridor hides a new danger, every room tells a forgotten story, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

Will you escape the facility... or become another terminated patient?

games.name: Some of You May Die
games.summary: Create an overpowered squad of heroes to fight for you. Each run is different. Heroes are granted random boosted abilities making each unique. Go head to head against other players online or overcome the challenging singleplayer campaign in this one-of-a-kind roguelike autobattler!

games.name: Sunny Side Up
games.summary: Sunny Side Up is a cozy 3D parkour adventure game where you guide a brave little egg across a charming farm to reunite w/ your family. Master playful jumps, uncover hidden paths, & explore handcrafted levels on a heartfelt journey full of charm, one careful hop at a time. Can you find your way home?

games.name: Swish Ball Clicker
games.summary: A cute, pixel-art, incremental basketball idler that every click is a swish. Automate your shots, upgrade your players, and go from being rookie to an all-star in this relaxing 2D indie baller. Perfect game to keep open in the background while you work.

games.name: Taolu
games.summary: Becoming a kung fu master has never been that much fun! In Taolu you can train your martial arts skills respecting the essence of the real kung fu, expanded with the wonder of a VR game. Master curated sets of choreographed movements using a realistic wooden dummy.

games.name: The Afterlife Cafe
games.summary: The Afterlife Cafe is a cozy visual novel centered around death and traveling to the afterlife. In the living world, meet and chat with your concierges at the cafes. Then take a temporary trip to the afterlife and learn the stories of those who have passed. Experience moving between the living and spirit realms in this narrative-driven game.

games.name: The Alley
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore a maze-like Korean alley, photograph and identify supernatural 'Demon Traces' from realistic illusions, and escape while evading a relentless ghost.

games.name: The Dungeon of Lulu Farea: Rebirth
games.summary: The Dungeon of Lulu Farea: Rebirth is an engaging blend of traditional turn-based RPG and puzzle game elements, boasting a complex world in which nothing is left to chance and every encounter matters. Genre classics such as fishing and side quests abound, and the game encourages thinking ahead to find the best way to obstacles in order to successfully clear the dungeon.

games.name: Traffic Survivor
games.summary: Dodge traffic. Survive longer.

games.name: Tulip Season
games.summary: Tulip Season is an incremental farming sim built from small, satisfying routines. Beauty has a number, and you make it go up. Unlock new tulips and field upgrades, breed new colours, and help out when the neighbours come by.

games.name: Wizard Dungeon
games.summary: Wizard Dungeon is an old school action rpg inspired by Diablo 1 and 2, with a unique pixel art style inspired by NES and Gameboy aesthetics. Grind through dungeon floors full of monsters, level up, spend skill points, equip items, and try to find a way out. Play the early access demo on itch for free! https://tonyhork.itch.io/wizard-dungeon

games.name: World of Eggs: Idle Adventures
games.summary: World of Eggs: Idle Adventures is a world where you can build your civilization, trade with players, fight in raids, and do it all in idle mode. The game automates all the routine!

games.name: Zavod: Conveyor Logic
games.summary: ZAVOD is a minimalist puzzle game focused on setting up conveyor line operations.

games.name: Zoo Protocol
games.summary: Zoo Protocol is a co-op sci-fi horror game where you and your team are assigned to an abandoned alien industrial complex run by a malfunctioning corporate system. Care for dangerous anomalous creatures, prepare nutritional mixtures, process waste into energy, repair failing machinery, and meet ever-growing production quotas. Explore the facility, uncover the fate of the previous shift, and fight to escape before the system decides you're no longer needed.

games.name: 100 Dragon Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️‍

games.name: 5D Chess With Multiverse Time Travel Chatting
games.summary: Just chatting, but with the 5D Chess With Multiverse Time Travel starting screen in the background.

games.name: Blast Dash
games.summary: Run Fast Blast Everything

games.name: Castaway
games.summary: Survive day and night on a small island in the middle of the ocean.

games.name: Code-Black
games.summary: A First-Person Single-Player Zombie Survival game where you, Rugir J.z, live through the initial events of a mass zombie outbreak, shoot, kill, upgrade, explore. Do you think you can survive, or possibly escape…

games.name: Curse of The Lineage
games.summary: Curse of the Lineage is an isometric puzzle roguelike where you navigate shifting grounds filled with lost souls, powerful charms and endless secrets. Unravel your bloodline’s dark past as you solve evolving puzzles and fight to break the family curse.

games.name: Dracula: Restless Legs Syndrome
games.summary: The Count needs to suck up the blood of the maiden, but after a countdown ends, your last few moves will be repeated backwards.

games.name: Driving School Sim
games.summary: Can you master every road and every challenge?

games.name: Farming Homestead
games.summary: Build, grow, craft, and live your dream farm life in Farming Homestead, a cozy farming simulation game where every day brings new opportunities.

games.name: Jack Bonecroft 4
games.summary: An outsider. A different world. A warrior who isn't finished yet. Lunara Mistwalker is thrust into a realm of secrets and ancient powers. Four kingdoms. One mission. Jack Bonecroft 4 is a story-driven action RPG. Based on true events witnessed during my business trip to this sector.

games.name: Mall Simulator Together
games.summary: Mall Simulator Together is a multiplayer mall management simulator where you can open stores, manage deliveries, organize products, hire employees and develop your own mall together with your friends.

games.name: No Final Night: Protect the Sponk Can
games.summary: You are the night guard protecting the last Sponk Energy can in the world, and three energy drink junkies will break into your office to steal it. Watch the cameras, slam the doors and burn your power wisely to survive from 12 AM to 6 AM. Every night is harder than the last. There is no final night.

games.name: Nothing To Declare
games.summary: Live the thrill of working for airport security! In a wholesome setting, weigh and scan bags, ask passengers questions, and if you are not convinced, search their luggage for dangerous items. It could be a bomb or an oddly shaped electronic device. Earn money and upgrade your workstation.

games.name: Onaka Game
games.summary: Merge a variety of fat furries together to achieve bigger furries and a high score.

games.name: Pocket Dinos
games.summary: An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

games.name: Steel Heaven
games.summary: Hack, slash, and dismember the undead in this first-person melee action game. Fight through an ever-changing labyrinth where every wrong turn makes enemies stronger. Three brutal weapons, six upgrade paths, and a Doom-style kill-to-survive loop. Get lost, get punished.

games.name: T7's Basics in Educational
games.summary: Just don't make anything wrong with this game... because T7 will start finding you after the second laptop you collect it, or make wrong answers on the first laptop.

games.name: The Box is Alive
games.summary: A physics-based comedy platformer where you tumble, roll, and flap your way through chaotic warehouse challenges as a living cardboard box.

games.name: Tiny Train Adventures
games.summary: Set off on a tiny train adventure! Build your railway and drive through the mountains in this cozy exploration adventure.

games.name: Ascension Trail
games.summary: Kill, Die, Repeat! Exterminate massive swarms of monsters in this action-packed, top-down rogue-lite. Dash, hit, and cast through endless mobs where every death is a step toward god-tier power. Hoard coins, buy permanent upgrades, and craft a legendary hero to challenge the Devil on your own terms.

games.name: Astral-Battlecraft
games.summary: 3D Rogue Game Space Battleship Rogue Game light Tactical System, Inertia System, Drift System DIY Weapons: Flexible weapon customization with independent cooldowns. Weapons can be destroyed.

games.name: Boingus' Big Day
games.summary: Keep ahead of the clock in this gauntlet of wacky mini-games.

games.name: Bomb-Time Job
games.summary: Defuse the bomb before it explodes! Compete for the highest score!

games.name: Bomberful!
games.summary: Welcome, interns, to the Bomberful company! In this game, assemble bomb parts on a grid, manage space to increase your score, and calibrate your unstable product by mixing chemicals and connecting wires.

games.name: Brief Offerings
games.summary: Gather resources until a countdown ends and then battle your way through a bullet hell.

games.name: Broken Depths RPG
games.summary:
You are Ari, a treasure hunter seeking riches in the depths.
What you didn't know is that this cave is cursed.
Can you make it to floor 30?

games.name: Captcha Overload
games.summary: You are trying to play a very cool countdown game, so you use an installer. However, the installer seems kinda weird...

games.name: CarMarket
games.summary:
Collect, trade and build the ultimate car empire in Car Market!

Start with a simple clicker, earn cash, buy mystery boxes and unlock over 1,000+ unique cars ranging from common city cars to ultra-rare prestige hypercars. Will you pull a common or a mythic car?

Simple to pick up, impossible to put down. How big will your garage get?

games.name: Catterplosion
games.summary: Help Wiggle The Galaxy Swallower of Eternal Despair make his childrens become butterflys ! Place bombs and set their countdowns to explode Wiggle's childs into the magic ring of butterfly transformation.

games.name: Clicker Ore
games.summary: Dig deeper! Break rocks, hire miners, and uncover endless treasures beneath the earth.

games.name: Countdown to Eclipse
games.summary:
An incremental cult management sim.
Tired of your old life, you take out a $70,000 loan to purchase a tiny church and begin your new ministry.

games.name: Deathmate
games.summary: Build an army of chess pieces, stack a deck full of moves, and battle your way across the map towards the grim reaper in this chess inspired strategy game.

games.name: DeepCroak
games.summary:
DeepCroak is a puzzle game in which a very hungry little frog discovers a cave full of flies, and its goal is to eat them all!
On DeepCroak, you move across a grid filled with obstacles; the number of moves allowed is extremely limited, so be careful how you navigate.

games.name: Der Böse Mann
games.summary:
An action packtion thriller with horror elements. Its a jump and run because you jump and run. You need to survive until your deadly laser is charged and then kill the evil man. But don't get hit by the hands or his little minios.

This game was made for the GMTK GameJam 2026

games.name: Desert Picaroon
games.summary: Your goal is to descend into an endless, procedurally generated tomb, killing monsters and collecting their treasures. But be warned: the tomb is cursed, and every time you descend to a new floor, it will begin to crumble! Hurry to find the artifact and escape before it’s too late! Buy upgrades and make your way through the increasingly difficult levels!

games.name: Erdetspill
games.summary: Grandpa wants 2 ice creams. You have to get them. It turns out to be more complicated than you thought. An absurd first-person adventure game where you navigate Norwegian bureaucracy, talk to strange people and solve pointless quests - in a small Norwegian village.

games.name: Fair And Balanced
games.summary: A Roguelike Autobattler game about creating monster towers, balance them, exploit strategies, think out of the box by placing everything where it's not supposed to be, and win in this totally fair and balanced game!

games.name: Frenfield
games.summary: Descend Dracula's castle to go cheer him up!

games.name: Glade and Ritual
games.summary: Glade and Ritual is a cute and short story game with some Breakout-meets-Peggle style minigames. You play as a gnome who is in charge of a small village with various bug inhabitants. In the centre of the village a magic flower grows. Every night the villagers come together to perform a ritual and in return the magic flower protects the village. However the flower starts loosing it's petals once a day, leading to chaos and tension between the villagers.

games.name: GodWright
games.summary: Sculpt a tiny pixel world, seed it with life, and watch civilizations rise on their own. Kingdoms war, trade, and crown kings; dynasties fall to rebellion; whole ages turn. A cozy god-game sandbox where the story isn't scripted — it's discovered. No goals, no clock. Just a tiny world that lives.

games.name: Goobers
games.summary: A collection of micro-games featuring some goobs.

games.name: I Was Seen as the Weakest Hero But I Can Secretly Edit the Metadata of the World?!?
games.summary: I Was Seen as the Weakest Hero But I Can Secretly Edit the Metadata of the World?!? is a minimalist word-editing game where players trim sentences down to their essentials while keeping them grammatically correct. Each scene presents a short paragraph, and your goal is to remove words until the sentence fits a strict word count, though the real challenge lies in how those omissions reshape the story.
