With absurd twists like bribing a horse, the game rewards creative editing, letting you craft wildly different outcomes from the same starting text.

games.name: Idylls of the Lunar Maria
games.summary: Idylls of the Lunar Maria is a charming "match-3 builder" roguelite adventure. Chat with rats, defeat demons.

games.name: Kairos
games.summary: Kairos is a basic Asteroids-like game, where your objective is to kill enemies to collect more ammo and stay alive. Getting hit decreases Kairo's time, shortening your run!

games.name: Level Down
games.summary: Crashed in space, surrounded by collapsing floors, reach for the top...

games.name: Locostation
games.summary: Locostation is an incremental game. Drive a train, deliver cargo, fight off thieves and upgrade.

games.name: Mighty Moth and the Horrible, Terrible, Awful, No-Good Day!
games.summary:
Save the day and save your date, one punch at a time!

You’re Mighty Moth, hero of the universe, defender of Cecropolis and helpless romantic! After saving your crush for the millionth time, you finally score a dinner date for 8:00PM. But your excitement is cut short, as the nefarious Shocked Cult has broken into your base and stolen all the galactic gifts you gathered for your date!

Help Mighty Moth beat up cultists, recover her gifts and get to her date before the risotto gets cold!

games.name: Mixolydia Fringes
games.summary: Halt its ascension. Explore the lands through death to ascertain the way, they will hide their riches from those who take the trodden path. Be sure to find your way there before too long. Dethrone the Good King.

games.name: PolterDates
games.summary: It's a short narrative game where you play as Dolores Delalma, a medium and matchmaker who has to pair souls.

games.name: Questionable Countdowns
games.summary: A game about counting down and following instructions.

games.name: Short Fuse
games.summary: Short Fuse is a minimalist logic puzzle about timing detonations perfectly. Each bomb has a timer. Drag its fuse out, cover every tile on the grid with no overlaps, hit ignite, and watch the whole chain play out.

games.name: So Perfect I Could Eat You Up
games.summary:
A mini restaurant simulator where envy eats you alive...

Enchanting Elixirs has been in Marion's family for years now, and it's up to her to make this cafe the best it can be!!! At all costs. Help Marion manage Enchanting Elixirs and make it great again!!! Or don't.

games.name: The Count is Down for Blood
games.summary: A puzzle game where you control a vampire trying to get to its crypt by dawn, but on the way through he will need to suck up enough blood from the townsfolk.

games.name: The Grade 5B Case Files
games.summary: A narrative AVG focused on everyday mysteries from the lives of elementary school students. The two protagonists encounter ordinary yet unusual incidents at school, and through investigation and deduction, players uncover the truth together with them.

games.name: Time Thief
games.summary: Traverse through the magic dungeon and steal the sacred vial containing the embodiment of the tides of time to attain immortality... only then can you find the door to escape.

games.name: Tiny Birdtopia
games.summary: This is not Bird Game 3! Build and manage a relaxing bird sanctuary. Collect and raise diverse bird species, and unlock hidden species by gathering feathers. Customize your Birdtopia with themes like forests and islands, and watch your birds thrive in this casual, idle game.

games.name: Tumble in the Deep Noon
games.summary: Play as a tumbleweed in the final 8 seconds of a western film. Satisfy the order (critics) and chaos (audience). A short game about charisma.

games.name: Voleur!
games.summary: With a minute left in the Volouvre, Rion must dash around the museum to steal the remaining treasures before they get him... A Voleur in the Volouvre!!

games.name: What Happened to Squad 7
games.summary: What happened to Squad 7 is a military visual novel where you will decide the outcome of the world, what members of the cast live and die, and Orion, the Frontman of Squad 7 which you play as. Will you follow orders? Or will you dig deeper beyond what you're given clearance?

games.name: Yggdrasil
games.summary:
9 worlds, 9 colors, 9 puzzles to solve.

YGGDRASIL is a small 2D puzzle game about walking, exploring and finding your ways.

You wake up in a place you do not recognise, with buttons you do not know what they are for (yet), and not even recalling exactally what you are.

Every piece of information matters. There are no "quests" and no direct leads. You are on your own in YGGDRASIL.

games.name: ¡Tú decides!
games.summary: Are we good? Are we bad? You decide what people think now!

games.name: Abyssal Soul
games.summary: Abyssal Soul is a sequential card battle Roguelike game that blends strategic deck-building, multi-class progression, and Western fantasy art style, delivering a profound adventure centered on "sacrifice and choice." You will select characters, plan routes, collect cards and blessings through repeated "rituals," while confronting the anomalies lurking in the depths of dreams.

games.name: Alice's Night at the Mansion
games.summary: Three eccentric ghosts have kidnapped Alice's dog, Dinah! Help Alice free her dog, solve the mysteries of Monster Mansion, and make the annual Monster Party a success in this hand-drawn, point-and-click-inspired comedy adventure!

games.name: Alphabetto's
games.summary: Roguelite letter-deckbuilder. The characters of the great classics sit at your table. Chain, sign and mutate letters from a deck shared by every player — every card you add arms your rival as much as you. Unlock the works line by line.

games.name: Ariokan
games.summary: Ariokan is the online collectible card game where you can create new (and balanced) official cards to invent new combos and break the "Meta". No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns, no pay-to-win. Generated cards can be unlocked by other players, contributing to an ever-growing library of cards!

games.name: Backfire Brigade
games.summary: Backfire Brigade is a chaotic couch co-op firefighting game for two to four players. Coordinate with your fellow firefighters to rescue victims trapped in burning buildings while extinguishing the flames.

games.name: Behind The Walls
games.summary: A first-person puzzle adventure where you explore a secret place, solve mysteries, and uncover the dark truth hidden behind the walls.

games.name: Bobanook!
games.summary: A relaxing, idle boba-shop simulator that can accompany you as you work on other things. Sell boba tea, unlock new drinks, and customize and care for a boba pet that lives in the corner of your screen!

games.name: BonkCity
games.summary: BonkCity is a 90s hip-hop horde survivor roguelike. Playing as an MC defending your block, you survive waves of posers, record label security, and label muscle across a procedurally chaotic back-alley night. Move and auto-attack while drafting weapons and perks from level-up cards, evolve maxed weapons into powerful combos, and earn "drip" — cosmetic gear that stacks into real stats. Each run climbs toward a three-phase showdown with the Industry Plant, a manufactured fake MC built to replace the cypher. Features a shared Daily Block seed with leaderboards, four playable characters (more to come), and challenge modifiers called Beefs. Built solo in Godot, drawing DNA from Vampire Survivors and Brotato with the color and soul of Jet Set Radio and Streets of Rage.

games.name: Bounce Forever
games.summary: Bounce from the backyard to the clouds in this punishing vertical climber. The only thing faster than the climb is the fall. Bounce forever and you might just reach the top.

games.name: Broken Reality 2000
games.summary: The sequel to everyone's favorite single-player adventure set on the internet about our digital lives.

games.name: Capybara Pizza Cafe
games.summary: Manage a cozy cafe run by Capybaras, for Capybaras. Bake pizzas, serve pizzas, clean tables and ring that cash register!

games.name: Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World
games.summary: Human civilization had finally burned out its last spark. The survivors chose to gather together, shutting themselves within safe zones to await death. But Cosdarica did not. Neither did I.

games.name: Ducks in Disguise
games.summary: Ducks in Disguise is a cozy hand-drawn hidden object game where you find hundreds of hidden rubber ducks in intricate 2D illustrations and collect them in your personal scrapbook.

games.name: Dwarf Delve
games.summary: In this first-person extraction roguelite adventure, strap on your gloves, grab your Battlemallet, and explore randomly-generated mines as a new Delveling. Gather riches, avoid deadly hazards and try to make it out with your beard intact!

games.name: Dystopicon
games.summary:
In Dystopicon the players will live in a dystopian society in which they receive money in exchange to watch TV. With that money they pay services to cover their basic needs. Throughout the game they will discover the details of this dystopia in which the government monitors your movements but gives you freedom of choice.

The story will be told through gameplay, texts and comics. Take your time to explore the different objects and the mechanics in your first day.

games.name: Endacopia
games.summary: Endacopia is a nontraditional point-and-click adventure game. Guide a lost child named Mellow through a world governed by unfamiliar rules. Relying on his strong gut instinct and your guidance as his guardian angel, Mellow must overcome obstacles in search of a place to call home.

games.name: Forever Skies
games.summary: Forever Skies is a first-person action survival game. Return to Earth destroyed by an ecological disaster, fly a high-tech airship, expand, rebuild and repair it. Scavenge resources to survive, face the dangers of the surface as you will hunt for viral pathogens to cure a mysterious illness.

games.name: Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call
games.summary: Adventure awaits in this narrative driven fantasy action-RPG. The war-torn city of Vahrin stands before you on the brink of collapse and in desperate need of aid. As a mercenary in search of your next…opportunity, will you answer Vahrin’s Call?

games.name: Graphite
games.summary: Unleash your creativity as a kid’s drawings spring to life in this thrilling roguelike RPG. Build your party, navigate a dynamic timeline, and shape your fate through notebook scenarios that test your team in a world where the heroes don’t know they’re imaginary.

games.name: GunBang
games.summary: GunBang is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you face off hordes of enemies and bosses. Choose from a variety of weapons, traits and items to create unique builds and survive until observers are satisfied!

games.name: Imouto Paradise! 2
games.summary: An all-ages version of Imouto Paradise! 2

games.name: Infinite Ruins
games.summary: An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources.

games.name: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron
games.summary: Cook or be cooked! In this cosmic deck-building roguelike, ingredients crash, merge, and react in chaotic ways. As the witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, craft the perfect stew, master strategic combos, and satisfy bizarre patrons—before you end up in the cauldron yourself!

games.name: Mahou Arms
games.summary: Mahou Arms is an anime-inspired character-action hack and slash that tells the story of a magical girl paramilitary group fighting back against an alien invasion.

games.name: Moon Crashers
games.summary: Moon Crashers is a 4-player online co-op game. Crash-land on the lunar surface with your squad, drift across craters, scavenge junk & rare minerals, uncover ancient ruins, build your ride, and rocket back home. Think you can make it home?

games.name: Moon Miner
games.summary: Drill into a dead moon, haul glowing ore, sell your load, and upgrade your mole-bot for the next risky descent. A compact mining adventure inspired by Motherload and I Dig It, with cozy progression, dangerous depths, and something alive below.

games.name: Mothiary
games.summary: Collect and raise hundreds of delicate moths in your cozy nighttime terrarium. Discover rare species, grow your collection, and unwind in a relaxing idle sanctuary.

games.name: Nightmare Hospital
games.summary: To cure a strange illness, you come to a bizarre hospital that seems abandoned. Someone tells you she can find a doctor, but you have to help her with some tasks first, such as taking some photos of the hospital's corpses. As things progress, you discover more abnormalities.

games.name: No Socks RPG
games.summary: Fight groovy enemies, and recruit a team of sexy, cute and quirky Monster Girls to get your fits back!

games.name: Null Root
games.summary: A roguelite incremental game about protecting a network by destroying the invading nodes, collecting the loot and customizing your build with new skills.

games.name: Office Keeper
games.summary: 5-to-10-minute score-attack cleaning with a spooky twist. Clean an abandoned office while evading a creepy "Entity." Vacuum and wipe away randomized dust, watching filth vanish right where it's traced. Secure the target score and report back to finish the shift!

games.name: Office Ladies
games.summary: Get Safe for Work with six inspirational HR managers in this interactive Human Resources Training Program

games.name: Office Leveling
games.summary: Office Leveling is a management game about secretly playing a minimalist clicker at work without getting caught. As you level up, you must complete office tasks, deal with coworkers dropping by with requests, and solve small puzzles to stay under the radar.

games.name: Orbital
games.summary:
Orbital is an outer space, endless survival, arcade game where players become planetary pilots to prolong the inevitable grasp of a super massive blackhole, witnessing the collapse of the solar system. Navigate the cosmic perils and chaos, deploying specialised planetary tech to endure the onslaught and ascend the galactic leaderboard.

Adapt your strategy with each mission and push your endurance further with every attempt.

games.name: Pigmen's Challenge
games.summary: Two Piggies in one wild restaurant. Chaos, pressure, panic — served fresh!

games.name: Plum Road Tea Dream
games.summary: Plum Road Tea Dream tells the semi-autobiographical story of 'S', a young game designer who creates virtual sanctuaries that reflect their own introspective journey out of need for safe havens, new rituals and space for grief.

games.name: Prelude Dark Pain
games.summary: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ash Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

games.name: Ragnarok: The New World
games.summary:
Ragnarok: The New World is a massive online role-playing adventure set in the legendary world of Midgard. Explore vast fields, bustling cities, and mysterious dungeons where every journey holds new challenges and stories.

Create your own character and choose from classic jobs such as Swordsman, Mage, Archer, and Merchant. Customize your appearance with a wide variety of outfits, raise pets, ride mounts, and truly express yourself in a vibrant open world.

Beyond combat, build and decorate your own home—design a personal sanctuary to relax, gather with friends, and show off your creativity.

Join forces with allies to defeat powerful bosses, tackle dangerous raids, and grow together in guilds and communities. Or simply wander freely, trade, and enjoy the world at your own pace. With nostalgia and freedom at its core, Ragnarok: The New World invites you to relive the spirit of Ragnarok while writing your own legend in an ever-evolving online world.

games.name: Rubber Duck Survival
games.summary: Rubber Duck Survival is a 2D survival game where you control a rubber duck and face over 30 bosses plus 1 secret boss. Unlock skins, defeat challenging bosses, and face waves of enemies. Can you overcome the challenge?

games.name: Sakuna: Hinuka Junreitan
games.summary: A free-to-play game based on the Sakuna series.

games.name: Scrap Yard Idle
games.summary: Build your own scrap empire in this incremental idle game. Collect, process, and automate your production chain while optimizing resources and scaling your industrial system.

games.name: Skills & Raids
games.summary: A party-based RPG with real-time, ability driven combat. Manage cooldowns and react to enemy mechanics. Loot and extract resources to complete quests and craft powerful gear. The world has fallen into the grasp of a corruption spreading creature. Combine skills to create unique builds.

games.name: Slime Jump
games.summary: Master precise jumps, climb ever higher, and race against the clock in this challenging precision platformer. Every jump matters, can you reach the top and earn every speed achievement?

games.name: Spell Knight
games.summary: Descend into the dark abyss and wipe out endless hordes of monsters. Wield powerful weapons as a magic knight and enjoy the thrill of rapid growth.

games.name: Spheroll
games.summary: Spheroll is a 3D rolling ball platformer. Balance the ball and feel every roll and jump between platforms.

games.name: Stop and Smell the Flowers
games.summary: Relax in your shady garden and watch the flowers. Plant flowers, earn money, expand your garden, and trace the evolution chart to complete your collection.

games.name: Storytime Cats: A Day at the Park
games.summary: Storytime Cats – A Day At The Park is a hidden object game where you’ll search for hundreds of hidden cats scattered throughout a cozy park. The only thing they're missing is their favorite hooman. Can you find and pet them all?

games.name: Streetlight Syndicate
games.summary: A casual, story-driven incremental game set in 1920s New York. Build your criminal empire from speakeasies to protection rackets, fight rival hitmen, meet colorful characters, and become the city's most powerful crime lord.

games.name: Suika Game
games.summary: A game where you drop fruits. When two of the same fruit meet, they form a bigger fruit, which can then combine to create an even bigger fruit, until eventually you form a watermelon!

games.name: Tachyon Fire
games.summary: Tachyon Fire is a hectic movement-focused arena shooter that pits you against an army of surreal mechanical creatures in a nightmarish dreamscape. Ski, slide, and launch yourself through the air while tearing apart the horde with unlimited firepower and a magic hammer.

games.name: The Faraway King
games.summary: A narrative adventure with exploration and visual novel elements. Join J.D. on a journey through the nation of Yoom to find the mythical figure known as the Faraway King and rid himself of his supposed curse. But should J.D. trust his bizarre companion, Zxtabella?

games.name: The Left Behind
games.summary: The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore an overgrown open world at day time and beware of enemies coming in at night. Salvage, hunt and build your way through this world to survive. How long will you survive?

games.name: The Political Simulator
games.summary: Create a candidate and run a Presidential campaign across the United States. Improve your approval rating with battleground voters and try to earn enough support to win on election night. The campaign mode allows you to take part in a turn-based strategic campaign where every decision matters.

games.name: Ticket to Nowhere
games.summary:
Enjoy your movie... if you can ever reach the theater.

You just wanted to catch a late-night screening, but you find yourself trapped in a strangely empty cinema corridor. The lights hum, the posters stare back at you, and the only way out is the elevator at the end of the hall. But memory is a fragile thing, and this place loves to play tricks on your mind.

Ticket to Nowhere is a psychological anomaly observation game where your eyes—and your ears—are your only lifeline.

games.name: Tile Trials
games.summary: Tile Trials is a tile-placing, number based puzzle game for the casual strategist. Place a variety of familiar shapes onto increasingly difficult layouts to maximize your score and surpass each level threshold. Iterative gameplay, mind bending challenges, and hand-crafted puzzles await!

games.name: Tyrania Enforcers
games.summary: Faced with evil... would you pull the trigger? Tyrania Enforcers is a story-driven visual novel exploring morality, duty, and the cost of enforcing order in a world on the brink of conflict.

games.name: Unbeatable
games.summary: Unbeatable is a rhythm-adventure game where music is illegal, and you do crimes. talk your way through trouble as you explore vibrant locales. Fight your way through exciting arcade-perfect rhythm setpieces, featuring an original soundtrack by Peak Divide.

games.name: Unsent
games.summary: Trapped in a loop within old apartment, the only way out is to confront deliberately forgotten memories. Under the chilling atmosphere, you must confront the manifestations of your trauma, and decide the fate of a fractured bond. Every clue matters; every choice leads to a different redemption.

games.name: Utopia: Birth of The Heroes
games.summary:
Utopia: Birth of the Heroes is a character‑driven fantasy visual novel about conviction, sacrifice, and the price of protecting those who matter most.

The story follows three distinct protagonists, each driven by a different vision of a perfect society. They’ll navigate hardship, political tension, and morally charged decisions. Every perspective reveals a different truth, and every “hero” believes that what they are doing is right and just.

games.name: VectaGuard
games.summary: Arcade-inspired shmup action where neon vector caverns explode with modern visuals, dynamic music, weapon upgrades and intense score chasing.

games.name: Void Noir
games.summary:
The internet never sleeps. Neither do its mysteries.

Welcome to Void Noir, a cozy detective investigation game where every case is generated from real live Twitch stream metadata.

You are not browsing Twitch.

You are not watching streams.

You are a detective.

Each investigation begins at your desk as rain falls outside your office window. A fresh case file slides onto your monitor containing only a handful of clues.

A category.

A language.

Maybe a viewer count.

Maybe part of a title.

Maybe how long they've been live.

Using those clues, you'll investigate the live internet to identify the correct broadcaster before closing another case.

Every investigation is different because every investigation comes from actual live Twitch streams happening right now.

No handcrafted mysteries.

No scripted solutions.

The internet creates the cases.

You solve them.

games.name: Aisle Survive
games.summary:
Aisle Survive is a retail rogue-like, a deli-crawling dystopia and a supermarket survivor like no other. The customers will crush you. The banana skins are baying for your blood. Finish the job before the job finishes you.

Survive a week at the last human-run store in Mech City. Melee, multi-task and manage your stress to meet your boss' crushing standards - and stop the revolution.

games.name: Augmented Fear
games.summary:
Augmented Fear is a horror puzzle game set in a dark and oppressive cyberpunk universe.
Trapped in a mysterious district, you must find a way out and survive against aggressive creatures.
Use augmented reality to uncover the secrets hidden within.

games.name: Bloodwright
games.summary: Descend through deadly procedural dungeons, claim powerful loot, and decide how deep you're willing to risk it all in this dark fantasy action RPG roguelite.

games.name: Bonehold
games.summary: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

games.name: Cata-Bomb
games.summary: Pinball game by where you use cat bombs to defeat bosses but the bombs explode in 30 seconds if they don't hit anything.

games.name: Chemical Combat
games.summary: A chemistry-themed roguelike in which you fight your way through procedurally generated dungeons, splashing enemies with highly reactive potions.

games.name: Come Out Guys
games.summary: Get ready for a chaotic chase for 2-8 players! Experience high tension FPS Parkour Hide and Seek with tiny characters in a giant environment. Climb, jump, hide, and shoot to surprise your friends. Escaping and chasing have never been this exciting!

games.name: Conjurers
games.summary:
Defeat the Conjurers. Take their constellations. Conquer the Zodiac.
A classic turn-based tactics game where deckbuilding lets players summon Zodiac creatures and hybrids, then steal new constellations by defeating rival Conjurers. Will you become powerful enough to face the Immortal Aquarius?

games.name: Conquest: Global Domination
games.summary:
Conquer the world through strategy, diplomacy, and military power.
Build your nation. Expand your empire. Dominate the globe.

games.name: Convent Chronicles: Revelation
games.summary: A visual novel that combines religious themes from Catholicism with anime inspired drama and visuals.

games.name: CookieRun: Crumble - Idle RPG
games.summary: CookieRun: Crumble is a lighthearted idle strategy RPG from Devsisters that expands the beloved CookieRun universe into effortless, large-scale tactical battles.

games.name: Cristal Absoluto
games.summary: A F2P Indie Roleplaying Game, Discover its story about crystals and old universal beings.

games.name: Dissolution of the Silent Union
games.summary: Dissolution of the Silent Union is a short, narrative-driven visual novel where you accompany Vera, who is trapped on the last day of school, toward her inevitable date.

games.name: Dog of Wisdom
games.summary: Dog of Wisdom is a 2D action platformer where you play as Pepper the dachshund. Fly around barking at nothing and sample the galaxy's best foods, all while attaining the knowledge to be good. Get the foods and the wisdom and the hat and the galaxy.

games.name: Drive Horizon Story
games.summary: How far can you drive before the desert finally defeats you?

games.name: Dust Bunny Simulator
games.summary: You are a dust bunny under the couch. You don't move — the world moves you. Grow from a speck into a Dust Monster while dodging the one true predator: the Roomba. A cozy, gloriously helpless idle sim.

games.name: E-Shop Tycoon
games.summary: E-Shop Tycoon is an isometric online shopping company management game. Fill your warehouses, take orders, hire employees, expand and design your offices. Protect your site against hackers, improve your reputation on social media. Become the best online shopping company in the world!

games.name: Go North
games.summary: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!

games.name: Gothic Classic
games.summary:
For the first time, relive this amazing RPG on a handheld console and enjoy the game that revolutionized roleplaying games on the go. Dive into dark times and adventures with great performance and a well adapted UI and controls.

War has been waged across the kingdom of Myrtana. Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed ore. You are thrown through the barrier into this prison colony. With your back against the wall, you have to survive and form volatile alliances until you can finally escape.

games.name: Hamster, Eat, Run
games.summary: This is a casual strategy game about being a hamster on your first escape. To survive out there, you must learn to efficiently gather energy from food and upgrade hoarding level to gain new survival tricks. Fail, you'll have no choice but to be a house pet again!

games.name: Harvest Moon: Skytree Village
games.summary: Revive the Land, Save a Village!

games.name: Harvest Moon: The Lost Valley
games.summary: A New Evolution of Harvest Moon!

games.name: Heartdust
games.summary:
HEARTDUST is a horror online PvP/Co-op hero shooter with up to 4 players set inside a cursed retro videogame.

Your childhood friend texted you after realizing that the servers for HEARTDUST, a game you both used to play as children, have misteriously reopened 15 years after their closure. You decide to play together one more time, but something ghastly is awaiting inside.

games.name: Heroes of Hammerwatch II: Celestial Ruins
games.summary: Take up the holy duties of the new Priest class and brave a fallen sanctum in the Celestial Ruins Expansion for Heroes of Hammerwatch II.

games.name: Incremental Retro Racing
games.summary: Earn more and more stars by driving faster and faster in Incremental Retro Racing. Accumulate and unlock 70+ vehicles, upgrades, track generation options, and more. Includes unlimited tracks and customizable CRT filter for that old school retro feel.

games.name: Island Beekeeper
games.summary: Build your apiary on islands above the clouds, travel on your medocycle, crossbreed bees with unique traits and create a cozy home in the sky. Grow plants, explore islands and send healing honey down to Earth, where people still hope for your help.

games.name: Ispell
games.summary: Ispell is a shoot'em up & bullet hell game where you take on the role of a nameless android who wanders through the dying worlds. Use various weapons and dodge enemy bullets, as well as challenge powerful creatures.

games.name: Minimate
games.summary: Solve puzzles with a chess board that sits in the corner of your screen. Challenge yourself to difficult puzzles, unlock streaks, and customize your board. Idle away and your chess buddy will always be there to help you practice.

games.name: Monster Storm
games.summary:
You are the bullet hell.

Fight back against an overwhelming storm of monsters in this 2D top-down multiplayer reverse bullet hell, where you unleash screen-filling chaos while struggling to survive ever-escalating enemy hordes.

Dive into procedurally generated levels, build absurdly powerful characters, and push your skills, talents, and weapons to their limits. Every run is different. Every mistake is deadly. Every victory feels earned.

Whether you’re flying solo or surviving together, the storm never stops coming.

games.name: My Infamous Dungeon
games.summary:
It's time to be evil. Build and master your dungeon, hire despicable monsters, and rise to conquer the overworld. Gaze from below as your dark tendrils creep across the land, snatching treasures from the forces of good and funding an ever growing empire. But beware! Saint Million the Hero King and his table of royal knights are always watching. Leave your dungeon weak, and a single cleave from the hero's sword will end your reign.

My Infamous Dungeon is a roguelite dungeon builder. Take time to carefully plan your dungeon, then protect it against waves of greedy heroes.

games.name: My Lil Afterlife
games.summary: Become the new ruler of the afterlife. Summon spooky friends to reside in your unearthly realm and decorate it however you like with items you can craft, buy and find. Unravel the mysteries of the afterlife by taking on the reapers tower using spine-tingling spells to smite your enemies.

games.name: Nibble Quest
games.summary: A collectathon 3D platformer featuring a hungry capybara in search of legendary snacks.

games.name: Nulla Via
games.summary: NULLA VIA is a WW2 psychological horror set in a preserved, abandoned war town. Explore silent ruins, bunkers, and mass graves where life was erased. Shadows cannot be killed by bullets alone. Use your camera, your weapons, and your sanity to survive. This town was never rebuilt for a reason.

games.name: Paironix
games.summary: A fast-paced, rogue-lite tile-matching adventure! Connect identical pairs to unleash powerful magic spells, adapt to shifting grids, and draft game-changing upgrades. Can you survive the ever-evolving trials in this striking minimalist vector world?

games.name: Pastor
games.summary:
Pastor is a short atmospheric horror experience combining elements of a walking simulator, psychological thriller, and visual demo.

Originally created for a game jam that never took place, the project was later completed and released as an ultra-indie title. It was developed almost entirely by one person, with additional voice acting and several 3D models contributed by members of the developer’s community, all credited in the game.

Expect a small, experimental experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and unsettling events rather than complex gameplay.

games.name: Proton & Electron
games.summary: Play as Dr. Proton and Electron in a world of Electromagnetism, where two must collaborate to solve puzzles and restore their broken world.

games.name: Realms and Ruins: Abencor
games.summary: Realms & Ruins: Abencor is a first-person, grid-based, open world, retro, pixel art dungeon crawler harkening back to the days of yore. Realms & Ruins takes inspiration from games like Wizardry and Might & Magic and other cRPG's of the 90's.

games.name: Roll The Bones
games.summary: Select spell-dice for your loadout, roll them and wreak absolute havoc! This high-paced pixelart roguelite will let you build unique loadouts with extremely interactable spells. Let's roll some bones!

games.name: Runebook
games.summary: Runebook is an AI story game where you become the protagonist of a living story. Tell the Storyteller what you do next—choose a suggestion, type anything, or say it aloud—and the world responds. Characters remember how you treated them, clues and relationships persist, and each story builds toward an ending shaped by your choices.

games.name: Saved by the Coupon
games.summary: Your salary is gone, and payday is still a whole month away. Open your phone, pinch every penny, and make the most of every food delivery coupon. Can you survive until the next payday?

games.name: Scream Note
games.summary: Jumpscare your friends. If you write your friend's name on a page, the monster jumpscares them and they scream. Co-op comedy horror where you and your friends are trapped in a haunted neighborhood house. Can you reach the exit together, or will you scare each other out? 222 unique, crazy jumpscares!

games.name: Shards of Order
games.summary: A grim RPG with card-based combat where nothing stays dead. Lead a party of survivors through a world undone by shattered Laws. Restore them and reshape the rules of the game—but be ready to face the consequences.

games.name: Sinned Arena
games.summary: Sinned Arena is a classic arena shooter inspired by timeless 90s games. You are trapped in Hell with other unfortunate souls, fighting among each other for demons twisted pleasures. Fight for your way out this dark place but beware, demons aren't there just to watch.

games.name: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
games.summary: Incremental style tower-defense game where you face tens of thousands of orcs.

games.name: Skyward Bastion
games.summary: Skyward Bastion is a tower defense roguelite set on floating islands. Build and upgrade your defenses, survive endless waves of enemies, and explore procedurally expanding maps under a living day-night cycle.

games.name: Slot & Dungeons
games.summary: "Slot & Dungeons” is a deck-building roguelite in which the placement of enemies and items on the floor changes depending on the slots. While developing your character, collect symbols along the way to enhance the contents of the slots and conquer the dungeon.

games.name: Snayk 3+
games.summary: Higher dimensional snake with gradients and many options, who can beat a megadimension?

games.name: Space Imperia 4X
games.summary: A faithful digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game Space Empires 4X by GMT Games, beloved by wargamers for almost two decades. Command the rise of your civilization and the fall of others, all in one to two hours.

games.name: Spellsy
games.summary: A cozy-but-clever word puzzle game where every move counts. Plan your path, chain tile effects, and clear the board in as few turns as possible. No timers, no pressure, just pure puzzlin’.

games.name: Suncraft
games.summary: Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather resources, craft items, and upgrade tools to expand the land. Can you rebuild the grand Lighthouse and bring the village back to its golden days?

games.name: The Green Light
games.summary: The Green Light is a single-player first-person mystery set in 1986. A story driven game with an atmospheric environment and narrations. A tale of self-discovery as Gary Baker attempts to save what's left of himself and his family.

games.name: The Kuon Island Nursery Rhyme Murders: Case Notes
games.summary: A storm-lashed island, a nursery rhyme that foretells death, seven prodigies, serial murders, modern locked-room mysteries, classic locked-room mysteries, astrology, a jigsaw of flesh and blood, a survivor—and one lie told only so you would see this story.

games.name: Truck Parking Simulator 2026
games.summary: Accuracy defines the driver

games.name: We Were Here Before
games.summary: The frontier does not want to be settled. A narrative highly replayable story game where your choices build a settlement, shape its story, and seal its fate. Every run ends. Every obituary tells a story only you lived.

games.name: Whack-A-Monster
games.summary: Whack-A-Monster. An incremental game about Whacking, Smashing, Splashing & BONKING monsters. Upgrade through the skill tree and unlock new weapons to vanquish all evil from this world.

games.name: Where We Used to Play
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game focused on observation, anomaly detection, and meaningful choices that lead to multiple endings inside a house filled with forgotten memories.

games.name: Zwamman
games.summary: Zwamman is a zero pressure single screen puzzle game in which you have to use your light to help Zwamman find crystals in dark forests and swamps. Use the crystals to light a path to Zwamman's home and reveal the true nature of the scary monsters!

games.name: Archon Soul
games.summary: Roll the dice but make your own luck in this 2D dicebuilding roguelike. Customize your dice using swappable faces, runes, and bodies with unique effects. ​Draft spells, create powerful synergies, defeat challenging enemies, and conquer the Archon's palace.

games.name: Below, Rusted Gods
games.summary: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

games.name: Bills Must Be Paid
games.summary: A short active incremental game where you smash piggy banks to pay your bills. Collect coins, upgrade, and get debt free!

games.name: Blood Money
games.summary: Blood Money is a 2D tactical shooter game.

games.name: Bokura
games.summary: Bokura is a puzzle adventure game for 2 players only. Each player will be two boys who have run away from home, and will work together to overcome the wall and aim for "somewhere far".

games.name: Case Solved: The London Files
games.summary: A cozy noir puzzle game where you must investigate the dark underbelly of London. Murders have taken place, witness statements conflict and alibis aren’t adding up. Everyone has a motive, only logic reveals the truth.

games.name: Cat Hits the Deck
games.summary: Deckbuilder roguelike about a cat that fears being hurt but has only cards that hurt her before enemies! Min-max your resources, get OverPowered cards in your paw, and build an unlosable Deck that prolly gonna kill you 9 times^^

games.name: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand
games.summary: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand delivers a standalone roguelite wave-defense experience for solo and cooperative play. Command and survive against fast-paced escalating enemy waves, intimidating bosses, and dynamic battlefield events. Are you ready to make your final stand?

games.name: Cue Room
games.summary: Cue Room is a rogue-like billiard game. Shop balls with special abilities, pot them, embrace their unleashed chaos and repeat.

games.name: Dante's Rumba
games.summary: A route-planning puzzle game set in an oddly cozy version of Dantes Inferno. Clean up Hell, one circle at a time, discover various traps, and help Faust deal with a malfunctioning Rumba, an overly dramatic dead poet, and a personal mission he wont quite talk about.

games.name: Debrisverse
games.summary: The debt is a trap. DEBRISVERSE is a sci-fi incremental sim where you crush space debris for profit. Use roguelite upgrades to accelerate destruction and pay off your $100M debt. But this perfect workplace has a dark secret. Uncover the system's conspiracy across 7 unique endings.

games.name: Devils Due
games.summary: DEVIL'S DUE - A hellish slot machine RPG! Face demonic bosses in slot-based combat, collect Lucky Charms, and manage your debt to the Devil. Win big to deal damage, but demons turn your victories against you. Three phases of challenge await. Will you pay the Devil's Due?

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua
games.summary: Dungeon Antiqua is a simple RPG inspired by the Wizardry and Final Fantasy games of the 1980s and 1990s, in which players traverse dungeons by repeatedly exploring and developing their characters.

games.name: Dungeons of Hinterberg
games.summary: From developer Microbird, Dungeons of Hinterberg takes place in the Austrian Alps, where the small town of Hinterberg has become a tourist destination due to its lush scenery and crisp mountain air. And also monsters. It's a great place to holiday if you want to kill some monsters.

games.name: Dverghold
games.summary: When the Dwarves of Dverghold awakened something ancient beneath the isle of Rekestt, King Sterren sent word across the Shattered Sea: brave the haunted depths, or let the darkness rise. Oldschool dungeon crawler with turn-based combat and atmospheric soundtrack by Dungeon Synth artist Splendorius.

games.name: Echoes of Egypt
games.summary: Master action challenges in an ancient Egyptian setting. Dodge, jump, and dance through rhythmic puzzles on animated temple carvings, enhanced by a unique 1980s Middle Eastern soundtrack. Experience dynamic gameplay where history & fantasy meet, pushing your reflexes and rhythm skills to the limits.

games.name: Express Rider Simulator
games.summary: Paying rent is tough, but outrunning stray dogs is tougher! Go live in Express Rider Simulator, navigate complex addresses, and hype up your viewers. Manage fuel, handle your accountant, and upgrade your bike while battling dynamic weather. Can you deliver the goods without getting bitten?

games.name: Fishbait
games.summary: Fishbait is a chaotic card game where you play as fish that needs to avoid getting caught by the fisherman. It has online multiplayer and can be played with up to 4 people in a round. With its Russian roulette–style mechanics, only the last fish alive wins.

games.name: Florida Man Court
games.summary: Prosecute. Defend. Judge. Throw objections... or punches. Outwit opposing counsel, cross-examine bizarre NPC witnesses, and turn procedurally generated Florida Man cases into unforgettable multiplayer courtroom chaos.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel
games.summary: Fuga is set in a war-ravaged world where a village is destroyed by the fascist Berman Empire. Eleven child survivors band together after the attack and board a gigantic tank known as Taranis - a relic of an ancient but technologically-advanced civilization - in order to travel across the dangerous landscape and rescue their families who were taken prisoner. The Taranis houses a super weapon called the Soul Cannon which is capable of immense destruction at the cost of a crew member's life, with the main characters having to choose when and whom to sacrifice in order for the group to reach their destination.

games.name: Hotel The Memory
games.summary: If you find an anomaly, remember it. Welcome to Hotel The Memory, an anomaly-hunting x memory-matching escape game. Match pairs of rooms with the exact same anomaly to escape from this strange hotel.

games.name: Hydra Heli 2
games.summary: Hydra Heli 2 is a relaxing incremental game about sinking battleships with an overpowered helicopter. Control a swarm of unstoppable weapons, annihilate armadas, collect shards, and utilize the Depot to boost damage, increase firepower, and unlock new regions.

games.name: Idle Hacker
games.summary: IdleHacker is an idler/incremental game where you hack the world.

games.name: Idle_Directive
games.summary: Idly gather and manage resources to repair what's left of a decaying world. Scavenge forgotten ruins, meet scattered survivors, and push back against the inevitable collapse. Idle_Directive is a grid-based inventory and resource management idle game.

games.name: Joy Malignant
games.summary: A surreal dice-based RPG in a cursed city of gut-wrenching suffering. Here, your choices shape your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique identity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.

games.name: Kassei: Road Cycling - Next Season
games.summary: Kassei: Road Cycling - Next Season is a summer sports simulation game. Become one of more than 80 male and female road cycling managers at more than 10 tours and classics - and decide on training plans as well as race tactics! The next season starts here ...

games.name: Keyboard Warrior
games.summary:
The keyboard is the level!

Every key your press sends you flying to that location on-screen, slashing your sword along the way! There's no limit to how quickly you can attack, so nothing will hold you back from fighting as quickly or as slowly as you want. But be careful- Every enemy is different, so you'll need to bring strategy along with speed.

A single run in this rogue-like adventure can last anywhere from 15 seconds to 15 minutes. Keyboard Warrior features multiple difficulty settings, multiple international keyboard layouts, and hours of fun for those who are willing to master their keyboard.

games.name: Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau
games.summary: Time to fight back against the spirits! Play as an exorcist with firearms and purge unlawful spirits to solve the mystery of the Saiga village invasion in Nara!

games.name: Last Spaceship
games.summary: Last Spaceship is an adventure puzzle game. Play as a maintenance robot, repair the ship by solving a series of fascinating puzzles, explore its various compartments, and collect relics of human legacy. Experience a story about war, extinction, salvation, and choice.

games.name: Lily Fantasia
games.summary: Welcome, to the fantastical and rhythmic world of Lily Fantasia! Join the mysterious vampire, Lily, in a race against time to save your sickened mother. Overcome fierce enemies, wield the magical piano, and become the Rhythm Master you were always destined to!

games.name: Lunarium
games.summary: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

games.name: MandarinMastermind
games.summary: This is an adventure game that uses voice to solve puzzles. You will play as an amnesiac girl trapped in the ether world. You need to learn Mandarin words to solve puzzles, and use these words to activate magic and defeat enemies. Can you complete the challenge of using Mandarin?

games.name: Market Chain 98
games.summary: Build your Market Chain in this retro incremental game set inside a nostalgic 90s operating system. Start with a small shop, manage bank loans, expand your logistics hubs, and unlock global upgrades through your Portfolio. Fill your desktop with windows and dominate the market!

games.name: Mattami Restaurant & Cafe Tycoon
games.summary: ♪ Mattami is a restaurant tycoon game where you start with a tiny humble place and work your way up. Manage your staff, their schedule and inventory to efficiently grow your restaurant as fast and as elegant as possible.

games.name: MineGeon: Renegades
games.summary: Descend into Planet Paimo in MineGeon: Renegades, a chaotic multiplayer roguelite where you choose your renegade, delve into the minegeons, and battle unique enemies across diverse biomes. Fight, gather, improve, and die to uncover the secrets of Paimo and New Olympia.

games.name: Mischief Moves In
games.summary: Welcome to the laid-back nighttime world of Mischief Moves In. You’re Mischief, a raccoon who has just moved into the neighborhood. Find furniture to decorate your new home. Lend a paw to other animals during your adventure, and don’t worry about causing a little mischief along the way!

games.name: Mistfall Hunter
games.summary: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Gear up for different classes, master combos and strategic skills, and face intense battles against monsters or players, solo or with teammates. Only a successful escape will secure your treasures.

games.name: Osta
games.summary: A militaria collecting simulator where you hunt for items through metal detecting, auctions, and markets to build your collection and customize your home. Travel to various locations to uncover the relics of different conflicts throughout history.

games.name: Outclaw
games.summary:
Ouclaw is a cosy minion-managing action adventure about herding cats. Play as Comet, a five eyed magic cat from space who commands mischievous shadow kittens called Shades.

Fight monsters, solve puzzles, collect treasure, and explore a galaxy of vibrant worlds.

Morph your underlings into various forms, creating shields, bridges, bombs and more to aid in your journey - Who knows what they’ll become next?

games.name: Outfield
games.summary: Outfield is a horror/puzzle game in which you are trapped in a mysterious field of tall grass. Solve the puzzles, discover the secrets of the tall grass and survive the danger around you to hope to survive.

games.name: PhiloDeka
games.summary: In a serene, immersive world, strategically craft your path to turn every multiple of 10 into a rewarding harvest. Unlock the powerful interplay of numbers and strategy, and savor the satisfaction of perfect alignment and numerical zen.

games.name: Powerplay
games.summary: Powerplay is an RTS with a focus on resources and industry. Create supply chains, transport, and explore in this thrilling base builder. Grow into a powerful industrial nation, but don't spread too thin! Resources are finite and "the others" can reclaim what is theirs at any time.

games.name: Project Manager Sim
games.summary: Manage the most unpredictable resource - people - in this WASD tycoon! Plan projects, hire a dream team, assign tasks to specialists, and monitor the budget while upgrading your office. Balance between team burnout, complex contracts, and the wrath of upper management.

games.name: Retail Rivals
games.summary: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

games.name: Rleotha: Trial of Gods
games.summary: Help the young one complete the trial, set by the council of gods, on the planet Rleotha.

games.name: Scottside
games.summary: "Scottside" is a non-linear visual novel in the thriller genre. A small provincial town may seem quite dull. However, everything changes when you find a strange object in the forest.

games.name: Scuttle
games.summary: Scuttle across the sands in an exhilarating musically charged adventure. Groove to the beat to jump and boost your way through treacherous dunes and risky seas in this mesmerizing 3D platformer with rhythm game elements.

games.name: Sea War Naval Supremacy
games.summary: Sea War Naval Supremacy is a naval action RPG. Command your ship explore an endless ocean and battle pirates, mercenaries, and treasure hunters. Upgrade your fleet, unlock new ships and prove who rules the seas

games.name: Separated
games.summary: Trapped and separated across two connected houses, you and your friend must use voice chat to solve puzzles from different perspectives. But beware, a blind presence is listening to your conversations. Your voice is your only way out.

games.name: Singulier
games.summary: The party game where you must NEVER say the same thing as everyone else. Find the answer no one dares to give and survive — up to 100 players in Battle Royale! One friend buys it, the whole table plays FREE from their browser. Built for streaming.

games.name: Sizeable
games.summary: Sizeable is a relaxing and peaceful puzzle/exploration game where you shrink and grow your way through handcrafted dioramas in search of hidden objects. What is Sizeable?

games.name: Sizeable
games.summary: Sizeable is a puzzle/exploration game about shrinking and growing the environment in order to find all the hidden objects that every little diorama hides!

games.name: Slimelon
games.summary: Try to defeat the chaos generated by a multitude of slimes, each one cuter (almost) than the other. Discover all the fusions, collect them... And try to be the best (temporary) slime breeder!

games.name: Snekromancy
games.summary: Slither through a maze-like dungeon, devouring enemies and gobbling up treasure to summon an unstoppable horde in this twist on a classic.

games.name: Solitaire Deck
games.summary: Solitaire that runs beautifully on PC gaming handhelds where every win builds your Museum of card history. Play Solitaire Deck on any device with controller, mouse, keyboard or touch. No tricks. Just solitaire done right.

games.name: Subsurface
games.summary: Subsurface is a 1–4 player online co-op underwater horror game where players dive into abandoned underwater facilities to recover valuable scrap, meet demanding quotas, and survive terrifying creatures lurking in the depths. Explore, scavenge, and escape together—but beware, not everyone makes it back to the surface.

games.name: The King is Watching
games.summary: The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run.

games.name: Truck-Kun Is Supporting Me From Another World?!
games.summary: Your truck is magic and you now owe a soul debt to the buff isekai elf girl living in your head. Run over pedestrians as Truck-kun, make deliveries, and defeat the Skeleton King across two worlds in this chaotic run-based anime driving game!

games.name: Ugoku Sushi Bar
games.summary:
Become a sushi chef in a cozy Japanese conveyor belt sushi bar!
Prepare sushi on your crafting table, serve quirky customers, learn new recipes, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, and build relationships with your regular customers.

games.name: Vquarium
games.summary: Vquarium is a relaxing incremental-idle game where you grow your own underwater world on your screen overlay with a virtual assistant. Collect rare fish, discover sparkling variants, and decorate your tank while taking care of an adorable assistant!

games.name: Wake Up, Lia!
games.summary: Help Lia overcome her nightmares in a side-scrolling adventure across emotionally themed stages!

games.name: You Had a Bad Dream
games.summary: A minimalist horror game where you move through procedurally generated narrow corridors and avoid lurking monsters.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: TX-1
games.summary:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

games.name: Arcade Archives: TX-1
games.summary:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

games.name: Asteranova
games.summary: Fast-paced vertical scrolling space shooter featuring intense boss battles, challenging enemy waves, and score-driven arcade gameplay.

games.name: Be Kind Rewind
games.summary: The fate of movie night is in your hands.

games.name: Beats of Un'sonia
games.summary: Dive into a rhythmic combat game where every move counts! Adapt your playstyle, explore diverse biomes, face epic bosses, and push your score higher. Face the beat... and conquer it!

games.name: Ben's Zombie Apocalypse
games.summary: That unstoppable arcade addiction is back, once you start, you can't stop! Ben and Carmen, two agents, join the fight! Blast zombie heads and take down the towering bosses closing in!

games.name: Bicycle Quiz & Riding
games.summary:
A game to learn about the Blue Ticket system
Two gameplay modes: Quiz and Action
Simultaneous Japanese and English display

games.name: Blackwood Lodge: The Siblings
games.summary: Uncover the dark secrets of Blackwood Lodge in this atmospheric psychological horror game. As John Wilson, use your lighter to brave the dark, explore fractured spirit memories, and solve puzzles to piece together a tragic crime, all while evading a terrifying supernatural stalker.

games.name: Bloody Grids
games.summary: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure.

games.name: Blue Flag Down, Guard Up
games.summary: A fast-paced Blue Flag, White Flag arcade game where a split-second choice determines your score. Follow changing commands to test your reflexes and focus. Enjoy classic rules with fresh features, perfect for casual family fun.

games.name: Blue Reflection
games.summary:
A remaster of the first Blue Reflection game included in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.
Textures and character models have been updated to high resolution versions, and new visual effects such as glistening water add to the world’s atmosphere. New quality of life features such as autosave and increased movement speed have been included, offering a more enjoyable experience than ever before.

games.name: Blue Reflection Ray
games.summary:
A condensed game adaptation of the Blue Reflection Ray's anime included in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.

Follow Hiori and Ruka as they explore the Common while re-experiencing their memories on their way to confront a girl trying to recreate the world. New short stories expand on the anime’s story, and a new prologue and epilogue connect this entry to the other works in the series.

games.name: Blue Reflection Sun
games.summary:
An offline remake of the Blue Reflection Sun gacha game inclunded in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.
It has been remade as a console game using the systems of Blue Reflection: Second Light to recreate the memorable battles of the original game. 24 new character events have been added alongside the main story.

games.name: Blue Reflection: Second Light
games.summary: A new release of Second Light included in the Blue Reflection quartet bundle. This release features eight additional characters from Ray and Sun who can join you in battle, as well as new quality of life features such as increased battle speed, faster movement speed while exploring, and event fast-forwarding.

games.name: Bobble and the Tri-Crystal
games.summary: Swim, shoot, and save the ocean! Play as a detective fish in this fast-paced 2D Game Boy-style shoot 'em up! Unlock multiple weapons, defeat enemy hordes, and defeat bosses before it's too late!

games.name: Boli
games.summary: Boli is a retro-style JRPG with hand-drawn ASCII art. Venture forth into the wilderness to find a cure for a rare disease that is decimating your village.

games.name: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0
games.summary: A surreal narrative adventure set on the night Tamarack Narrows collapses into static, fire, and aurora. Follow Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk as an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation. A lo-fi, analog-horror

games.name: Bowling in a Skate Park
games.summary: Analyze the playfield, find the best trajectory, pick the right time and go for a strike hit.

games.name: Bringers of Darkness
games.summary: Fight for the forces of darkness in a fast-paced bullet heaven survivors-like. Become a champion of darkness, master unique abilities, and bring ruin to the kingdoms of light that created their own nightmares.

games.name: Buttons Up! 2
games.summary: The Gnomes are back! Buttons Up! is a incremental button collecting game where you hoard Buttons and keep them safe from stealing intruders. Get those Buttons Up by buying and crafting buildings. Unlock new skills from the tech tree and automate your income!

games.name: Card Homestead
games.summary: Card Homestead is a roguelike deckbuilder where card placement decides everything. Each day, draft one of three delivered cards and stack them onto your plot, engineering powerful chain reactions. Produce gold with efficient synergies and layouts to survive the ever-rising taxes.

games.name: Cento
games.summary: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!

games.name: Chameleon Dummy Hunt
games.summary:
Can you spot what does not belong?
Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden-object action game where sneaky dummy.

games.name: ChronoQuest VR
games.summary: Narrative VR adventure inspired by classic graphic adventures. Explore historical eras, interact with characters, and solve story-driven puzzles through dialogue and immersive environments. Designed for experienced players who enjoy story-driven challenges.

games.name: CipherMind
games.summary: Explore the eerie ruins, complete missions to obtain clues, deduce one's own and others' identities, and finally escape.

games.name: Click Build Repeat
games.summary: Click Build Repeat is an incremental game about building and collecting model kits.

games.name: Console Archives: Doraemon
games.summary:
Doraemon was released by Hudson (current Konami) in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
This is an action game in which Doraemon goes on adventure using various Secret Gadgets to search for Nobita, Shizuka, Gian, Suneo who have been sent to "Space," "The haunts of evil," and "Undersea" due to a problem with their Time machine.
Once you defeat the bosses in each world and rescue all of them, a wonderful ending awaits you!

games.name: Crayon Mandala
games.summary: Enjoy healing time with your family through soothing mandala coloring!

games.name: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute
games.summary:
The Culdcept series has captivated players worldwide. Now, the original masterpiece returns, enhanced with convenient new features.

Build your deck from over 300 types of cards and witness the dawn of a new battle among Cepter.

games.name: Cute Animals
games.summary: Adorable animal puzzles where toddlers learn, explore & grow.

games.name: Cyber City: Science Crime Mystery
games.summary:
The evidence is hidden in the artwork.
Find the truth with a keen eye — a cyber sci-fi mystery!

games.name: Defense of Fort Burton
games.summary:
Defense of Fort Burton is a top-down action RPG that fuses intense hero combat with strategic tower defense. Rebuild a besieged fortress, master legendary heroes, and face waves of corrupted creatures in heroic battles for survival.

This is a single player gameplay with blend of action and strategy. Defeat the series of various enemies, each enemies bring different character and ways to defeat them. Fight against unique bosses through at the climax situation.

games.name: Destroy The Universe: Solar Mayhem
games.summary: Choose a planet. Unleash cosmic weapons. Decide how the world ends.

games.name: Digital Survivor
games.summary: A neon bullet-heaven survivors roguelite. Outrun the swarm as 4 hunted programs, forge 20 weapons into ultimate forms, master build-defining synergies, raid extraction vaults, climb leaderboard seasons — and face ROOT, the administrator that wants you deleted.

games.name: Dimension Defenders
games.summary: Tower Defense Redefined. Race friends in ranked 1v1, defend together in 2-player co-op, or solo your way through dimensions of escalating chaos.

games.name: Dinosaurium
games.summary: Crack. Hatch. Roar. Extinction was never the end. Hatch and raise hundreds of unique dinosaurs through real-time growth in this cozy idle game. Your prehistoric park thrives with ancient giants, even while you work or study.

games.name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Super Limit-Breaking Neo
games.summary:
Super Limit-Breaking Neo has come to Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
Adding new Playable Characters, new Customization, new Stages, and Solo Mode!
Experience the Super Limit-Breaking battle!

Adding about 30 characters including those joining the Budokai Tenkaichi series for the first time such as Super 17, Bardock, Super Saiyan, and Champa and Vegeta (GT)!

games.name: Dramatic Road: The Origin of Wind
games.summary: A full-fledged simulation RPG set in modern Japan! A variety of characters unique to modern times, such as riders, magicians, and baseball players, have appeared. Command them, nurture them, and use their skills to protect the peace of the school!

games.name: Eden Coil
games.summary:
upgrade your snake
manage more snakes at once
solve puzzles

games.name: Elementis TD
games.summary: Elementis TD is an elemental tower defense game. Basic towers are intentionally weak, and the core mechanic consists of combining them into 21 discoverable fusions. A Corruption system can affect the player's own towers during a wave. The game features a 7-chapter campaign, an endless mode with progressive scaling, and 90 achievements.

games.name: Escape game R00m15
games.summary: Explore 3D space and escape

games.name: Exstetra
games.summary: The only way to save the world is a kiss——. 《EXSTETRA》 is a fantasy RPG set in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and burdened with a doomed fate, where you rise as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the threat of the world’s destruction.

games.name: Fantasy Journey
games.summary: The core combat gameplay is similar to Sekiro, emphasizing precise parrying, counterattacks, and dodging—players can even trigger powerful counters with regular attacks. The game features richly detailed environments and a vast, expansive world map.

games.name: Fantasy Maiden Wars: Dream of the Stray Dreamer
games.summary: A fantasy tactical RPG where you command over 70 characters across grid-based battles. Customize skills, unleash flashy Spell Cards, and enjoy rich animations in a strategic, story-driven adventure set in the world of Touhou.

games.name: Forgotten Playland: Party Edition
games.summary: Step into Forgotten Playland: Party Edition, a 4-player social party game where the attic becomes your Playland and PlushKyn take center stage. Compete, socialize, and express yourself in a beautifully crafted world.

games.name: Get Fit: Beach Workout
games.summary: Train with hot beach trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer,

games.name: Hachishakusama
games.summary: 『She Is Always Right Beside You』 The fate of one summer — a boy beloved by the eight-feet-tall Hachishakusama, the urban legend. A heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.

games.name: Hex Core
games.summary: Hex Core is a short, incremental clicker-style defense game where you help PeteOS hold back waves of viruses until you can wipe them out for good. Spend resources to unlock a huge spread of upgrades, new mechanics, weapons, and research.

games.name: How Many Dudes?
games.summary: How many dudes does it take to beat up 1000 toddlers? A gorilla? Twelve bears and a horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out.

games.name: Hyperstacks
games.summary:
Hyperstacks is a VR world of combat, parkour, logic-driven puzzles, memorable characters, and community-made levels.
Meet its residents through quests and discover a growing library of player creations.

games.name: Ira
games.summary: A character-based shooter with roguelike elements, IRA celebrates the artistry of what shooter fans call “bullet hell”: enemy projectiles that weave intricate, geometric patterns across the screen and force you to seek out the precarious safe spaces between them. Set in an Eastern-influenced fantasy world marked by ethereal beauty as well as grave danger, it’s a procedurally generated action game that requires skill, inspires strategy and rewards patience.

games.name: Jump Protocol
games.summary: Leap across towering rooftops, wall-run over obstacles, and master fast-paced parkour as you race through a dangerous city filled with enemies and challenging platforming.

games.name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
games.summary: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

games.name: Kimi ni Madoi, Kimi ni Oboreru.
games.summary: An omegaverse visual novel by Otomate.

games.name: Kusan: City of Wolves
games.summary:
Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter where players fight through a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption to save Haru — a girl fitted with a city-grade atomic weapon.

Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves, a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

games.name: LEGO Party!
games.summary: LEGO(R) Party! is a 4-player party game that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO and more. Play your way! Join your friends no matter their platform locally or online!

games.name: La vieja contra el Dibu
games.summary: The judge thought it was funny. He gave the kid a choice: two years behind bars, or get his mother to score a goal against the best goalkeeper in the world. The kid chose his old lady, he didn’t even think twice. So the judge signed off on the fine print: 30 penalty kicks, one per day. And if none of them go in, the kid will no longer get two years. He’ll be sentenced to death. No one asked the old lady, who’s sixty years old and has never even kicked a football. Nor did they tell Dibu that on the other side there was a woman. Or maybe they did, and that’s why he agreed. He waits for her every morning between the posts. He talks to her. He makes fun of her. He dances. She shows up every morning nonetheless.

games.name: Laptop Architect
games.summary: Design laptops from the PCB up and build a global tech empire! Balance complex heat and power mechanics, manage your corporate budget, and conquer international markets. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Laptop Architect?

games.name: Leafy Corner
games.summary: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

games.name: Loot Before the Law
games.summary: Sneak through guarded corridors, avoid police patrols, and steal valuable loot without being detected. Study their routes, stay out of sight, and escape before the law catches up with you.

games.name: Ludus: A Gladiator Story
games.summary: A fully voiced branching narrative RPG of the Roman arena with a unique engraving and VO for every choice and outcome. Four origins, over 1,800 choices, and 19 endings. You will bleed on the sand. The only question is whether you bleed for them, or for yourself. Every choice leaves a scar.

games.name: Machine Party
games.summary: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

games.name: Mechaconda
games.summary: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while collecting cards that add unique ability upgrades to the body of a small snake Mechaconda.

games.name: Midnight Moments
games.summary: A small, cyberpunk diorama-building game where you create cozy rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, or quiet neighbourhood corners. Decorate your designs with props and place citizens, crafting stories that bring your city to life. At your own pace. No goals. Just vibes.

games.name: Mikane's Hand
games.summary: A girl's card battle world — where you witness the turmoil of youth. What is this place?

games.name: Mimicry!
games.summary: Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!

games.name: Moon Corona
games.summary: open your eyes from the ancient temple and embark on this adventure! Embark on an RPG adventure in a dark-themed sandbox world. Explore vast lands, collect all kinds of cards, craft diverse combinations, and make pivotal choices—seeking lost truths and redemption in the chaos and danger.

games.name: Mycubium
games.summary: Mycubium is a first-person 3D puzzle platformer where you grow bridges using mushrooms in a minimalist cubic world. Explore and solve spatial puzzles across shifting landscapes filled with secrets, platforming challenges, and evolving mechanics. Build your path as the day fades to night.

games.name: Nazi Zombies
games.summary: Nazi Zombies is a cooperative survival game where players fend off escalating waves of Nazi zombies, earning points by killing zombies and repairing barriers to buy weapons, upgrades, perks, and unlock new map areas to maximize their survival.

games.name: Neko Odyssey
games.summary: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

games.name: Nightmare Shift
games.summary: Nightmare Shift is a psychological horror game that follows a female protagonist who starts a new job as a motel receptionist, only to find her life spiraling into a dark and mysterious reality. As she questions her sanity, she must uncover the truth behind the eerie and abnormal events around her.

games.name: Noun Town: Learn & Chill
games.summary: Learn 500+ words across 12 languages (including Japanese + Spanish). Test your vocabulary to earn credits, unlock relaxing lofi tracks, and customize your study space. Put your progress on autopilot and watch your vocabulary grow while you chill.

games.name: One-Move Checkmate: Chess Brain Trainer
games.summary:
Find the winning move
Solve checkmate puzzles
Train your chess thinking

games.name: Pixel Warrior
games.summary: Only forward - towards the enemies! Without fear!

games.name: Random Dragons
games.summary: Chance-based roguelike deckbuilder with silly and goofy dragons. Spin the roulette wheel to get insane crit damage on enemies, manipulate the odds, and use multipliers like Balatro. Build your synergic deck and kill Random Dragons.

games.name: Redtail Relic Rush
games.summary:
Adventure never slows down in Redtail Relic Rush! Join Redtail, a fearless red panda explorer armed with a grappling hook, on an action-packed journey through ancient ruins filled with danger, mystery, and legendary treasures.

Run nonstop through thrilling platforming challenges packed with traps, enemies, and daring leaps. Swing through the air, build momentum at just the right moment, and master the perfect rhythm to overcome every obstacle as you race toward the legendary Golden Idol.

Explore 30 exciting levels across 3 unique biomes, from lush jungle ruins and mysterious cliffs to ancient pyramids full of secrets. Every environment introduces fresh challenges that put your reflexes, timing, and precision to the test while keeping the adventure fun and rewarding.

With charming pixel art, responsive controls, and smooth gameplay that always makes you want to play just one more level, Redtail Relic Rush is the perfect adventure for fans of fast-paced platformers, exploration, and exciting action.

Grab your grappling hook, keep your momentum, and prove that no treasure is out of your reach!

games.name: Rita
games.summary: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

games.name: Room 0
games.summary: A first-person horror game about a detective investigating an abandoned research facility, a missing girl named Carla, and the sealed room at the center of it all. Recover VHS tapes, follow the tracks left behind, and avoid what's left inside.

games.name: Rose Guns Days: Season 2
games.summary: In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

games.name: Senara: The Sacrament
games.summary: "SENARA: The Sacrament" is a first-person survival horror aboard a ship. Uncover the truth while escaping fanatics and unspeakable horrors. In a place where blind faith and salvation intertwine, you’ll be forced to make choices that go far beyond survival.

games.name: Senatus
games.summary: Strategic card battles in the heart of the Roman Senate. Debate, persuade, and rise through the ranks to become Consul of Rome. Influence is power — and power decides everything.

games.name: Seventh Mansion: The First Escape
games.summary: Escape an eerie mansion where death resets everything. Solve puzzles, evade the Wicked Nuns, or use a camera to survive in this psychological horror experience.

games.name: Shard Squad
games.summary: In Shard Squad, join elemental creatures to save their lands in intense battles against challenging hordes and bosses. Strengthen yourself with unique allies, gather valuable items, face epic calamities, and unlock new members to create unique strategies on your path to victory!

games.name: Sheva
